articles.title: Agile Space Industries Expands to Seattle Area with New Bellevue Office
articles.author: Agile Space Industries

paras.en: BELLEVUE, Wash., Oct. 15, 2026 — Agile Space Industries, a leading provider of in-space chemical propulsion solutions, has expanded into the Seattle metropolitan area with the opening of a new office in Bellevue, Washington. The expansion builds on Agile’s continued growth, extending its engineering capabilities and strengthening its presence in one of the nation’s most established aerospace and technology markets.
paras.zh: 华盛顿州贝尔维尤，2026 年 10 月 15 日 — 领先的太空化学推进解决方案提供商 Agile Space Industries 已将业务扩展到西雅图大都市区，在华盛顿州贝尔维尤开设了新办事处。此次扩张建立在敏捷公司持续增长的基础上，扩大了其工程能力，并加强了其在美国最成熟的航空航天和技术市场之一的影响力。

paras.en: Located at Sunset North in Bellevue, the new 5,470-square-foot office will initially accommodate 7 employees, with the capacity to grow to approximately 30 as Agile expands its regional operations. Agile Chief Technology Officer Jake Mills will be based at the Bellevue office, reinforcing the company’s commitment to establishing a strong engineering and leadership presence in the region.
paras.zh: 位于贝尔维尤 Sunset North 的新办公室占地 5,470 平方英尺，最初可容纳 7 名员工，随着 Agile 扩大其区域业务，其容量将增至约 30 名员工。 Agile 首席技术官 Jake Mills 将常驻贝尔维尤办事处，强化公司在该地区建立强大的工程和领导力的承诺。

paras.en: “Seattle has a remarkable concentration of aerospace talent, innovative companies and organizations advancing the space industry,” said Jake Mills, chief technology officer at Agile Space Industries. “Establishing a presence here allows us to tap into that expertise, strengthen industry relationships and build on the capabilities we’re developing across Agile to support our customers and their missions.”
paras.zh: Agile Space Industries 首席技术官杰克·米尔斯 (Jake Mills) 表示：“西雅图集中了航空航天人才、推动航天工业发展的创新公司和组织。” “在这里建立业务使我们能够利用这些专业知识，加强行业关系，并利用我们在敏捷开发中的能力来支持我们的客户及其使命。”

paras.en: The Bellevue office will focus on engineering and program management, supporting the development and delivery of advanced propulsion systems for government and commercial space missions. As the team grows, Agile expects to broaden its technical expertise and support an expanding range of propulsion programs.
paras.zh: 贝尔维尤办事处将专注于工程和项目管理，支持政府和商业太空任务的先进推进系统的开发和交付。随着团队的成长，Agile 希望扩大其技术专业知识并支持不断扩大的推进项目。

paras.en: Beyond its engineering talent, the Seattle region offers an established network of aerospace companies, industry partners and investors. Agile’s presence in this ecosystem creates opportunities to strengthen customer relationships, develop new partnerships and engage with the broader business and investment community as the company pursues its long-term growth objectives.
paras.zh: 除了工程人才之外，西雅图地区还拥有成熟的航空航天公司、行业合作伙伴和投资者网络。在公司追求其长期增长目标的过程中，敏捷在这个生态系统中的存在创造了加强客户关系、发展新的合作伙伴关系以及与更广泛的商业和投资社区互动的机会。

paras.en: The expansion also creates opportunities for experienced aerospace professionals looking to work on complex propulsion challenges in a collaborative, hands-on engineering environment. Agile’s teams contribute to programs spanning early development through qualified flight hardware, with the opportunity to help shape technologies supporting the next generation of space missions.
paras.zh: 此次扩建还为经验丰富的航空航天专业人士创造了机会，让他们能够在协作的实践工程环境中应对复杂的推进挑战。 Agile 的团队通过合格的飞行硬件为早期开发项目做出贡献，并有机会帮助塑造支持下一代太空任务的技术。

paras.en: The Bellevue office joins Agile’s headquarters in Durango, Colorado, and operations in Pennsylvania and Oklahoma. Together, these locations support Agile’s growing capabilities in propulsion design, manufacturing and testing, positioning the company to serve an expanding range of commercial and government space customers.
paras.zh: 贝尔维尤办事处与敏捷公司位于科罗拉多州杜兰戈的总部以及宾夕法尼亚州和俄克拉荷马州的业务部门一起成立。这些地点共同支持敏捷在推进设计、制造和测试方面不断增长的能力，使该公司能够为不断扩大的商业和政府航天客户提供服务。

paras.en: Agile Space Industries develops advanced chemical propulsion solutions that enable spacecraft to move, maneuver, and operate in space. From early concepts to qualified flight hardware, Agile brings together propulsion expertise, additive manufacturing, and in-house testing to rapidly solve complex challenges and accelerate development. Agile partners with leading aerospace companies and the U.S. Government on spacecraft and launch vehicle programs. Learn more at agilespaceindustries.com.
paras.zh: Agile Space Industries 开发先进的化学推进解决方案，使航天器能够在太空中移动、机动和运行。从早期概念到合格的飞行硬件，敏捷汇集了推进专业知识、增材制造和内部测试，以快速解决复杂的挑战并加速开发。 Agile 与领先的航空航天公司和美国政府就航天器和运载火箭项目开展合作。请访问agilespaceindustries.com 了解更多信息。

articles.title: How NASA is thinking about a moon base
articles.author: SpaceNews Editor

paras.en: In this episode, SpaceNews’ Mike Gruss talks with NASA’s Shatel Bhakta, the principal systems engineer for Moon Base, about what’s needed between now and 2028 and the incremental steps to the future.
paras.zh: 在本集中，SpaceNews 的 Mike Gruss 与 NASA 月球基地首席系统工程师 Shatel Bhakta 讨论了从现在到 2028 年的需求以及未来的渐进步骤。

paras.en: Space Minds is a new audio and video podcast from SpaceNews that focuses on the inspiring leaders, technologies and exciting opportunities in space.
paras.zh: Space Minds 是 SpaceNews 推出的新音频和视频播客，重点关注太空中鼓舞人心的领导者、技术和令人兴奋的机会。

paras.en: The weekly podcast features compelling interviews with scientists, founders and experts who love to talk about space, covers the news that has enthusiasts daydreaming, and engages with listeners. Join Mike Gruss and journalists from the SpaceNews team for new episodes every Thursday.
paras.zh: 每周播客对热爱谈论太空的科学家、创始人和专家进行引人注目的采访，报道让爱好者们做白日梦的新闻，并与听众互动。每周四与 Mike Gruss 和 SpaceNews 团队的记者一起观看新剧集。

paras.en: Watch a new episode every Thursday on SpaceNews.com and on our YouTube, Spotify and Apple channels.

articles.title: Astranis Upgrades Falcon 9 Launch Contract to Dedicated Mission for Entire Block 4 Production Run of Satellites
articles.author: Astranis

paras.en: SAN FRANCISCO —October 26, 2026—Today, Astranis announced it has upgraded its 4th launch to a dedicated mission aboard a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket set to launch in 2028, allowing it to carry all of the “Block 4” production run of Astranis MicroGEO satellites.
paras.zh: 旧金山 — 2026 年 10 月 26 日 — 今天，Astranis 宣布已将其第四次发射升级为由 SpaceX Falcon 9 火箭执行的专用任务，该火箭定于 2028 年发射，使其能够运载 Astranis MicroGEO 卫星的所有“Block 4”生产运行。

paras.en: The mission will carry six MicroGEO satellites, placed directly into GEO via direct-inject using an Impulse Helios upper stage. These new satellites expand Astranis’ capacity to serve commercial and government customers around the world. The launch will bring Astranis’ total fleet size to 16, adding to the 10 satellites built across Blocks 1, 2, and 3. Astranis has already signed a number of initial customers for Block 4, to be announced at a later date. This is an amendment to an initial contract Astranis signed with SpaceX in late 2024 that gives Astranis the full payload capacity on the mission.
paras.zh: 该任务将携带六颗 MicroGEO 卫星，使用 Impulse Helios 上级通过直接注入直接放入 GEO。这些新卫星扩大了 Astranis 为全球商业和政府客户提供服务的能力。这次发射将使 Astranis 的总卫星规模达到 16 颗，在 Block 1、2 和 3 中建造的 10 颗卫星中又增加了。Astranis 已经签署了 Block 4 的一些初始客户，具体信息将在稍后公布。这是对 Astranis 于 2024 年底与 SpaceX 签署的初始合同的修订，该合同赋予 Astranis 任务中的全部有效载荷能力。

paras.en: Securing launches for multi-satellite blocks is a core benefit of Astranis’ responsive business model and provides the capacity needed to support the increased demand for dedicated space infrastructure.
paras.zh: 确保多卫星块的发射是 Astranis 响应式业务模式的核心优势，并提供支持专用空间基础设施不断增长的需求所需的容量。

paras.en: Governments and enterprises around the world are increasingly seeking dedicated space infrastructure for communications and other missions such as space domain awareness that they can fully control, rather than relying on shared capacity. Higher orbits like GEO are uniquely suited for this requirement.
paras.zh: 世界各地的政府和企业越来越多地寻求用于通信和其他任务的专用空间基础设施，例如他们可以完全控制的空间域意识，而不是依赖共享能力。像 GEO 这样的更高轨道非常适合这一要求。

paras.en: “We’ve only just begun to ramp up production to meet the demand we are seeing for commercial and national security missions,” said John Gedmark, CEO and co-founder of Astranis. “This launch means we can accelerate the critical infrastructure we’re building for customers in GEO and other higher orbits.”
paras.zh: Astranis 首席执行官兼联合创始人约翰·格德马克 (John Gedmark) 表示：“我们才刚刚开始提高产量，以满足商业和国家安全任务的需求。” “这次发射意味着我们可以加速为 GEO 和其他更高轨道的客户构建的关键基础设施。”

paras.en: This contract marks another step in Astranis’ continued expansion of high-orbit infrastructure and follows the recent introduction of Perceptor, which extends the company’s reach beyond communications into space domain awareness and maneuverability for commercial and national security missions. Astranis first proved that high-performance GEO satellites could be built faster and at scale. The company is now developing broader high-orbit platforms to connect, safeguard, and sustain critical infrastructure in GEO.
paras.zh: 该合同标志着 Astranis 持续扩展高轨道基础设施的又一步，之前推出了 Perceptor，将公司的业务范围从通信扩展到商业和国家安全任务的空间域感知和机动性。 Astranis 首先证明了高性能 GEO 卫星可以更快、更大规模地建造。该公司目前正在开发更广泛的高轨道平台，以连接、保护和维持地球静止轨道的关键基础设施。

paras.en: Astranis builds advanced satellites for high orbits, expanding humanity’s reach into the solar system. Today Astranis satellites provide dedicated, secure networks to highly-sophisticated customers across the globe — large enterprises, sovereign governments, and the US military.
paras.zh: Astranis 为高轨道建造先进的卫星，将人类的触角扩展到太阳系。如今，Atranis 卫星为全球高度复杂的客户（大型企业、主权政府和美国军方）提供专用、安全的网络。

paras.en: With multiple satellites now on orbit serving customers around the world, the company is servicing a backlog of more than $1 billion of commercial contracts. Astranis is the preferred satellite communications partner for buyers with stringent requirements for uptime, data security, network visibility, and customization.
paras.zh: 目前，该公司有多颗卫星在轨运行，为世界各地的客户提供服务，并正在为积压的超过 10 亿美元的商业合同提供服务。 Astranis 是对正常运行时间、数据安全、网络可见性和定制有严格要求的买家的首选卫星通信合作伙伴。

paras.en: Astranis has raised over $1.2 billion from some of the world’s best investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, BlackRock, Fidelity, Franklin Templeton, and Snowpoint, and employs a team of 500 engineers and entrepreneurs. Astranis designs, builds, and operates its satellites out of its 153,000 sq. ft. headquarters in Northern California, USA.
paras.zh: Astranis 已从安德森霍洛维茨 (Andreessen Horowitz)、贝莱德 (BlackRock)、富达 (Fidelity)、富兰克林邓普顿 (Franklin Templeton) 和 Snowpoint 等全球最佳投资者处筹集了超过 12 亿美元，并拥有一支由 500 名工程师和企业家组成的团队。 Astranis 在其位于美国北加州 153,000 平方英尺的总部设计、建造和运营其卫星。

articles.title: Ebola: UN officials condemn killing of nurse in DR Congo

paras.en: Ebola: UN officials condemn killing of nurse in DR Congo
paras.zh: 埃博拉：联合国官员谴责刚果民主共和国护士遇害事件

paras.en: The UN’s Ebola coordinator and the head of the World Health Organization (WHO) have deplored the killing of a nurse working to halt the spread of the disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC).
paras.zh: 联合国埃博拉协调员和世界卫生组织（WHO）负责人对刚果民主共和国（DRC）一名致力于阻止埃博拉病毒传播的护士被杀表示遗憾。

paras.en: The nurse was killed by protesters in Bafwasende, a rural town in Tshopo province, on Saturday while responding to an Ebola alert.
paras.zh: 周六，这名护士在乔波省乡村小镇巴夫瓦森德响应埃博拉警报时被抗议者杀害。

paras.en: A health worker was also severely injured in the attack and remains in hospital.
paras.zh: 一名卫生工作者也在袭击中受重伤，目前仍在医院接受治疗。

paras.en: Julien Harneis, UN Senior Ebola Response Coordinator, issued a statement extending condolences to the nurse’s family and colleagues.
paras.zh: 联合国埃博拉应对高级协调员朱利安·哈尼斯发表声明，向这名护士的家人和同事表示哀悼。

paras.en: “I strongly condemn this attack and call for a thorough investigation,” he said. “I urge communities to protect health workers and allow them to carry out their work safely”.
paras.zh: 他说：“我强烈谴责这次袭击，并呼吁进行彻底调查。” “我敦促社区保护卫生工作者，让他们安全地开展工作”。

paras.en: The WHO Director-General, Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, expressed his condolences in a post on social media. He also wished a swift and full recovery to the injured health worker.
paras.zh: 世卫组织总干事谭德塞在社交媒体上发帖表达哀悼。他还祝愿受伤的卫生工作者迅速全面康复。

paras.en: “Everyone working to protect communities from this deadly disease must be able to work in dignity and safety,” he wrote on X. “Healthcare must always be protected.”
paras.zh: 他在 X 上写道：“每个致力于保护社区免受这种致命疾病侵害的人都必须能够有尊严和安全地工作。医疗保健必须始终受到保护。”

paras.en: The deadly incident occurred amid ongoing efforts to contain the spread of Ebola disease caused by Bundibugyo virus for which there currently is no approved vaccine.
paras.zh: 这起致命事件发生时，正在努力遏制由本迪布焦病毒引起的埃博拉疾病的传播，目前尚无批准的疫苗。

paras.en: More than 9,760 cases and some 4,727 deaths have been recorded in the DRC since the outbreak was declared on 15 May, according to recent WHO figures.
paras.zh: 根据世卫组织最新数据，自 5 月 15 日宣布疫情爆发以来，刚果民主共和国已记录超过 9,760 例病例，约 4,727 人死亡。

paras.en: The outbreak is the deadliest in the country’s history. It was first reported in the volatile eastern region and has now reached eight provinces: Bas-Uélé, Haut-Uélé, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Sud Ubangi, Tshopo and Nord-Ubangi.
paras.zh: 这次疫情是该国历史上最致命的一次。疫情首先在动荡的东部地区报告，现已蔓延到八个省份：下韦莱省、上韦莱省、伊图里省、北基伍省、南基伍省、南乌班吉省、乔波省和北乌班吉省。

paras.en: Uganda also confronted a smaller Ebola outbreak which was declared defeated in August, while France, Kenya and Nigeria have reported cases.
paras.zh: 乌干达还遭遇了规模较小的埃博拉疫情，并于八月宣布被击败，而法国、肯尼亚和尼日利亚也报告了病例。

paras.en: Nigeria confirmed its first case last week – a woman who had travelled from Uganda.
paras.zh: 尼日利亚上周确认了第一例病例——一名来自乌干达的女性。

paras.en: She and a contact, who is her husband, were medically evacuated to Switzerland on Monday morning, WHO said, explaining that both are Swiss citizens and that the patient is clinically stable.
paras.zh: 世卫组织表示，她和一名联系人（即她的丈夫）已于周一上午接受医疗疏散至瑞士，并解释说，两人都是瑞士公民，患者临床情况稳定。

paras.en: “The Nigerian medical team successfully managed her through the acute phase of the illness and stabilized her condition,” the WHO regional director for Africa, Dr. Mohamed Janabi, wrote on X.
paras.zh: 世卫组织非洲区域主任穆罕默德·贾纳比博士在 X 上写道：“尼日利亚医疗队成功地帮助她度过了疾病的急性期，并稳定了她的病情。”

paras.en: He congratulated the Nigerian Government, health workers, clinicians, emergency responders and all those involved in the response.
paras.zh: 他向尼日利亚政府、卫生工作者、临床医生、应急人员以及所有参与应对工作的人员表示祝贺。

paras.en: “This is a remarkable achievement and a testament to what Africa can accomplish when we work together,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“这是一项了不起的成就，证明了我们共同努力非洲可以取得的成就。”

paras.en: Dr. Janabi noted that the evacuation means Nigeria currently has no Ebola cases, “however, vigilance remains critical”.
paras.zh: 贾纳比博士指出，撤离意味着尼日利亚目前没有埃博拉病例，“但是，保持警惕仍然至关重要”。

paras.en: Nigeria will continue to monitor 52 contacts, he said, while Switzerland will assume responsibility for the patient’s continued care and follow-up of her husband.
paras.zh: 他说，尼日利亚将继续监测 52 名接触者，而瑞士将负责患者的持续护理和对其丈夫的随访。

articles.title: In Egypt, Guterres warns against Iran-US escalation

paras.en: In Egypt, Guterres warns against Iran-US escalation
paras.zh: 在埃及，古特雷斯警告伊朗与美国不要升级

paras.en: “I want to send a loud and clear message to the parties. We need maximum restraint and diplomatic solutions,” he said.
paras.zh: “我想向各方发出响亮而明确的信息。我们需要最大限度的克制和外交解决方案，”他说。

paras.en: “If the sabre-rattling we are witnessing now translates itself into a major escalation, the situation in the region can get out of control.”
paras.zh: “如果我们现在看到的武力威胁演变成局势的重大升级，该地区的局势可能会失控。”

paras.en: Moreover, navigational rights and freedoms must be fully restored in and around the Strait of Hormuz and the Bab el-Mandeb Strait at the mouth of the Red Sea – critical maritime corridors for global trade.
paras.zh: 此外，必须全面恢复霍尔木兹海峡和红海口曼德海峡及其周边地区的航行权利和自由，这两个海峡是全球贸易的关键海上走廊。

paras.en: He commended Egypt for its mediation role in helping to create the conditions for dialogue between the sides.
paras.zh: 他赞扬埃及在帮助创造双方对话条件方面发挥的调解作用。

paras.en: The Secretary-General was speaking alongside Egypt’s Foreign Minister Badr Abdelatty following meetings focused on this and other crises in the Middle East and Africa.
paras.zh: 在就这一危机以及中东和非洲的其他危机举行会议后，秘书长与埃及外交部长巴德尔·阿卜杜拉蒂一起发表了讲话。

paras.en: “Egypt is a pillar of multilateralism,” he said. “And at a time when divisions are deepening, it is critical to keep the channels of diplomacy open.”
paras.zh: “埃及是多边主义的支柱，”他说。 “在分歧加深之际，保持外交渠道畅通至关重要。”

paras.en: On Gaza, Mr. Guterres expressed profound appreciation for Egypt’s indispensable role, noting that the country has been central to mediation and humanitarian efforts since the beginning of the conflict.
paras.zh: 关于加沙，古特雷斯先生对埃及不可或缺的作用深表赞赏，并指出自冲突开始以来，该国一直是调解和人道主义努力的核心。

paras.en: He commended continued support in facilitating life-saving aid, medical evacuations and the work of humanitarian partners such as the Egyptian Red Crescent.
paras.zh: 他赞扬埃及红新月会等人道主义合作伙伴在促进救生援助、医疗后送和工作方面的持续支持。

paras.en: The Secretary-General called for Israeli restrictions on humanitarian assistance to be lifted and obstacles blocking implementation of the UN Security Council-endorsed comprehensive plan to end the Gaza conflict to be removed.
paras.zh: 秘书长呼吁以色列取消对人道主义援助的限制，并消除阻碍执行联合国安理会批准的结束加沙冲突全面计划的障碍。

paras.en: “Civilians must be protected and international law must be respected,” he said.
paras.zh: “平民必须受到保护，国际法必须得到尊重，”他说。

paras.en: The UN chief said he was also deeply alarmed by Israeli actions in the occupied West Bank, pointing to expanding settlements, “unrelenting” evictions, surging violence, assaults, and attacks against journalists and diplomats.
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长表示，他还对以色列在被占领的约旦河西岸的行动深感震惊，并指出以色列不断扩大定居点、“无情”驱逐、暴力事件激增、袭击记者和外交官。

paras.en: “We are seeing an increasingly coercive environment with the spectre of ethnic cleansing looming ever larger. This must end,” he said.
paras.zh: “我们看到一个越来越具有胁迫性的环境，种族清洗的幽灵越来越大。这种情况必须结束，”他说。

paras.en: Moreover, there can be no durable peace in the Middle East without the realization of the legitimate rights of the Palestinian people to self-determination, he said, once again upholding the two-State solution.
paras.zh: 此外，如果巴勒斯坦人民不实现合法的自决权利，中东就不可能实现持久和平，他再次支持两国解决方案。

paras.en: The Secretary-General also addressed the war in Sudan. He said that “the fighting must stop”, adding that the country’s future “must belong to the Sudanese people through an inclusive pro-political process that preserves its unity, sovereignty, and territorial integrity”.
paras.zh: 秘书长还谈到了苏丹战争。他说，“战斗必须停止”，并补充说，该国的未来“必须通过包容性的亲政治进程，维护苏丹的统一、主权和领土完整，属于苏丹人民”。

paras.en: Regarding Libya, he said that “it is time to build on political momentum, unify institutions and pave the way for national elections, finally bringing the prolonged transition to an end.”
paras.zh: 关于利比亚，他表示，“现在是巩固政治势头、统一机构、为全国选举铺平道路、最终结束漫长过渡的时候了。”

paras.en: The UN chief leaves office at the end of the year and this marked his ninth visit to Egypt since being appointed in 2017.
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长将于今年年底卸任，这是他自 2017 年被任命以来第九次访问埃及。

paras.en: Mr. Guterres began his remarks by explaining that he has come back repeatedly “because when this region and our world have faced some of the most difficult moments, Egypt has consistently worked to open space for diplomacy”.
paras.zh: 古特雷斯先生在讲话开始时解释说，他多次回来“是因为当这个地区和我们的世界面临一些最困难的时刻时，埃及一直致力于为外交打开空间”。

articles.title: Ukraine: Investigators find Russia committed war crimes by targeting civilians

paras.en: Ukraine: Investigators find Russia committed war crimes by targeting civilians
paras.zh: 乌克兰：调查人员发现俄罗斯针对平民犯下战争罪

paras.en: Top human rights experts investigating Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine said on Monday that the Russian authorities had committed war crimes and crimes against humanity by attacking civilians and vital energy infrastructure, among other violations of international law.
paras.zh: 调查俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰的高级人权专家周一表示，俄罗斯当局袭击平民和重要能源基础设施等违反国际法的行为，犯下了战争罪和反人类罪。

paras.en: In its latest report, the Independent International Commission of Inquiry on Ukraine, noted that attacks on power plants have intensified “once again” across Ukraine, where temperatures plunged to -21°C last winter.
paras.zh: 乌克兰问题独立国际调查委员会在其最新报告中指出，乌克兰各地对发电厂的袭击“再次”加剧，去年冬天乌克兰气温骤降至-21°C。

paras.en: “The scariest thing was to fall asleep and not to wake up; it was like torture to be scared of dying from cold,” said one 53-year-old man cited in the report, which reiterated the war’s serious negative impact on older people, too.
paras.zh: 报告中援引一名 53 岁男子的话说：“最可怕的是睡着了就醒不来；害怕冻死就像一种折磨。”报告还重申了战争对老年人的严重负面影响。

paras.en: “I lay cold and hungry, without medicine, without anything,” said a 74-year-old woman from Kyiv, who like many senior citizens is unable to use stairs and too afraid to use lifts, making it impossible to reach a safe place during air raid alerts.
paras.zh: “我又冷又饿，没有药物，什么也没有，”一位来自基辅的 74 岁妇女说。她和许多老年人一样，无法使用楼梯，也不敢使用电梯，因此在空袭警报期间无法到达安全地点。

paras.en: “This means that they must remain in unheated dwellings without electricity or water, with no access to life support devices or essential services,” the report’s authors insisted.
paras.zh: 该报告的作者坚称：“这意味着他们必须留在没有暖气、没有电或水的住宅中，无法获得生命支持设备或基本服务。”

paras.en: Russian commanders ordering the attacks knew full well that the heating facilities they were targeting “were indispensable to the civilian population, particularly during the winter”, the report notes.
paras.zh: 报告指出，下令发动袭击的俄罗斯指挥官非常清楚，他们所针对的供暖设施“对平民来说是不可或缺的，尤其是在冬天”。

paras.en: “Russian authorities have made official declarations concerning further attacks and referred to a plan to carry them out. The independent investigators concluded that they committed war crimes of intentionally directing attacks against civilian objects.”
paras.zh: “俄罗斯当局已就进一步袭击发表正式声明，并提到了实施这些袭击的计划。独立调查人员得出的结论是，他们犯下了故意针对民用物体进行袭击的战争罪。”

paras.en: The Commission was appointed by the UN Human Rights Council in March 2022, shortly after Russian troops entered Ukrainian territory.
paras.zh: 该委员会于 2022 年 3 月俄罗斯军队进入乌克兰领土后不久由联合国人权理事会任命。

paras.en: For its latest report, the three-person panel relied on the accounts of 255 persons who endured winter amid dire conditions in Dnipro, Kyiv, Kharkiv, Kherson, Mykolaiv, Odesa, Poltava, Zaporizhzhia and Zhytomyr oblasts, as well as Ukrainian authorities, medical doctors and non-governmental organisations.
paras.zh: 该三人小组的最新报告参考了第聂伯罗、基辅、哈尔科夫、赫尔松、尼古拉耶夫、敖德萨、波尔塔瓦、扎波罗热和日托米尔州 255 名在恶劣条件下度过冬季的人以及乌克兰当局、医生和非政府组织的叙述。

paras.en: The Commission also examined attacks by Ukrainian armed forces on energy infrastructure in Russia and in occupied areas of Ukraine. But the panel’s investigators – Erik Møse, Pablo de Greiff and Vrinda Grover – were unable to investigate the impact of these strikes in Russia as the authorities did not allow access or respond to requests for information.
paras.zh: 委员会还审查了乌克兰武装部队对俄罗斯和乌克兰被占领地区能源基础设施的袭击。但该小组的调查人员——埃里克·莫斯（Erik Møse）、巴勃罗·德·格雷夫（Pablo de Greiff）和弗林达·格罗弗（Vrinda Grover）——无法调查这些袭击对俄罗斯的影响，因为当局不允许访问或回应信息请求。

paras.en: The Commission also cited “compelling evidence” that the Russian authorities recruited men trafficked from 29 countries into the armed forces, in violation of international human rights law.
paras.zh: 委员会还引用了“令人信服的证据”，表明俄罗斯当局招募了来自 29 个国家的贩运人口加入武装部队，这违反了国际人权法。

paras.en: The new recruits have been deployed on the front lines in Ukraine “and assigned dangerous tasks. Many have been killed or have gone missing, others have surrendered or were captured by the Ukrainian armed forces, thereby acquiring the status of prisoners of war,” the report notes.
paras.zh: 报告指出，新兵被部署在乌克兰前线，“执行危险任务。许多人被杀或失踪，其他人投降或被乌克兰武装部队俘虏，从而获得战俘地位”。

paras.en: It highlights how the trafficking happened using “deception and coercion”, in coordination with agents operating in different countries; and how soon after arrival, the men were forced to sign contracts in Russian with the Ministry of Defence.
paras.zh: 它强调了人口贩运是如何通过与不同国家的特工协调“欺骗和胁迫”进行的；抵达后不久，这些人被迫用俄语与国防部签订合同。

paras.en: The report recounts the testimony of a 35-year-old woman, the wife of a man who was recruited from the Caribbean, who said: “They took his passport and just told him to sign here, here and here on the contract. It was only in Russian. He was totally pressured and had no choice.”
paras.zh: 报告援引了一名 35 岁妇女的证词，她是一名从加勒比海招募的男子的妻子，她说：“他们拿走了他的护照，只是告诉他在合同上在这里、这里和这里签字。只有俄语。他完全受到压力，别无选择。”

paras.en: It calls for all the trafficked persons to be discharged from the Russian armed forces.
paras.zh: 它呼吁所有被贩运者从俄罗斯武装部队中退役。

paras.en: The UN Independent International Commission of Inquiry on Ukraine is an independent body mandated by the UN Human Rights Council to investigate all alleged violations and abuses of human rights and violations of international humanitarian law, and related crimes in the context of the aggression against Ukraine by the Russian Federation. The Commission’s members are not UN staff nor are they paid for their work.
paras.zh: 联合国乌克兰问题独立国际调查委员会是联合国人权理事会授权的一个独立机构，负责调查俄罗斯联邦侵略乌克兰期间所有涉嫌侵犯和践踏人权、违反国际人道主义法的行为以及相关犯罪行为。该委员会的成员不是联合国工作人员，他们的工作也没有报酬。

articles.title: Fearnley retires injured to give Fery victory at Vienna Open

paras.en: Jacob Fearnley retires hurt against Arthur Fery at Vienna Open as Harriet Dart extends winning run
paras.zh: 雅各布·费恩利 (Jacob Fearnley) 在维也纳公开赛对阵阿瑟·费里 (Arthur Fery) 时受伤退赛，哈里特·达特 (Harriet Dart) 延续连胜纪录

paras.en: Arthur Fery is into the second round of the Vienna Open after fellow Brit Jacob Fearnley retired with an injury in the first set; Harriet Dart has won her third successive match at the Guangzhou Open; watch WTA and ATP Tours live on Sky Sports
paras.zh: 亚瑟·费里 (Arthur Fery) 进入维也纳公开赛第二轮，英国同胞雅各布·费恩利 (Jacob Fearnley) 在第一盘受伤退赛。哈丽雅特·达特 (Harriet Dart) 在广州公开赛上取得三连胜；观看天空体育直播 WTA 和 ATP 巡回赛

paras.en: Jacob Fearnley retired with an injury after losing 5-1 in the first set against Arthur Fery to give his fellow countryman a place in the second round at the Vienna Open.
paras.zh: 雅各布·费恩利 (Jacob Fearnley) 在首盘以 5-1 输给阿瑟·费里 (Arthur Fery) 后因伤退赛，为他的同胞赢得了维也纳公开赛第二轮的席位。

paras.en: Fearnley was broken by Fery in just his second service game, with the British No 1 winning the next two games on the bounce and looking set to consign his opponent to a comprehensive first-set loss.
paras.zh: 费恩利在他的第二个发球局中就被费里破发，这位英国头号选手在接下来的两局比赛中迅速获胜，并有望让对手在第一盘全面失利。

paras.en: Fearnley, though, then put a stop to the contest, shaking the umpire's hand and retiring with an unspecified injury, allowing Fery safe passage to the next stage of the competition.
paras.zh: 不过，费恩利随后终止了比赛，与裁判握手并因伤退场，费里的伤势不明，这让费里安全进入了比赛的下一阶段。

paras.zh: - 博尔特在日本公开赛半决赛中失利，但将重返英国第一

paras.en: Fery will face the winner of No 6 seed Francis Tiafoe and Lorenzo Musetti - the latter of whom he lost against in straight sets at the US Open - in the second round.
paras.zh: 费里将在第二轮面对六号种子弗朗西斯·蒂亚福和洛伦佐·穆塞蒂的冠军——后者在美国公开赛上直落两盘落败。

paras.en: Dart extends winning run in Guangzhou Open
paras.zh: 达特在广州公开赛延续连胜纪录

paras.en: Harriet Dart maintained her winning form at the Guangzhou Open in China as she beat Russian qualifier Tatiana Prozorova 6-4 2-6 6-2 to reach the second round.
paras.zh: 哈丽雅特·达特 (Harriet Dart) 在中国广州公开赛上继续保持胜利状态，以 6-4 2-6 6-2 击败俄罗斯资格赛选手塔蒂亚娜·普罗佐罗娃 (Tatiana Prozorova)，进入第二轮。

paras.en: Dart, who also came through two qualifiers, will next face Uzbekistan's Polina Kudermetova or Indonesia's Janice Tjen in the last 16 after winning a see-saw battle against world number 123 Prozorova.
paras.zh: 达特也通过了两场预选赛，在与世界排名第 123 名的普罗佐罗娃的拉锯战中获胜后，接下来将在 16 强赛中对阵乌兹别克斯坦选手波琳娜·库德梅托娃或印度尼西亚选手珍妮丝·詹恩。

paras.en: Both players struggled to hold serve, but the British number five broke three times in the decider to open up a 5-2 lead and served out to seal victory in two hours and 15 minutes.
paras.zh: 两位选手都难以保住发球局，但英国五号选手在决胜盘中三次破发，以5-2领先，并在2小时15分钟的发球局中锁定胜局。

paras.en: British teenager Mika Stojsavljevic slipped to a heavy first-round defeat at the Toray Pan Pacific Open in Tokyo, losing 6-1 6-2 to Filipino world number 19 Alexandra Eala in one hour and 15 minutes.
paras.zh: 英国小将米卡·斯托伊萨夫列维奇(Mika Stojsavljevic)在东京举行的东丽泛太平洋公开赛首轮惨败，用时1小时15分钟以1-6、2-6不敌世界排名第19位的菲律宾选手亚历山德拉·伊拉(Alexandra Eala)。

paras.en: Stojsavljevic, 17, who won the girls' US Open singles title at the 2024 US Open, was broken twice in both sets by the world number 19 after being given a wildcard into the WTA 500 tournament.
paras.zh: 17岁的斯托伊萨夫列维奇在2024年美国公开赛上赢得了女子美国公开赛单打冠军，但在获得WTA 500赛事的外卡后，她在两盘比赛中都被世界排名第19的选手两次破发。

articles.title: McDowell latest player to confirm LIV Golf exit

paras.en: LIV Golf: Graeme McDowell becomes latest player to confirm exit from breakaway tour
paras.zh: LIV Golf：格雷姆·麦克道尔（Graeme McDowell）成为最新确认退出脱离巡回赛的球员

paras.en: Graeme McDowell is the latest player to announce he is leaving LIV Golf; the breakaway league is looking to relaunch for the 2027 season with new investment; the Northern Irishman follows in the footsteps of Jon Rahm, Ian Poulter and Tyrrell Hatton, who will not participate in LIV 2.0
paras.zh: 格雷姆·麦克道尔 (Graeme McDowell) 是最新一位宣布离开 LIV Golf 的球员；脱离联盟希望通过新的投资在 2027 赛季重新启动；这位北爱尔兰人追随 Jon Rahm、Ian Poulter 和 Tyrrell Hatton 的脚步，将不会参加 LIV 2.0

paras.en: Graeme McDowell has confirmed he will follow the lead of Jon Rahm, Tyrrell Hatton and Ian Poulter, among others, by becoming the latest player to leave LIV Golf.
paras.zh: 格雷姆·麦克道尔 (Graeme McDowell) 确认，他将追随乔恩·拉姆 (Jon Rahm)、泰瑞尔·哈顿 (Tyrrell Hatton) 和伊恩·保尔特 (Ian Poulter) 等人的脚步，成为最新离开 LIV Golf 的球员。

paras.en: The 2010 US Open Champion revealed the news in a social media post on Monday, but the 47-year-old did not elaborate on his future plans.
paras.zh: 这位2010年美国公开赛冠军周一在社交媒体帖子中透露了这一消息，但这位47岁的选手没有详细说明他的未来计划。

paras.en: "I've decided not to pursue LIV 2.0," the Northern Irishman wrote on X.
paras.zh: “我决定不再追求 LIV 2.0，”这位北爱尔兰人在 X 上写道。

paras.en: "I'm grateful for the opportunity I've had over the last four years and want to thank everyone who has been part of that journey.
paras.zh: “我很感激过去四年里获得的机会，并感谢所有参与这段旅程的人。

paras.en: "I look forward to the next chapter of my career."
paras.zh: “我期待着我职业生涯的下一个篇章。”

paras.en: LIV Golf is currently plotting out its future after its former backers, Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund (PIF), announced in April that it would be ending its financing of the breakaway league at the end of the 2026 season.
paras.zh: LIV Golf 的前支持者沙特阿拉伯公共投资基金 (PIF) 在 4 月份宣布将在 2026 年赛季末结束对脱离联盟的融资，目前该公司正在规划其未来。

paras.en: The league was left searching for new investment, but secured financing from BC Partners Credit before filing for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection and citing its intentions to relaunch again in 2027 in a new league, dubbed LIV 2.0.
paras.zh: 该联盟被迫寻找新的投资，但在申请破产保护第 11 章之前从 BC Partners Credit 获得了融资，并表示打算在 2027 年以一个名为 LIV 2.0 的新联盟重新启动。

paras.en: The move left some LIV players contemplating their futures on the tour, with two-time major winner Rahm reaching a separation agreement in October to leave due to 'unacceptable terms' proposed for LIV 2.0.
paras.zh: 这一举动让一些 LIV 选手开始考虑自己在巡回赛中的未来，两届大满贯冠军拉姆在 10 月份达成了分居协议，由于 LIV 2.0 提出的“不可接受的条款”而离开。

paras.en: His compatriot, Sergio Garcia, has also ended his contract, while Hatton announced on social media on Friday that he too would "not be a part of LIV 2.0".
paras.zh: 他的同胞塞尔吉奥·加西亚也终止了合同，而哈顿周五在社交媒体上宣布他也“不会成为 LIV 2.0 的一部分”。

paras.en: BC Partners had set a deadline of October 25 for players to commit to the league going forward, with a handful of players having announced they would re-sign.
paras.zh: BC Partners 为球员们设定了 10 月 25 日为联盟未来承诺的最后期限，少数球员已经宣布将重新签约。

paras.en: McDowell, who was a part of LIV Golf's OKGC side, joined the breakaway league in 2022.
paras.zh: 麦克道尔曾是 LIV Golf 的 OKGC 球队的一员，于 2022 年加入了脱离联盟。

paras.en: His last start at a DP World Tour event, outside of the majors, came at the 2022 BMW PGA Championship.
paras.zh: 他最后一次参加大满贯赛之外的 DP 世界巡回赛是在 2022 年 BMW PGA 锦标赛上。

articles.title: Carney: 'England have it all to do to avoid Rugby League World Cup exit'

paras.en: Rugby League World Cup: Brian Carney warns England ‘have it all to do’ to avoid group-stage exit
paras.zh: 橄榄球联盟世界杯：布莱恩·卡尼警告英格兰队“必须全力以赴”以避免小组赛出局

paras.en: England’s hopes of reaching the Rugby League World Cup semi-finals hang in the balance, with their progression dependent on other results; Brian McDermott's side must beat Papua New Guinea on Friday, with Tonga set to face Samoa on Sunday
paras.zh: 英格兰进入橄榄球联盟世界杯半决赛的希望悬而未决，他们的晋级取决于其他结果；布莱恩·麦克德莫特的球队必须在周五击败巴布亚新几内亚，汤加队将于周日对阵萨摩亚

paras.en: Brian Carney says England ‘have it all to do’ to reach Rugby League World Cup semi-finals and avoid historic group-stage exit.
paras.zh: 布莱恩·卡尼表示，英格兰队“必须竭尽全力”才能进入橄榄球联盟世界杯半决赛，并避免历史性的小组赛出局。

paras.en: England's 30-12 defeat to Tonga in their opening match raised doubts over their chances of reaching the knockout stages.
paras.zh: 英格兰队在首场比赛中以30比12输给汤加队，让人们对他们晋级淘汰赛的机会产生了怀疑。

paras.en: Even after sealing an 82-0 victory against France on Saturday, Brian McDermott's side still needs a series of events to go their way to qualify.
paras.zh: 即使在周六以 82-0 战胜法国队之后，布莱恩·麦克德莫特的球队仍然需要一系列的比赛才能晋级。

paras.en: - Rugby League World Cup: Latest schedule, results, standings
paras.zh: - 橄榄球联盟世界杯：最新赛程、结果、积分榜

paras.en: - Latest Rugby League World Cup headlines and reports
paras.zh: - 最新的橄榄球联盟世界杯头条新闻和报道

paras.en: - Get the latest Sky Sports deals or stream with no contract
paras.zh: - 获取最新的天空体育优惠或无合同直播

paras.en: England must beat Papua New Guinea (PNG) in Wollongong on Friday by a large margin. They will then need to wait two days to learn their fate, with Tonga set to play Samoa in Sydney on Sunday.
paras.zh: 周五，英格兰队必须在卧龙岗以大幅优势击败巴布亚新几内亚队。然后他们需要等待两天才能知道自己的命运，汤加队将于周日在悉尼对阵萨摩亚队。

paras.en: A Samoa victory would send England out, while a Tonga win could see them progress on points difference.
paras.zh: 萨摩亚队的胜利将使英格兰队出局，而汤加队的胜利则可以让他们以分差晋级。

paras.en: "The whistle went on the Tonga game, and everybody went: 'well, this format is appalling. England are essentially out. It's one and done in the tournament'," Sky Sports Rugby League's Carney said.
paras.zh: “与汤加队的比赛哨声响起，每个人都说：‘好吧，这种赛制太可怕了。英格兰队基本上已经出局了。这在锦标赛中就已经结束了’，”天空体育橄榄球联盟的卡尼说。

paras.en: "They went out against France, and they built a huge scoreline to give themselves a hope.
paras.zh: “他们对阵法国队，他们创造了巨大的比分给自己带来希望。

paras.en: "They're gonna have to do the same again against a PNG side, who I have found disappointing, in the tournament so far. They will need Tonga to beat Samoa, so they're going to need an awful lot to go their way."
paras.zh: “他们将不得不再次对巴布亚新几内亚队做同样的事情，到目前为止，我对巴布亚新几内亚队的表现感到失望。他们需要汤加队击败萨摩亚队，所以他们需要大量的球员才能走上自己的路。”

paras.en: This year's tournament features a unique format, with six teams included in Pool B and C. If multiple teams finish tied, final group standings will be determined by a team's head-to-head record.
paras.zh: 今年的比赛采用了独特的赛制，B组和C组共六支球队。如果多支球队打成平手，则最终小组排名将根据一支球队的交锋记录来决定。

paras.en: That means Tonga will finish above England in the standings after their first-round victory.
paras.zh: 这意味着汤加在首轮获胜后将在积分榜上超越英格兰。

paras.en: England trail Samoa by a points difference margin of 68, heading into the final round of fixtures, and will need to cut that deficit with a big win against PNG to leapfrog Samoa.
paras.zh: 英格兰在进入最后一轮比赛时以 68 分的差距落后萨摩亚，需要通过大胜巴布亚新几内亚来缩小差距才能超越萨摩亚。

paras.en: "What England have to do, and you've heard this a thousand times in different sports, is control the controllables," Carney said.
paras.zh: 卡尼说：“英格兰必须做的就是控制可控因素，你在不同的运动中已经听过一千遍了。”

paras.en: "They'll have to go out. Pile on the points, and the more points they put over, the less Tonga have to win by."
paras.zh: “他们必须出局。积累分数，他们得分越多，汤加获胜的机会就越少。”

paras.en: England Women must change to catch up with Australia
paras.zh: 英格兰女足必须做出改变才能赶上澳大利亚

paras.en: England's Women's side were outclassed by Australia on Saturday, suffering a 78-0 defeat to the defending world champions.
paras.zh: 英格兰女足周六不敌澳大利亚队，以 78 比 0 输给卫冕世界冠军。

paras.en: The defeat follows Stuart Barrow's side's 90-4 loss to the Jillaroos in Las Vegas in March 2025, raising further questions about the gap between England and the world's leading teams.
paras.zh: 这场失利是在斯图尔特·巴罗的球队于 2025 年 3 月在拉斯维加斯以 90-4 输给 Jillaroos 队之后发生的，这引发了人们对英格兰与世界领先球队之间差距的进一步质疑。

paras.en: Despite opening the tournament with a commanding 70-6 victory over Wales, England must beat Samoa in a winner-takes-all final group-stage clash on Saturday to secure their place in the knockout stages.
paras.zh: 尽管英格兰队在本届世界杯上以70-6大胜威尔士，但他们必须在周六的小组赛最后一场赢者通吃的比赛中击败萨摩亚，才能确保进入淘汰赛阶段。

paras.en: Reflecting on the heavy defeat to Australia, McDermott acknowledged that significant changes are needed across all levels of rugby league in the UK if England are to close the gap on the Jillaroos.
paras.zh: 回顾对澳大利亚队的惨败，麦克德莫特承认，如果英格兰队想要缩小与吉拉鲁斯队的差距，英国各级橄榄球联赛都需要进行重大改变。

paras.en: "I'd ask this question, what did one expect?" Carney said, reflecting on the match.
paras.zh: “我会问这个问题，人们期望什么？”卡尼回忆起这场比赛说道。

paras.en: "The English Women's side, it's coming from a competition that is struggling for competitive games, struggling for resources, fighting for resources, against a Jillaroos side who are very well resourced in a very competitive environment with very strong competition, and all the best players in the world are in Australia's competition, the NRLW.
paras.zh: “英国女足是一场为竞技性比赛而奋斗、为资源而奋斗、为资源而奋斗的比赛，对手是一支在竞争激烈的环境中资源非常丰富、竞争非常激烈的 Jillaroos 球队，世界上所有最好的球员都在澳大利亚的 NRLW 比赛中。

paras.en: "So, I'm not sure what people expected the game to be. Was it an improvement on the Las Vegas defeat? Marginally on the scoreboard.
paras.zh: “所以，我不确定人们对这场比赛的期望是什么。这是否比拉斯维加斯的失利有所改善？在记分牌上处于边缘地位。

paras.en: "Some will argue that they have seen signs that England have turned the corner. I'm not so sure.
paras.zh: “有些人会说他们已经看到英格兰已经走出困境的迹象。我不太确定。

paras.en: "Unless you sort out the competition over here, and rugby league in this part of the world, and everybody is adequately funded, you're not going to close the gap."
paras.zh: “除非你解决这里的竞争，以及世界这个地区的橄榄球联赛，并且每个人都有足够的资金，否则你无法缩小差距。”

articles.title: Mass protests challenge Macron as French police use tear gas and water cannons
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: PARIS — More than 100,000 people marched in Paris on Saturday over school funding and soaring living costs, challenging President Emmanuel Macron’s government in a largely peaceful demonstration before clashes broke out near the march’s end point.
paras.zh: 巴黎——周六，超过 10 万人在巴黎举行游行，抗议学校经费和生活成本飙升，在一场基本和平的示威中挑战总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙(Emmanuel Macron)的政府，但在游行终点附近爆发了冲突。

paras.en: Paris police estimated turnout at 110,000, with demonstrators mobilizing despite restrictions that confined the march to the city’s southeastern edge, away from the center.
paras.zh: 巴黎警方估计参加人数为 11 万人，尽管游行活动仅限于远离市中心的城市东南边缘，但示威者仍动员起来。

paras.en: Students, union members, environmentalists and other groups marched through cold, rainy weather. Near the march’s end point at Porte de Vincennes, some demonstrators threw bottles and rocks at police, who then charged at the crowd, fired tear gas and used water cannons. The clashes lasted about an hour. NBC News witnessed no looting.
paras.zh: 学生、工会成员、环保人士和其他团体冒着寒冷多雨的天气游行。在文森门的游行终点附近，一些示威者向警察投掷瓶子和石块，警察随后冲向人群，发射催泪瓦斯并使用高压水枪。冲突持续了大约一个小时。 NBC 新闻没有目睹抢劫事件。

paras.en: Police used tear gas in several cities, including Lyon, Clermont-Ferrand and Strasbourg, and water cannons in Nice and Nantes, French media reported. In Marseille, officers fired tear gas during clashes with several dozen people near the march’s end point.
paras.zh: 据法国媒体报道，警方在里昂、克莱蒙费朗和斯特拉斯堡等多个城市使用了催泪瓦斯，并在尼斯和南特使用了高压水枪。在马赛，警察在游行终点附近与数十人发生冲突时发射了催泪瓦斯。

paras.en: The Paris prosecutor’s office said 64 people were arrested in connection with Saturday’s demonstration and 40 were placed in police custody. They included six minors. Most arrests concerned suspected weapons offenses or participation in a group preparing violence or property damage, the office said.
paras.zh: 巴黎检察官办公室表示，有 64 人因周六的示威活动被捕，其中 40 人被警方拘留。其中包括六名未成年人。该办公室表示，大多数逮捕涉及涉嫌武器犯罪或参与准备暴力或财产损坏的团体。

paras.en: The unrest is testing Macron’s authority in the final months of his presidency before voters choose his successor in May. The stakes are high: The far-right National Rally has accused his government of failing to protect the public and urged people to channel their anger into votes for it.
paras.zh: 在选民于五月选出他的继任者之前，这场骚乱正在考验马克龙总统任期最后几个月的权威。风险很高：极右翼全国集会指责他的政府未能保护公众，并敦促人们将愤怒转化为投票。

paras.en: Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez had announced a nationwide deployment of up to 70,000 officers, backed by helicopters, armored vehicles and water cannons.
paras.zh: 内政部长洛朗·努涅斯宣布在全国范围内部署多达 7 万名警员，并提供直升机、装甲车和水炮的支援。

paras.en: An Associated Press journalist saw tens of thousands of people marching from Porte d’Italie early in the afternoon. Trade unions led the procession, followed by protesters in raincoats carrying flags and handmade placards.
paras.zh: 美联社记者下午早些时候看到数万人从意大利门游行。游行队伍由工会带头，后面是穿着雨衣、举着旗帜和手工制作的标语牌的抗议者。

paras.en: At Porte de Vincennes, some demonstrators tried to continue toward Place de la Nation, but police blocked their path, French media reported.
paras.zh: 据法国媒体报道，在文森门，一些示威者试图继续前往民族广场，但警察挡住了他们的道路。

paras.en: Camille Chesnier, 27, said she had been unable to find work despite having an engineering degree and a master’s degree.
paras.zh: 27 岁的卡米尔·切斯尼尔 (Camille Chesnier) 表示，尽管她拥有工程学位和硕士学位，但一直找不到工作。

paras.en: “There are enormous numbers of people in the same situation as me but who aren’t privileged and who find themselves living on the streets and in squats, and frankly, it’s very tough,” she said.
paras.zh: “有很多人和我处境相同，但他们没有特权，他们发现自己生活在街头和棚屋里，坦率地说，这非常艰难，”她说。

paras.en: Another demonstrator, Domitille, 25, told NBC News that the people are protesting over several critical issues, including the cost of living.
paras.zh: 另一位示威者、25 岁的多米蒂尔 (Domitille) 告诉 NBC 新闻，人们抗议包括生活费用在内的几个关键问题。

paras.en: “We are tired of the government because the cost of living is higher. The policeman just goes against the population — kids, everyone. ... And also fascists are rising in France. And we need to hear everyone, because we are tired and we need to be heard as citizens,” she said Saturday, noting it’s her first time protesting.
paras.zh: “我们厌倦了政府，因为生活成本更高。警察只是与民众作对——孩子们，每个人。……法西斯分子也在法国崛起。我们需要听到每个人的声音，因为我们累了，我们需要作为公民被听到，”她周六说道，并指出这是她第一次抗议。

paras.en: A small protest became a national movement
paras.zh: 一场小规模的抗议活动变成了一场全国性的运动

paras.en: What began last month as a protest over staff shortages at one high school southeast of Paris has grown into a national movement. Students demanding better schools and workers seeking higher wages and pensions have brought anger over living standards into the final months of Macron’s presidency.
paras.zh: 上个月，一场针对巴黎东南部一所高中教职人员短缺的抗议活动开始，现已发展成为一场全国性的运动。学生要求更好的学校，工人寻求更高的工资和养老金，这些都将人们对生活水平的愤怒带入了马克龙总统任期的最后几个月。

paras.en: Energy prices in France were 21.3% higher in September than a year earlier, helping drive overall inflation to 3.1%, according to the national statistics agency, INSEE.
paras.zh: 根据国家统计机构 INSEE 的数据，法国 9 月份能源价格比去年同期上涨 21.3%，推动整体通胀率升至 3.1%。

paras.en: Macron met high school representatives Friday. They said he had promised to overhaul university admissions, but they called for protests to continue until concrete measures are announced.
paras.zh: 马克龙周五会见了高中代表。他们表示，他已承诺对大学招生进行彻底改革，但他们呼吁抗议活动继续下去，直到宣布具体措施为止。

paras.en: Police changed the Paris route Friday. On Saturday morning, police cleared Place de la Bastille, where protesters had originally been expected to gather. NBC News journalists were among those ordered out of the square and witnessed no resistance. Police used a megaphone to tell people to leave or face a 135-euro ($150) fine.
paras.zh: 周五警方改变了巴黎路线。周六早上，警方清理了原本预计抗议者聚集的巴士底广场。 NBC新闻记者也被勒令离开广场，但没有看到任何抵抗。警方使用扩音器告诉人们离开，否则将面临 135 欧元（150 美元）的罚款。

paras.en: Soumaya Abed, a 58-year-old nurse wearing a red CGT union vest, said she had been joining protests for more than 30 years but had never seen a march start at Porte d’Italie.
paras.zh: 身穿红色 CGT 工会背心的 58 岁护士苏玛亚·阿贝德 (Soumaya Abed) 表示，她参加抗议活动已有 30 多年，但从未见过意大利门举行游行。

paras.en: “They are using what happened last week as an excuse to quiet protesters,” she said. “But it won’t stop the movement. It won’t stop students from demanding better conditions in schools.”
paras.zh: “他们利用上周发生的事情作为平息抗议者的借口，”她说。 “但这不会阻止这场运动。它不会阻止学生要求更好的学校条件。”

paras.en: A student studying cinema at Paris’ Sorbonne University told NBC News he joined the protests because of a police crackdown on demonstrations at Sorbonne Nouvelle University.
paras.zh: 一名在巴黎索邦大学学习电影的学生告诉美国全国广播公司新闻，他参加抗议活动是因为警方镇压了新索邦大学的示威活动。

paras.en: “They were, like, kicking people who were not involved in the protest inside the university, and it was a total mess,” he said.
paras.zh: “他们踢那些没有参与大学内抗议活动的人，场面一片混乱，”他说。

paras.en: “We are mostly students,” he added, referring to the protesters. “We’re not here to break things. We’re not here to mess with the cops or anyone. We’re just here to protest.”
paras.zh: “我们主要是学生，”他补充道，指的是抗议者。 “我们不是来这里破坏​​东西的。我们不是来这里惹警察或任何人的。我们只是来这里抗议。”

paras.en: In Marseille, police put attendance at 17,000, while the CGT union estimated 100,000. In the southwestern city of Toulouse, 26,500 people joined the protests, according to authorities. Authorities had banned rallies in Lyon, Nice and Montpellier and other cities.
paras.zh: 在马赛，警方估计出席人数为 17,000 人，而 CGT 工会估计出席人数为 100,000 人。据当局称，在西南部城市图卢兹，有 26,500 人参加了抗议活动。当局已禁止在里昂、尼斯和蒙彼利埃等城市举行集会。

paras.en: Trade unions have criticized the bans, calling them violations of freedom of expression, which is protected by the constitution.
paras.zh: 工会批评这些禁令，称其侵犯了受宪法保护的言论自由。

paras.en: Thousands also marched Saturday in Orléans, south of Paris, in a separate peaceful protest against the far right as Marine Le Pen’s National Rally held a two-day congress in the city.
paras.zh: 周六，数千人还在巴黎南部的奥尔良游行，在玛丽娜·勒庞的全国集会在该市举行为期两天的大会之际，举行了针对极右翼的另一场和平抗议活动。

paras.en: Macron, a centrist, has entered the crisis in the final stretch of his term, with his popularity at its lowest since he took office in 2017. He has said the measures are needed to protect city centers, businesses and public buildings.
paras.zh: 中间派马克龙在任期最后阶段陷入危机，支持率降至2017年上任以来的最低点。他表示，需要采取这些措施来保护市中心、企业和公共建筑。

paras.en: Nuñez acknowledged Monday that police lost control in some cities during last weekend’s unrest. He offered to resign, but Macron refused the offer.
paras.zh: 努涅斯周一承认，在上周末的骚乱中，警方在一些城市失去了控制。他提出辞职，但被马克龙拒绝。

paras.en: More than half a million people took to the streets last Saturday. About 3,000 shops across France were damaged or looted over the weekend.
paras.zh: 上周六，超过五十万人走上街头。周末，法国各地约 3,000 家商店遭到破坏或抢劫。

paras.en: Gendarmes stood guard beneath the Arc de Triomphe as shopkeepers boarded up storefronts across Paris. Near the Saint-Lazare train station Saturday, Akram Ahmed, a 34-year-old contractor, was boarding up an optician’s shop.
paras.zh: 宪兵在凯旋门下站岗，巴黎各地的店主都用木板封住了店面。周六，在圣拉扎尔火车站附近，34 岁的承包商阿克兰·艾哈迈德 (Akram Ahmed) 正在用木板封住一家眼镜店。

paras.en: “I got the call last night,” he said. “The owner seemed desperate. He said I was saving his life.”
paras.zh: “我昨晚接到电话，”他说。 “店主看起来很绝望。他说我正在救他的命。”

paras.en: Major museums, including the Louvre, the Orsay Museum, the Picasso Museum and the Grand Palais — where a major Cézanne exhibit is on display — were shuttered Saturday.
paras.zh: 包括卢浮宫、奥赛博物馆、毕加索博物馆和大皇宫在内的主要博物馆（其中展出了塞尚的主要展览）周六都被关闭。

paras.en: Art Basel, one of the world’s most prestigious contemporary art fairs, opened to the public Friday, but only for the day, with the threat of unrest prompting organizers to cancel the weekend program.
paras.zh: 巴塞尔艺术展是世界上最负盛名的当代艺术博览会之一，周五向公众开放，但仅限当天，骚乱的威胁促使组织者取消周末活动。

paras.en: Student groups want 250,000 more places in higher education and an end to selection through Parcoursup, the national admissions system.
paras.zh: 学生团体希望在高等教育中增加 25 万个名额，并结束通过全国招生系统 Parcoursup 进行选拔。

paras.en: Their joint 10-point plan also calls for more teachers and repairs to schools and universities.
paras.zh: 他们的联合十点计划还要求增加教师并修复学校和大学。

paras.en: Public middle and high schools lost 15.4 million teaching hours in the 2024-25 school year because absent teachers were not replaced, according to Education Ministry figures. That amounted to 7.5% of scheduled teaching time.
paras.zh: 根据教育部的数据，公立初中和高中在 2024-25 学年因缺席教师没有得到替换而损失了 1540 万教学时。这相当于预定教学时间的 7.5%。

paras.en: Students are also seeking help with everyday costs: an extra 200 euros a month in student grants and a rent freeze in public student housing.
paras.zh: 学生们也在寻求日常费用方面的帮助：每月额外 200 欧元的学生助学金以及公共学生宿舍租金的冻结。

paras.en: “The money is now concentrated in the hands of very few people,” said Victoria Ambrosini, an art critic and art teacher at Saint-Denis University.
paras.zh: “钱现在集中在极少数人手中，”圣丹尼斯大学艺术评论家兼艺术教师维多利亚·安布罗西尼说。

articles.title: What to know about the Israeli elections as Netanyahu faces a battle for survival
articles.author: Matt Bradley

paras.en: TEL AVIV — After three years of navigating war, crisis and global outcry, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is facing one of the most significant electoral tests of his decades-long political career.
paras.zh: 特拉维夫——在经历了三年的战争、危机和全球抗议之后，以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡正面临着他数十年政治生涯中最重大的选举考验之一。

paras.en: As Israelis go to the polls on Tuesday, Netanyahu’s party is neck and neck with former Israel Defense Forces Chief of Staff Gadi Eisenkot, who has emerged as his strongest rival in a campaign that has revolved around everything from Israel’s security and military conscription to bread-and-butter issues like the economy.
paras.zh: 随着以色列人周二前往投票站，内塔尼亚胡的政党与前以色列国防军参谋长加迪·艾森科特(Gadi Eisenkot)并驾齐驱，艾森科特在一场围绕以色列安全、征兵和经济等民生问题的竞选活动中成为内塔尼亚胡最强劲的竞争对手。

paras.en: This is the first nationwide election in Israel since the Oct. 7, 2023, Hamas-led attacks, the deadliest day in the country’s history.
paras.zh: 这是以色列自 2023 年 10 月 7 日哈马斯领导的袭击以来举行的首次全国选举，这是该国历史上死亡人数最多的一天。

paras.en: The attacks, which saw 1,195 people killed and 251 taken into Gaza as hostages, triggered a major security crisis that led to three years of war on multiple fronts. There are few households in Israel that haven’t been affected in some way by the events that have played out since, leaving a sense of profound grief and insecurity that lingers across the Israeli society.
paras.zh: 这些袭击导致 1,195 人死亡，251 人被劫持到加沙作为人质，引发了一场重大安全危机，导致多条战线持续三年的战争。在以色列，几乎没有家庭没有受到此后发生的事件的某种影响，以色列社会弥漫着深深的悲伤和不安全感。

paras.en: For most Israelis, the man who has defined the continuing legacy of October 7 is Netanyahu. Many of his opponents believe he has repeatedly evaded responsibility for the intelligence failures leading up to the attacks and what is widely seen as the security forces’ inadequate response.
paras.zh: 对于大多数以色列人来说，定义 10 月 7 日事件持续遗产的人是内塔尼亚胡。他的许多反对者认为，他一再逃避导致袭击的情报失误以及普遍认为安全部队反应不力的责任。

paras.en: Bibi, as he’s commonly called, has led Israel for nearly 19 of the past 30 years, with security for many years a core part of his pitch to voters. The 77-year-old has survived political defeats before, only to come back stronger, but a groundswell of opposition could make this one of the most formidable challenges of his political career.
paras.zh: 过去 30 年里，人们普遍称呼他为“比比”，他领导以色列近 19 年，多年来，安全一直是他向选民宣传的核心内容。这位 77 岁的老人此前曾经历过政治失败，但后来却变得更加强大，但反对声音的高涨可能使这成为他政治生涯中最艰巨的挑战之一。

paras.en: The election is about more than just political survival for Netanyahu — it’s also about his personal freedom. Netanyahu is seeking re-election while also facing long-running criminal cases domestically on charges of fraud, breach of trust and bribery, allegations he has dismissed as a politically motivated witch-hunt.
paras.zh: 这次选举不仅关系到内塔尼亚胡的政治生存，还关系到他的个人自由。内塔尼亚胡正在寻求连任，同时还面临国内长期存在的欺诈、失信和贿赂等刑事案件，他将这些指控斥为出于政治动机的政治迫害。

paras.en: His grip on power affords him political privileges that have allowed him to drag out those cases, but that could change if he is voted out of power. Critics have derisively accused him of running to stay out of jail.
paras.zh: 他对权力的掌控为他提供了政治特权，使他能够拖延这些案件，但如果他被选下台，这种情况可能会改变。批评者嘲笑他竞选是为了逃避牢狱之灾。

paras.en: Netanyahu goes into the election as both the leading candidate and one of the biggest issues dividing voters. His actions before, during and after the Oct. 7 attacks have driven much of the debate.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡作为主要候选人参加选举，也是选民分歧最大的问题之一。他在 10 月 7 日袭击之前、期间和之后的行为引发了很多争论。

paras.en: Netanyahu’s opponents — particularly his strongest rival, Eisenkot, 66 — have rallied around calls for an independent commission of inquiry to investigate the attacks, which Netanyahu has opposed.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡的反对者——尤其是他最强劲的竞争对手、66 岁的艾森科特——聚集在一起呼吁成立独立调查委员会来调查这些袭击事件，但内塔尼亚胡对此表示反对。

paras.en: Various critics accuse Netanyahu of helping to keep Hamas in power in Gaza in the years before Oct. 7; of prioritizing the fight against Hamas over rescuing Israeli hostages in the wake of the attacks; and of alienating Israel from much of the world with his actions since. Last month, he threatened to sue Israeli newspaper Haaretz over a report that he had been warned about Oct. 7 ahead of time.
paras.zh: 各种批评者指责内塔尼亚胡在 10 月 7 日之前的几年里帮助哈马斯在加沙继续掌权；在袭击发生后优先考虑打击哈马斯而不是营救以色列人质；此后他的行为使以色列与世界大部分地区疏远。上个月，他威胁要起诉以色列报纸《国土报》，因为有报道称他已提前收到有关 10 月 7 日的警告。

paras.en: “This is the first chance Israelis will have to vote in what is becoming a referendum on what Netanyahu has come to represent following Oct. 7,” said Dahlia Sheindlin, an Israeli American political analyst.
paras.zh: 以色列裔美国政治分析人士达丽娅·谢因德林 (Dahlia Sheindlin) 表示，“这是以色列人第一次有机会在 10 月 7 日之后就内塔尼亚胡代表什么问题举行公投”。

paras.en: “For his supporters, he is the strong prime minister who fought back and was able to expand the war to other fronts to defend Israel,” she said. “And to his detractors or critics, people supporting parties of the opposition, he’s the prime minister who led to the failures of the government to detect or prevent Oct. 7 and has refused to take accountability for it.”
paras.zh: “对于他的支持者来说，他是一位强有力的总理，他进行了反击，并能够将战争扩大到其他战线来保卫以色列，”她说。 “对于他的诽谤者或批评者、支持反对党的人来说，他是导致政府未能发现或阻止 10 月 7 日事件的总理，并且拒绝为此承担责任。”

paras.en: Netanyahu has staunchly defended his conduct and the war in Gaza, which has left about 74,500 people dead since Oct. 7, according to figures from the Palestinian Ministry of Health. He goes into the election facing an arrest warrant from the International Criminal Court on charges of war crimes and crimes against humanity, and having vehemently rejected allegations of perpetrating a genocide from a United Nations commission.
paras.zh: 巴勒斯坦卫生部的数据显示，内塔尼亚胡坚决捍卫自己的行为和加沙战争，自 10 月 7 日以来，加沙战争已造成约 74,500 人死亡。他参加选举时面临国际刑事法院以战争罪和反人类罪指控发出的逮捕令，并强烈否认联合国委员会提出的种族灭绝指控。

paras.en: But while Israel’s conduct in Gaza has provoked strong international opposition, opinions within Israel remain highly supportive of Israel’s conflicts in Gaza, Lebanon, the West Bank and Iran, with a broad surge in support for right-wing parties and a greater emphasis on Israeli security. Eisenkot, who served in Netanyahu’s war cabinet in the opening months of the war, has criticized strategic failures and supports a long-term ceasefire. He has vowed to remove Hamas from power within 18 months of taking office.
paras.zh: 尽管以色列在加沙的行为激起了国际社会的强烈反对，但以色列内部的舆论仍然高度支持以色列在加沙、黎巴嫩、约旦河西岸和伊朗的冲突，对右翼政党的支持广泛激增，并更加重视以色列的安全。艾森科特在战争开始的几个月内曾在内塔尼亚胡的战时内阁任职，他批评了战略失败并支持长期停火。他发誓要在上任后18个月内将哈马斯赶下台。

paras.en: Palestinian-led parties, which largely enjoy support from Palestinian-Israeli citizens who make up 20% of Israel’s population, go into the election as the loudest voices calling for restraint when dealing with Palestinians in the West Bank and the Gaza Strip.
paras.zh: 巴勒斯坦领导的政党在很大程度上得到了占以色列人口20%的巴勒斯坦-以色列公民的支持，他们在选举中呼吁在处理约旦河西岸和加沙地带的巴勒斯坦人问题时保持克制。

paras.en: But Palestinian-Israeli voters in Israel will also cast votes with an eye on the rising scourge of organized crime in their communities that has caused a spike in violent deaths over the past few years.
paras.zh: 但以色列境内的巴勒斯坦裔以色列选民也将投票关注其社区中日益严重的有组织犯罪祸害，这些犯罪行为导致过去几年暴力死亡人数激增。

paras.en: The vast majority of Palestinians in the West Bank and the Gaza Strip are not Israeli citizens and are not able to vote in the election.
paras.zh: 约旦河西岸和加沙地带的绝大多数巴勒斯坦人不是以色列公民，无法在选举中投票。

paras.en: A key dividing line ahead of the election has been the compulsory conscription of the strictly orthodox Haredi Jews into the Israeli military. For generations, Israeli law has given leave to Haredi men to study scripture instead of military service, which is mandatory for other 18-year-olds. Many Israelis now want to end the exemption for a group that now accounts for nearly 15% of Israel’s population.
paras.zh: 选举前的一个关键分界线是强制将严格正统的正统派犹太人征召入以色列军队。几代人以来，以色列法律都允许正统派男性学习圣经，而不是服兵役，而服兵役对其他 18 岁的年轻人来说是强制性的。许多以色列人现在希望终止对目前占以色列人口近 15% 的群体的豁免。

paras.en: While the tumultuous events of the last few years have dominated the headlines, many Israelis also will vote on bread-and-butter issues that Americans will find familiar: education, healthcare, crime, transportation and, above all, inflation. Israel’s still-thriving tech boom has left out huge portions of the population, particularly the young, who are being squeezed by soaring prices.
paras.zh: 尽管过去几年的动荡事件占据了头条新闻，但许多以色列人也会对美国人熟悉的民生问题进行投票：教育、医疗保健、犯罪、交通，尤其是通货膨胀。以色列依然蓬勃发展的科技热潮让很大一部分人口，尤其是年轻人，受到价格飞涨的挤压。

paras.en: No one Israeli party can expect to earn a majority of the Israeli Knesset’s 120 seats — that’s never happened in Israeli history. Israel’s leadership will instead be decided by negotiations to build a governing coalition.
paras.zh: 没有任何一个以色列政党能够获得以色列议会 120 个席位的多数席位——这在以色列历史上从未发生过。相反，以色列的领导地位将通过建立执政联盟的谈判来决定。

paras.en: For much of the past few months, the two top coalitions have been neck and neck. But the latest polling by Israel’s Wala news shows Eisenkot’s party, Yashar, pushing ahead, winning 23 seats compared to Netanyahu’s Likud winning 19.
paras.zh: 在过去几个月的大部分时间里，两个最高联盟一直势均力敌。但以色列《瓦拉新闻》的最新民意调查显示，艾森科特领导的亚沙尔党领先，赢得 23 个席位，而内塔尼亚胡领导的利库德集团赢得 19 个席位。

paras.en: Behind the two front-runner parties is an alliance of two center-right former prime ministers who joined forces to form their own party called B’Yachad, or Together. The latest polls have Together winning 14 seats.
paras.zh: 这两个领跑政党的背后是两位中右翼前总理的联盟，他们联手组建了自己的政党，名为“B'Yachad”，即“团结党”。最新民意调查显示Together赢得了14个席位。

paras.en: The Democrats, the largest political party representing what remains of Israel’s leftist political current, is projected to win nine seats.
paras.zh: 代表以色列左翼政治潮流的最大政党民主党预计将赢得九个席位。

paras.en: Most of the remaining vote will go to a menagerie of smaller right-wing parties representing more niche religious and ethnic identities: Yisrael Beytenu, Otzma Yehudit, Shas, Religious Zionism and United Torah Judaism are each expected to win six to eight seats, according to Wala’s research.
paras.zh: 根据瓦拉的研究，剩下的大部分选票将投向代表更小众宗教和种族身份的一系列较小的右翼政党：以色列贝特努党、奥兹玛·耶胡迪特党、沙斯党、宗教犹太复国主义和联合托拉犹太教预计将分别赢得六到八个席位。

paras.en: Palestinian-Israeli political parties like Ra’am and the Joint List are likely to get similar numbers, but will split the Palestinian-Israeli vote.
paras.zh: 像拉姆党和联合名单这样的巴以政党可能会获得类似的支持率，但会分裂巴以选票。

paras.en: The elections for the 26th Knesset will take place on Tuesday, with 7,331,981 Israeli citizens eligible to vote, and no fewer than 35 parties running candidates.
paras.zh: 第26届以色列议会选举将于周二举行，有7,331,981名以色列公民有资格投票，不少于35个政党竞选候选人。

paras.en: Each voter will cast a ballot for one party in a nationwide poll. There are no separate geographic constituencies and voters do not cast ballots directly for named politicians — every ballot is cast only for a political party and is counted among the full national pool.
paras.zh: 每位选民将在全国范围内的民意调查中为一个政党投票。没有单独的地理选区，选民也不直接为指定的政客投票——每张选票都只投给一个政党，并计入整个全国选区。

paras.en: Polls will open at 7 a.m. at more than 12,000 polling stations across the country, mostly schools, hospitals, prisons and other public buildings. The voting places will close at 10 p.m., at which point major news outlets will release their own exit polling data as polling officials begin counting the ballots.
paras.zh: 投票将于早上 7 点在全国 12,000 多个投票站开始，其中大部分是学校、医院、监狱和其他公共建筑。投票站将于晚上 10 点关闭，届时主要新闻媒体将在投票官员开始计票时发布自己的出口民意调查数据。

paras.en: A complex vote apportioning system calculates the share of seats each party receives for its votes based on the total voter turnout. Parties that receive fewer than 3.25% of the vote will win no seats — a fate that at least two-thirds of the parties can probably expect.
paras.zh: 复杂的选票分配系统根据总投票率计算每个政党获得的席位份额。得票率低于 3.25% 的政党将不会赢得任何席位——至少三分之二的政党可能会面临这种命运。

paras.en: The official results are required to be published within eight days of the vote, though the rough seat counts should be known well before then.
paras.zh: 官方结果必须在投票后八天内公布，不过在此之前就应该知道大概的席位数。

paras.en: But even those official results will be far from the last word on who will govern. Days and maybe weeks of horse-trading will follow, as the parties jockey to form a governing coalition with support from at least 61 of the 120 elected Knesset members.
paras.zh: 但即使是这些官方结果也远不足以决定谁将执政。接下来将是几天甚至几周的讨价还价，各党派将在 120 名当选议员中至少 61 名议员的支持下争取组建执政联盟。

paras.en: This step gives outsized influence to smaller parties, which can emerge as kingmakers able to press for concessions and ministerial posts in the government and can influence which coalitions get to form a government, or even attempt to string together enough support to try and govern by themselves.
paras.zh: 这一步骤给较小的政党带来了巨大的影响力，这些政党可以成为国王拥护者，能够迫使政府让步并获得部长职位，并可以影响哪些联盟组建政府，甚至试图聚集足够的支持来尝试自己执政。

paras.en: Approximately one week after the official results are published, President Isaac Herzog will task a member of the Knesset with forming a government. Herzog can pick whichever member’s proposed coalition he finds most promising — and is not required to choose the member with the largest party or the coalition.
paras.zh: 官方结果公布大约一周后，艾萨克·赫尔佐格总统将责成一名议会成员组建政府。赫尔佐格可以选择他认为最有前途的拟议联盟成员，并且不需要选择拥有最大政党或联盟的成员。

paras.en: The member has a maximum of seven weeks to convene a ruling coalition before all lawmakers must vote on whether to accept it. That could allow for a minority government and give weaker coalitions a shot at leadership if they can rally the support of the full legislature.
paras.zh: 该成员最多有七周的时间召集执政联盟，然后所有立法者必须投票决定是否接受。如果能够获得全体立法机构的支持，这可能会允许组建一个少数派政府，并让实力较弱的联盟有机会获得领导权。

paras.en: If that member cannot form a coalition able to win majority support in the Knesset, the president appoints another member to form a coalition. If that attempt fails as well, and the Knesset remains gridlocked, the president can dissolve the Knesset, with new elections taking place within 90 days.
paras.zh: 如果该成员无法组建能够赢得议会多数支持的联盟，总统将任命另一名成员组建联盟。如果这一尝试也失败，并且议会仍陷入僵局，总统可以解散议会，并在 90 天内举行新的选举。

paras.en: Such an impasse can drag on for years: Israelis went to the polls five times during the three years between 2019 and 2022.
paras.zh: 这种僵局可能会持续数年：2019年至2022年的三年间，以色列人五次去投票站。

paras.en: The outcome of those years of electoral discord: Netanyahu, the great survivor of Israeli politics, returned to office. Next week, he will be hoping his luck has not yet run out.
paras.zh: 这些年选举不和的结果是：以色列政治的伟大幸存者内塔尼亚胡重返办公室。下周，他希望自己的运气还没有耗尽。

articles.title: How much do you know about nature's small wonders? Try our insect quiz
articles.author: Gavin McGrath

paras.en: The ABC will crown its third Australian Insect of the Year in 2026 and you get to help choose our winner.
paras.zh: ABC 将于 2026 年评选第三届澳大利亚年度昆虫，您可以帮助选出我们的获胜者。

paras.en: But how much do you really know about Australia's native bugs, beetles, bees and butterflies?
paras.zh: 但您对澳大利亚本土昆虫、甲虫、蜜蜂和蝴蝶了解多少？

paras.en: Test your knowledge with our insect quiz, produced in conjunction with the CSIRO.
paras.zh: 通过我们与 CSIRO 联合制作的昆虫测验来测试您的知识。

paras.en: Then check out our six ABC Australian Insect of the Year finalists, and vote for your favourite until the end of October.
paras.zh: 然后查看我们的六位 ABC 澳大利亚年度昆虫决赛入围者，并在 10 月底之前投票选出您最喜欢的昆虫。

articles.title: Childcare is undergoing a 'reckoning' but safety gaps remain
articles.author: Adele Ferguson, Chris Gillett, and Dylan Welch

paras.en: When Christina Spark toured Little Zak's Academy in the Sydney suburb of Gladesville early last year, it seemed like the perfect place to enrol her one-year-old.
paras.zh: 去年年初，当克里斯蒂娜·斯帕克 (Christina Spark) 参观悉尼郊区格拉兹维尔 (Gladesville) 的小扎克学院 (Little Zak's Academy) 时，那里似乎是让她一岁的孩子入学的完美场所。

paras.en: "The playground was shiny, they had soccer and yoga and swimming," she said. "I was pretty blown away and amazed."
paras.zh: “操场很闪亮，他们踢足球、瑜伽和游泳，”她说。 “我非常震惊和惊讶。”

paras.en: Within weeks, Spark started to notice hygiene issues, dietary instructions not being followed, her little boy's milk bottle coming home unused and babies sitting in soiled nappies.
paras.zh: 几周之内，斯帕克开始注意到卫生问题，没有遵守饮食说明，她小男孩的奶瓶回家时没有使用，婴儿坐在脏尿布上。

paras.en: "The underlying problem was just a lack of supervision … and not enough people," she said.
paras.zh: “根本问题是缺乏监管……而且人员不足，”她说。

paras.en: Then the incidents started to pile up. One bite turned into two and by October her child, now 19 months old, had been bitten five times.
paras.zh: 然后事件开始堆积起来。咬一口变成了咬两口，到了十月，她现在 19 个月大的孩子已经被咬了五次。

paras.en: After months of mounting concerns, Spark pulled her son out and used her skills as an auditor to dig into the centre and the chain behind it.
paras.zh: 经过几个月的担忧，斯帕克把她的儿子拉了出来，并利用她作为审计员的技能深入调查了该中心及其背后的连锁店。

paras.en: "If I just looked up who owns the centre, done a little bit of digging, realised the number of enforcement actions, realised the level of profits being generated, I wouldn't have sent him there, but I just didn't know," she said.
paras.zh: “如果我只是查一下该中心的所有者是谁，进行一些挖掘，了解执法行动的数量，了解所产生的利润水平，我就不会派他去那里，但我就是不知道，”她说。

paras.en: Little Zak's is one of the country's fastest growing childcare chains, generating $142 million in revenue and $17 million in profit in 2025.
paras.zh: Little Zak's 是美国发展最快的儿童保育连锁店之一，到 2025 年将产生 1.42 亿美元的收入和 1700 万美元的利润。

paras.en: The family-owned business also has the highest proportion of centres subject to enforcement action among the country's 26 largest long daycare operators.
paras.zh: 该家族企业在全国 26 家最大的长期日托运营商中，受到执法行动的中心比例也是最高的。

paras.en: At the Little Zak's centre at Shellharbour, two hours south of Sydney, the warning signs had been building for months.
paras.zh: 在距悉尼以南两小时车程的谢尔哈伯 (Shellharbour) 的小扎克 (Little Zak) 中心，警告标志已经竖立了几个月。

paras.en: Leigh Cotter said he initially blew off the incidents as kids being kids, but when they started to escalate, he raised concerns.
paras.zh: 利·科特 (Leigh Cotter) 表示，当他还是孩子的时候，他最初对这些事件不予理睬，但当事态开始升级时，他提出了担忧。

paras.en: "I said, 'Look, you guys really need to do something about the safety of kids, because if you don't, something serious is going to happen.'
paras.zh: “我说，‘听着，你们真的需要为孩子们​​的安全做点什么，因为如果不这样做，就会发生严重的事情。’

paras.en: "A month later, my son broke his leg in daycare, and I don't think they were completely honest about how it happened."
paras.zh: “一个月后，我儿子在日托所摔断了腿，我认为他们对事情的经过并不完全诚实。”

paras.en: Cotter said the centre told him his son was wearing socks indoors and had slipped and hit his head and left ankle just before pick-up.
paras.zh: 科特说，中心告诉他，他的儿子在室内穿着袜子，在接他之前滑倒并撞到了他的头部和左脚踝。

paras.en: When he took him to the hospital, the doctors discovered a spiral fracture on the other leg, running from his ankle towards his knee.
paras.zh: 当他带他去医院时，医生发现另一条腿上有螺旋形骨折，从脚踝一直延伸到膝盖。

paras.en: Cotter said an educator later told him his son had been screaming in another room much earlier in the day, but staff had not realised he was seriously injured.
paras.zh: 科特说，一名教育工作者后来告诉他，当天早些时候，他的儿子在另一个房间里尖叫，但工作人员并没有意识到他受了重伤。

paras.en: "Six hours of walking on a broken leg — it's child abuse," Cotter said.
paras.zh: “用断腿行走六个小时——这是虐待儿童，”科特说。

paras.en: Four Corners put the claims to Little Zak's but it did not comment for privacy reasons.
paras.zh: 四角向 Little Zak’s 提出了这一要求，但出于隐私原因，该公司没有发表评论。

paras.en: Since Cotter pulled his son from Little Zak's Shellharbour in May 2023, the centre has faced repeated parent complaints and regulatory action.
paras.zh: 自 2023 年 5 月 Cotter 将儿子从 Little Zak 的蚬壳港救出以来，该中心多次面临家长投诉和监管行动。

paras.en: In the past two years alone, it has been subject to four enforcement actions, including an emergency action notice over staffing ratios, which is the minimum number of educators legally required for the children in care.
paras.zh: 仅在过去的两年里，它就受到了四次执法行动，包括针对人员配置比例发出的紧急行动通知，这是法律规定的照顾儿童的最低教育工作者人数。

paras.en: In August, regulators issued a further compliance notice.
paras.zh: 8月份，监管机构发布了进一步的合规通知。

paras.en: The centre has also been downgraded from Meeting the National Quality Standard to Working Towards, which means it is no longer meeting the nationally agreed upon standards for child care.
paras.zh: 该中心也从符合国家质量标准降级为努力工作，这意味着它不再符合国家商定的儿童保育标准。

paras.en: Gabrielle Meagher, an emeritus professor at Macquarie University, has spent decades researching privatised social services including childcare.
paras.zh: 加布里埃尔·米格尔 (Gabrielle Meagher) 是麦格理大学 (Macquarie University) 的名誉教授，几十年来一直在研究包括儿童保育在内的私有化社会服务。

paras.en: Her analysis of the country's 26 largest long-daycare providers found the proportion of Little Zak's centres subject to enforcement action was 10 percentage points higher than the next highest, Edge Early Learning, which entered voluntary administration in August.
paras.zh: 她对全国 26 家最大的长期日托提供商的分析发现，Little Zak 中心受到执法行动的比例比第二高的 Edge Early Learning（8 月份进入自愿管理）高出 10 个百分点。

paras.en: Meagher says 56 per cent of Little Zak's centres are recorded on Starting Blocks as having been subject to enforcement action in the past two years.
paras.zh: Meagher 表示，Little Zak 中心 56% 的中心在起跑区上被记录为在过去两年中受到了执法行动。

paras.en: She says the chain has experienced rapid expansion. The family-owned company grew from 16 centres in 2021 to about 43 today.
paras.zh: 她说，该连锁店经历了快速扩张。这家家族企业从 2021 年的 16 个中心增加到如今的约 43 个。

paras.en: A deeper analysis of regulatory records reveals almost 600 confirmed breaches of Little Zak's centres by the regulator between 2020 and September 2025, with 181 of them linked to inadequate supervision, inappropriate discipline and failures to protect children from harm and hazards.
paras.zh: 对监管记录的更深入分析显示，2020 年至 2025 年 9 月期间，监管机构确认了近 600 起 Little Zak 中心违规行为，其中 181 起与监管不足、纪律不当以及未能保护儿童免受伤害和危险有关。

paras.en: At September 2025 staff turnover was 79 per cent, which is equivalent to almost eight departures for every ten employees in its average workforce over the year.
paras.zh: 截至 2025 年 9 月，员工流动率为 79%，相当于全年平均员工队伍中每 10 名员工就有近 8 名员工离职。

paras.en: But the problems uncovered at Little Zak's are not isolated.
paras.zh: 但小扎克发现的问题并不是孤立的。

paras.en: Four Corners has analysed thousands of regulatory records from across the sector, examined internal company documents, spoken to parents and educators and obtained CCTV as part of an investigation into child safety across Australia's $23 billion childcare sector.
paras.zh: 作为对澳大利亚价值 230 亿澳元的儿童保育行业儿童安全调查的一部分，四个角落分析了整个行业的数千份监管记录，检查了公司内部文件，与家长和教育工作者进行了交谈，并获得了闭路电视监控。

paras.en: It has uncovered serious failures at some major operators and examined the gaps that remain despite sweeping government reforms.
paras.zh: 它揭露了一些主要运营商的严重失败，并审查了尽管政府进行了全面改革，但仍然存在的差距。

paras.en: ABC Investigations has been uncovering systemic failures in childcare for the past 18 months.
paras.zh: 过去 18 个月，美国广播公司调查部一直在揭露儿童保育方面的系统性失败。

paras.en: Early Childhood Education Minister Jess Walsh says those stories have had a profound impact on the sector.
paras.zh: 幼儿教育部长杰西·沃尔什表示，这些故事对该行业产生了深远的影响。

paras.en: "There has been a reckoning in this system over the past 12 months, and it is changing in no small part because of the way in which you have shone a light on the problems in early learning," she said.
paras.zh: “在过去的 12 个月里，这个系统已经进行了一次清算，而且它正在发生很大的变化，因为你们对早期学习问题的揭示方式，”她说。

paras.en: The revelations have triggered a series of reforms including tougher penalties, mandatory child-safety training, a national worker register, tighter Working With Children Check requirements, greater powers for regulators and new powers to cut Commonwealth childcare subsidies to poorly performing providers.
paras.zh: 这些揭露引发了一系列改革，包括更严厉的处罚、强制性儿童安全培训、全国工人登记册、更严格的儿童工作检查要求、监管机构更大的权力以及削减对表现不佳的提供者的联邦儿童保育补贴的新权力。

paras.en: "The reforms that we have put in place are the right reforms," Walsh told Four Corners.
paras.zh: “我们实施的改革是正确的改革，”沃尔什告诉《四角》。

paras.en: "They are on track, and we are seeing the results of those reforms."
paras.zh: “他们正在步入正轨，我们正在看到这些改革的结果。”

paras.en: So far, 120 services with a history of failing to meet quality and safety standards have been put on notice to improve or risk losing access to Commonwealth subsidies. To date, funding has been withdrawn from 12.
paras.zh: 到目前为止，已有 120 项曾未能达到质量和安全标准的服务机构已收到通知，要求改进或面临失去联邦补贴的风险。迄今为止，资金已从 12 家撤回。

paras.en: More than 1,300 childcare services are currently failing to meet the national quality standards, accounting for around 48,000 childcare places. About 350 have failed twice in a row and can go on average more than three years between assessments.
paras.zh: 目前，有1300多个托儿服务机构不符合国家质量标准，约48000个托儿场所。大约有 350 人连续两次不及格，并且两次评估之间的平均时间可能超过三年。

paras.en: "Around half of the services that we have put those conditions on have turned around and have met the quality standards," Walsh said.
paras.zh: 沃尔什说：“我们提出这些条件的服务中，约有一半已经好转并达到质量标准。”

paras.en: "That is what we would like to see, but where they fail to do that or refuse to do that, we are clear that there is no place for those services in early learning."
paras.zh: “这是我们希望看到的，但如果他们未能做到这一点或拒绝这样做，我们很清楚，这些服务在早期学习中没有立足之地。”

paras.en: But a year into the funding crackdown, some big operators with regulatory issues have not been caught by it.
paras.zh: 但资金打击行动已过去一年，一些存在监管问题的大型运营商并未受到影响。

paras.en: None of Little Zak's centres are on the list, despite a regulatory record spanning dozens of centres and hundreds of confirmed breaches including failures involving supervision, staffing ratios and protecting children from harm.
paras.zh: 尽管有数十个中心的监管记录和数百起已确认的违规行为，包括监管、人员配置比例和保护儿童免受伤害方面的失败，但小扎克的中心没有一家出现在名单上。

paras.en: Little Zak's said it had restructured its executive management team, including replacing its CEO, and that its focus was the health, safety and wellbeing of children in its care.
paras.zh: Little Zak's 表示，它已经重组了执行管理团队，包括更换首席执行官，其重点是所照顾的儿童的健康、安全和福祉。

paras.en: It said notifiable incidents and compliance breaches were down following increased investment in staff training and more open communication with families.
paras.zh: 该公司表示，随着对员工培训的投资增加以及与家人更加开放的沟通，应通报的事件和合规违规行为有所减少。

paras.en: "Our focus is on quality and safety in our existing services, not on growth," it said in a statement.
paras.zh: 该公司在一份声明中表示：“我们的重点是现有服务的质量和安全，而不是增长。”

paras.en: Only About Children (OAC), which is owned by US-listed Bright Horizons, isn't on the list either. In the past two years, more than one in four of OAC's centres have been subject to enforcement action, including for inadequate supervision of children.
paras.zh: 美国上市公司 Bright Horizo​​ns 旗下的 Only About Children (OAC) 也不在名单上。在过去两年中，超过四分之一的 OAC 中心受到执法行动，包括对儿童监管不足。

paras.en: In April, OAC's Mosman centre on Sydney's north shore entered into an enforceable undertaking after a child was subjected to inappropriate conduct.
paras.zh: 4 月，OAC 位于悉尼北岸的莫斯曼中心在一名儿童遭受不当行为后签署了一项可执行承诺。

paras.en: In August, enforcement action was also taken against two OAC centres in Victoria. Brunswick West was cited for inadequate supervision and failing to protect children from harm and hazards.
paras.zh: 8 月，还对维多利亚州的两个 OAC 中心采取了执法行动。 Brunswick West 被指监管不力，未能保护儿童免受伤害和危险。

paras.en: Coonans Hill was cited for a much broader range of breaches, including inappropriate conduct, inadequate supervision, staffing arrangements, protecting children from harm and hazards, interactions with children, and safety and record-keeping requirements.
paras.zh: Coonans Hill 被指犯有更广泛的违规行为，包括不当行为、监管不足、人员安排、保护儿童免受伤害和危险、与儿童互动以及安全和记录保存要求。

paras.en: "They've got 78 services, and of them, 21 have had enforcement actions against them in the last two years, which is 27 per cent of them, more than a quarter of their services," Meagher said in September. One centre has since been closed.
paras.zh: Meagher 在 9 月份表示：“他们有 78 个服务机构，其中 21 个服务机构在过去两年中对其采取了执法行动，占其中的 27%，超过了其服务机构的四分之一。”一个中心已被关闭。

paras.en: "That's quite a high number, and it's more than twice as many as the largest not-for-profit."
paras.zh: “这是一个相当高的数字，是最大的非营利组织的两倍多。”

paras.en: The public record tells only part of the story.
paras.zh: 公开记录只讲述了故事的一部分。

paras.en: Four Corners has seen previously secret regulatory records, parent complaints and internal documents detailing thousands of incidents across its centres, including children going missing, serious injuries, failures of supervision and allegations of children being grabbed, dragged and forcibly restrained.
paras.zh: 四个角落看到了以前的秘密监管记录、家长投诉和内部文件，详细说明了中心内数千起事件，包括儿童失踪、严重受伤、监管不力以及儿童被抓住、拖拽和强行约束的指控。

paras.en: OAC's Williamstown centre in Melbourne's inner west has its own troubling history. Alleged paedophile Joshua Brown, who was committed to trial on 156 charges, worked there in 2020 and 2021, and police have since identified alleged victims from his time at the centre.
paras.zh: OAC 位于墨尔本内西区的威廉斯敦中心也有其令人不安的历史。涉嫌恋童癖者约书亚·布朗 (Joshua Brown) 因 156 项指控而受审，他曾于 2020 年和 2021 年在该中心工作，此后警方已经确认了他在该中心工作期间的受害者身份。

paras.en: In the past two years Williamstown has also faced two enforcement actions. In July, it was breached for failing to protect children from harm and hazards, as well as breaches of health, hygiene and safe food practices. In September its quality ratings were slashed from exceeding to "working towards", which means it failed to meet the national quality standards.
paras.zh: 过去两年，威廉斯敦还面临两次执法行动。今年 7 月，该法规因未能保护儿童免受伤害和危险，以及违反健康、卫生和安全食品规范而被违规。 9月份，其质量评级从“超标”下调为“正在努力”，这意味着它未能达到国家质量标准。

paras.en: The Williamstown centre is slated to close next year and its website says it isn't taking any new enrolments.
paras.zh: 威廉斯敦中心预计明年关闭，其网站称不再接受任何新的注册。

paras.en: OAC said in a statement that child safety was its highest priority, that it had a strong reporting culture and acted quickly when problems were identified.
paras.zh: OAC 在一份声明中表示，儿童安全是其最优先考虑的事项，该公司拥有强大的报告文化，并在发现问题时迅速采取行动。

paras.en: It said more than 97 per cent of services were meeting or exceeding the standards. Services facing enforcement action were down 20 per cent.
paras.zh: 报告称，97%以上的服务达到或超过标准。面临执法行动的服务下降了 20%。

paras.en: The Commonwealth has begun using its new powers against some major operators. One is Edge, which has 59 centres across Australia.
paras.zh: 英联邦已​​开始使用其新权力来对付一些主要运营商。其中之一是 Edge，它在澳大利亚设有 59 个中心。

paras.en: "We had very serious safety concerns about that provider," Walsh said. "Since then, we know that Goodstart Early Learning, which is a large quality not-for-profit provider, is in discussions with the administrator to take over some of those services. We're supporting them in that," she said.
paras.zh: 沃尔什说：“我们对该提供商存在非常严重的安全担忧。” “从那时起，我们知道 Goodstart Early Learning 是一家大型优质非营利提供商，正在与管理员讨论接管其中一些服务。我们对此表示支持，”她说。

paras.en: Walsh said the Commonwealth had also stopped two large providers from expanding until safety concerns were addressed. One was Edge. She would not name the other.
paras.zh: 沃尔什表示，联邦政府还阻止了两家大型供应商扩张，直到安全问题得到解决。其中之一是埃奇。她不愿透露对方的名字。

paras.en: While experts and advocates say the reforms will make childcare safer, they warn they won't fix the deeper structural problems in a sector dominated by for-profit operators.
paras.zh: 尽管专家和倡导者表示，这些改革将使托儿服务更加安全，但他们警告说，这些改革不会解决这个由营利性运营商主导的行业中更深层次的结构性问题。

paras.en: Georgie Dent, from parent advocacy group The Parenthood, says until the funding model is addressed, little will change.
paras.zh: 家长倡导组织 The Parenthood 的乔吉·登特 (Georgie Dent) 表示，在资助模式得到解决之前，不会有什么改变。

paras.en: "I think if we look at the money that is being spent on early education and care from taxpayers via the childcare subsidy to the tune of $16 billion a year … and you look at the out-of-pocket costs that parents are contributing, which is billions and billions of dollars, and you think for the exponential increase in investment, what are we getting?" she said.
paras.zh: “我认为，如果我们看看纳税人每年通过儿童保育补贴花费在早期教育和护理上的资金高达 160 亿美元……再看看父母所支付的自付费用，这是数十亿美元，你会想到投资的指数级增长，我们会得到什么？”她说。

paras.en: "Are we seeing better outcomes for children? Are we seeing better access? Are we seeing better quality services? The answer is no, we're not. Not at scale, not across the board."
paras.zh: “我们是否看到儿童得到更好的结果？我们是否看到更好的机会？我们是否看到更好质量的服务？答案是否定的，我们没有。不是大规模的，不是全面的。”

paras.en: She says the problem is not educators or every childcare service, but a funding model that she argues creates the wrong incentives.
paras.zh: 她说，问题不在于教育工作者或每个托儿服务机构，而在于她认为这种资助模式产生了错误的激励。

paras.en: "It means our system is not delivering on the objectives of best meeting the needs of children and enabling parents to participate in the workforce," she said.
paras.zh: “这意味着我们的系统没有实现最好地满足儿童需求和使父母能够参与劳动力市场的目标，”她说。

paras.en: "Providers have set up in areas where they can charge higher fees. They are far less likely to go and set up in a regional town."
paras.zh: “提供商已经在可以收取更高费用的地区设立了办事处。他们不太可能去偏远城镇设立办事处。”

paras.en: The Commonwealth is trying to change that. Its $1 billion Building Early Education Fund will support up to 160 new or expanded services, with a focus on not-for-profit provision in areas where childcare is scarce.
paras.zh: 英联邦正在努力改变这一现状。其 10 亿美元的早期教育建设基金将支持多达 160 项新的或扩展的服务，重点是在托儿服务匮乏的地区提供非营利性服务。
