paras.en: "We do want to see more quality not-for-profit services out there and we're backing that to happen," Walsh says.
paras.zh: 沃尔什说：“我们确实希望看到更多优质的非营利服务，我们支持这一点。”

paras.en: But in a sector plagued by childcare deserts, with one in four Australians living in areas where demand outstrips supply, rolling out 160 new or expanded centres will hardly make a difference.
paras.zh: 但在这个饱受儿童保育沙漠困扰的行业，四分之一的澳大利亚人生活在供不应求的地区，推出 160 个新的或扩建的中心几乎不会产生什么影响。

paras.en: Dent argues a much bigger shift is needed.
paras.zh: 登特认为需要做出更大的转变。

paras.en: "Over 70 per cent of long daycare in Australia is now delivered by for-profit organisations, and that has come at the expense of not-for-profit and community organisations, notwithstanding the fact we know that not-for-profit and community services tend to have higher quality ratings," she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“澳大利亚超过 70% 的长期日托服务现在是由营利性组织提供的，这是以牺牲非营利性和社区组织为代价的，尽管我们知道非营利性和社区服务往往具有更高的质量评级。”

paras.en: In Melbourne's north, parents are fighting to save Merrilands Uniting Early Learning, a not-for-profit long daycare centre that signalled it would close before the end of the year after three for-profit centres opened in the area since April.
paras.zh: 在墨尔本北部，家长们正在努力拯救Merrilands United Early Learning，这是一家非营利性的长期日托中心，自四月份以来该地区开设了三个营利性中心，该中心表示将在今年年底前关闭。

paras.en: "There are [now] six for-profit centres in the area and another one being built that's due to open next year," said one mother, Erica. Another mother, Etta, said one of the reasons she sent her child to Merrilands was that staff had been there for a long time.
paras.zh: “该地区现在有六个营利性中心，另外一个正在建设中，预计明年开放，”一位母亲艾丽卡 (Erica) 说。另一位母亲埃塔 (Etta) 表示，她把孩子送到 Merrilands 的原因之一是工作人员已经在那里待了很长时间。

paras.en: "A lot of them [have been there] decades," she said.
paras.zh: “他们中的很多人已经在那里呆了几十年了，”她说。

paras.en: "It was just full of heart. There was a lot of warmth in all the staff," said Nikolas, the father of another child.
paras.zh: “这真是充满了爱心。所有工作人员都充满了温暖，”另一个孩子的父亲尼古拉斯说。

paras.en: Non-profit childcare services operate under a different model with any surplus reinvested back into the centre. They are generally cheaper for families, employ more highly qualified staff and perform better on national quality standards. But they are losing ground as for-profit childcare expands.
paras.zh: 非营利性儿童保育服务以不同的模式运作，任何盈余都会重新投资回中心。对于家庭来说，它们通常更便宜，雇用更多高素质员工，并且在国家质量标准方面表现更好。但随着营利性托儿所的扩张，它们正在失去优势。

paras.en: One of the parents who sends their child to Merrilands, said the difference could be as much as $70 a day.
paras.zh: 一位将孩子送到 Merrilands 的家长表示，每天的差价可能高达 70 美元。

paras.en: "The financial impact is … huge," said one mother, Eman.
paras.zh: “经济影响是......巨大的，”一位母亲埃曼说。

paras.en: For Eman, however, she chose a community-run centre mainly for reasons of safety.
paras.zh: 然而，对于伊曼来说，她选择社区运营的中心主要是出于安全考虑。

paras.en: "For me, the deciding factor … was about the lower incident rate. I'm a survivor of child sexual abuse myself, so it was really important to find somewhere where my daughter will be safe," she said.
paras.zh: “对我来说，决定因素......是较低的事件发生率。我自己也是儿童性虐待的幸存者，所以找到一个让我女儿安全的地方非常重要，”她说。

paras.en: "The reforms that we're making are really putting children first. We have made child safety and wellbeing the paramount consideration in early learning as it should always have been," she said.
paras.zh: “我们正在进行的改革确实把儿童放在第一位。我们将儿童的安全和福祉作为早期学习的首要考虑因素，本来就应该如此，”她说。

paras.en: Putting children first may now be written into law. But in a sector dominated by large for-profit operators, including private equity-backed and listed companies, ensuring children come first will not be easy.
paras.zh: 将儿童放在第一位现在可能会写入法律。但在一个由大型营利性运营商（包括私募股权支持的公司和上市公司）主导的行业中，确保儿童优先并不容易。

articles.title: Parents of transgender children urge MPs to support conversion ban
articles.author: Loretta Lohberger

paras.en: Tasmanian MPs will this week debate a Greens bill that would ban conversion practices, which are any attempt to change, suppress or eradicate a person's sexual or gender identity.
paras.zh: 塔斯马尼亚议员本周将就一项绿党法案进行辩论，该法案将禁止改变性行为，即任何试图改变、压制或根除一个人的性或性别认同的行为。

paras.en: A group of 28 parents of transgender and gender diverse children has written to MPs urging them to support the ban.
paras.zh: 由 28 名跨性别和性别多样化儿童的家长组成的团体已写信给议员，敦促他们支持这项禁令。

paras.en: The parents are worried about the bill failing, or it being watered down so much that their children are not protected.
paras.zh: 家长们担心该法案会失败，或者会被淡化以致他们的孩子得不到保护。

paras.en: "Lifesaving legislation" is how Pru Peschar describes a bill to ban conversion practices in Tasmania.
paras.zh: 普鲁·佩斯查 (Pru Peschar) 将塔斯马尼亚禁止皈依习俗的法案描述为“拯救生命的立法”。

paras.en: But she and other parents of transgender and gender diverse children are worried about what might happen if the bill fails, or if it is watered down.
paras.zh: 但她和其他跨性别和性别多样化儿童的父母担心，如果该法案失败或被淡化，会发生什么。

paras.en: "It's lifesaving legislation because it's about making sure that young people and their families are getting the very best support and are not going to be harmed by any sort of intervention," Ms Peschar said.
paras.zh: 佩斯查尔女士说：“这是一项拯救生命的立法，因为它是为了确保年轻人及其家人得到最好的支持，并且不会受到任何形式的干预的伤害。”

paras.en: Conversion practices are any attempt to change, suppress or eradicate a person's sexual or gender identity.
paras.zh: 转变做法是指任何改变、压制或根除一个人的性或性别认同的尝试。

paras.en: Ms Peschar is one of 28 parents of transgender and gender diverse children who have signed a letter to Tasmanian MPs urging them to support a Greens bill that would ban conversion practices in the state.
paras.zh: 佩斯查尔女士是 28 名跨性别和性别多样化儿童的家长之一，他们签署了一封致塔斯马尼亚议员的信，敦促他们支持绿党法案，该法案将禁止该州的变性行为。

paras.en: "Conversion practices are a real and harmful threat to our children and families," the letter reads.
paras.zh: 信中写道：“皈依行为对我们的孩子和家庭来说是一个真实且有害的威胁。”

paras.en: "Much of the discussion is about same-sex attracted young people who undergo these deeply harmful practices.
paras.zh: “大部分讨论都是关于同性吸引的年轻人经历了这些极其有害的做法。

paras.en: "But very little is said about those trans and gender diverse young people who are told they are broken because of their gender identity and encouraged to undertake practices that hold out the false harmful promise they will be 'fixed'."
paras.zh: “但很少有人谈论那些跨性别和性别多样化的年轻人，他们被告知他们因为性别认同而被打破，并被鼓励采取做出虚假有害承诺的做法，他们将被‘修复’。”

paras.en: The bill is set to be debated in the House of Assembly tomorrow.
paras.zh: 该法案定于明天在众议院进行辩论。

paras.en: Don Pitcher is the father of two adult queer daughters and works with parents of transgender and gender diverse children as coordinator of the Dads for Gender Diversity Project at Engender Equality and group facilitator of Parents of LGBTIQA+ Folk at Working it Out.
paras.zh: 唐·皮彻 (Don Pitcher) 是两个成年酷儿女儿的父亲，作为 Engender Equality 性别多样性爸爸项目的协调员和 Working it Out 的 LGBTIQA+ Folk 家长小组协调员，与跨性别者和性别多样化儿童的父母一起工作。

paras.en: He said if the bill to ban conversion practices did not pass, it would send "a message to the broader community that there is something wrong or broken about trans kids that justifies and requires them to be changed or fixed".
paras.zh: 他说，如果禁止变性行为的法案没有通过，它将“向更广泛的社区发出一个信息，即跨性别儿童存在一些错误或破碎的地方，需要他们进行改变或修复”。

paras.en: "Parents with lived experience of raising trans kids know that this is not true.
paras.zh: “有抚养跨性别孩子经验的父母知道这不是真的。

paras.en: "On the other hand, supporting this bill sends an equally strong message to families that our community loves and supports them and their trans children."
paras.zh: “另一方面，支持这项法案向家庭发出了同样强烈的信息，即我们的社区热爱并支持他们和他们的跨性别儿童。”

paras.en: Leonie Crosse is a parent of a transgender child. As a youth health nurse, she also works with transgender and gender diverse young people.
paras.zh: 莱昂妮·克罗斯 (Leonie Crosse) 是一名变性儿童的父母。作为一名青年健康护士，她还与跨性别和性别多样化的年轻人一起工作。

paras.en: "We know that young people who are supported by their families and their community when they're transgender have much better mental health outcomes than those who are forced into practices which go against their authenticity and the way that they inherently are."
paras.zh: “我们知道，当年轻人变性时，得到家人和社区支持的年轻人比那些被迫采取违背其真实性和固有方式的年轻人的心理健康结果要好得多。”

paras.en: A 2022 Tasmanian Law Reform Institute report found conversion practices were still occurring in the state and made a series of recommendations to "address the risks and harms" caused by them.
paras.zh: 塔斯马尼亚法律改革研究所 2022 年的一份报告发现，该州仍在发生皈依行为，并提出了一系列建议，以“解决由此造成的风险和危害”。

paras.en: The Liberals promised to ban conversion practices, but their draft 2023 bill was criticised by LGBTQIA+ advocates and was never tabled in parliament.
paras.zh: 自由党承诺禁止皈依行为，但他们的 2023 年法案草案受到 LGBTQIA+ 倡导者的批评，并且从未提交议会审议。

paras.en: The Greens' bill has the support of Labor and independent Kristie Johnston, while independents David O'Byrne and Helen Burnet have indicated in-principle support. Health Minister Bridget Archer said she was "likely" to support it.
paras.zh: 绿党的法案得到了工党和独立人士克里斯蒂·约翰斯顿的支持，而独立人士大卫·奥伯恩和海伦·伯内特则表示原则上支持。卫生部长布里奇特·阿彻表示，她“可能”支持这一计划。

paras.en: The Liberals have been granted a conscience vote on the bill, and several — Guy Barnett, Eric Abetz, Felix Ellis, Gavin Pearce and Michael Ferguson — have said they would vote against it.
paras.zh: 自由党已获得对该法案的良心投票，盖伊·巴尼特、埃里克·阿贝茨、菲利克斯·埃利斯、加文·皮尔斯和迈克尔·弗格森等几位人士表示，他们将投票反对该法案。

paras.en: Those opposing the bill have argued it goes too far, while the Greens have said it is in line with what other states have legislated.
paras.zh: 反对该法案的人认为该法案太过分了，而绿党则表示该法案符合其他州的立法。

paras.en: The bill needs 18 votes to pass. The Greens, Labor and Ms Johnston make up 15.
paras.zh: 该法案需要 18 票才能通过。绿党、工党和约翰斯顿女士共 15 名。

paras.en: Ms Crosse said the public debate about the ban had been a difficult time.
paras.zh: 克罗斯女士表示，有关该禁令的公开辩论经历了一段艰难的时期。

paras.en: "I've had to hold the conversation and actually explain what is meant by conversion practices, which has caused some distress," she said.
paras.zh: “我不得不进行对话并实际解释皈依做法的含义，这引起了一些困扰，”她说。

paras.en: "I wish I could hide this from my child but I can't do that because they need to know the things that are going to impact them and the community that they live in."
paras.zh: “我希望我能向我的孩子隐瞒这一点，但我不能这样做，因为他们需要知道哪些事情会影响他们以及他们所居住的社区。”

paras.en: Ms Peschar said transgender and gender diverse people and their families were also contending with "anti-trans prejudice".
paras.zh: 佩斯查女士表示，跨性别者和性别多元化人士及其家人也在与“反跨性别偏见”作斗争。

paras.en: "We condemn the way the debate has been hijacked by those who want to stir up fear towards the bill by repeating misinformation and stereotypes about our children," she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“我们谴责那些想通过重复关于我们孩子的错误信息和刻板印象来煽动对该法案的恐惧的人劫持了辩论。”

paras.en: "The bill will not entrench any specific type of gender care, but will adapt to whatever the current medical guidelines are, which is a sensible and responsible approach."
paras.zh: “该法案不会巩固任何特定类型的性别关怀，但会适应当前的医疗指南，这是一种明智且负责任的做法。”

paras.en: The bill failing is not the only concern the parents have. They are also worried about what might be removed from the bill.
paras.zh: 法案失败并不是父母唯一担心的问题。他们还担心法案中可能会删除哪些内容。

paras.en: "Parents are concerned that some MPs may move to take gender identity out of the bill, removing protection for their children altogether,"
paras.zh: “家长们担心一些议员可能会将性别认同从法案中剔除，从而完全取消对孩子的保护，”

paras.en: "That would give a green light to conversion practices against trans and gender diverse Tasmanians."
paras.zh: “这将为塔斯马尼亚跨性别者和性别多元化的塔斯马尼亚人的转变行为开绿灯。”

paras.en: Victoria, New South Wales, Queensland, South Australia and the ACT have all banned conversion practices.
paras.zh: 维多利亚州、新南威尔士州、昆士兰州、南澳大利亚州和首都领地都禁止了皈依行为。

articles.title: U.S. officials accuse Canada of midterm meddling — but Trump has endorsed foreign candidates
articles.author: Darren Major

paras.en: U.S. officials accuse Canada of midterm meddling — but Trump has endorsed foreign candidates
paras.zh: 美国官员指责加拿大干预中期选举，但特朗普却支持外国候选人

paras.en: U.S. Embassy declines to comment when asked about Trump's endorsements
paras.zh: 当被问及特朗普的支持时，美国大使馆拒绝发表评论

paras.en: Despite U.S. officials repeatedly warning Canada not to get involved in the upcoming U.S. midterms, President Donald Trump has his own track record of weighing in on foreign elections.
paras.zh: 尽管美国官员一再警告加拿大不要参与即将到来的美国中期选举，但唐纳德·特朗普总统在参与外国选举方面有着自己的记录。

paras.en: Trump has endorsed about half a dozen candidates across the globe since he returned to the White House in early 2025 and even boasted earlier this year that he has "a very good record of endorsing candidates within the United States," before touting a number of foreign candidates he backed.
paras.zh: 自 2025 年初重返白宫以来，特朗普已经在全球范围内支持了大约六名候选人，甚至在今年早些时候吹嘘自己“在支持美国境内的候选人方面拥有非常好的记录”，然后又宣扬了他支持的一些外国候选人。

paras.en: "I'm not supposed to be endorsing people," Trump said during the February inaugural meeting of his Board of Peace. "As long as it works, it's OK with me."
paras.zh: “我不应该支持别人，”特朗普在和平委员会二月份的首次会议上说道。 “只要有效，我就OK。”

paras.en: Since early 2025, Trump has backed presidential or prime ministerial candidates in Poland, Honduras, Colombia and Japan.
paras.zh: 自2025年初以来，特朗普已支持波兰、洪都拉斯、哥伦比亚和日本的总统或总理候选人。

paras.en: Most recently, he voiced support for Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, who is facing an election on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 最近，他表达了对周二面临选举的以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡的支持。

paras.en: The U.S. president also put his support behind former Hungarian prime minister Viktor Orbán's failed re-election bid, which included Vice-President JD Vance appearing at a rally in Budapest.
paras.zh: 美国总统还支持匈牙利前总理维克托·欧尔班失败的连任竞选，其中包括副总统万斯出现在布达佩斯的一次集会上。

paras.en: Trump also weighed in to last year's midterms in Argentina, suggesting that a financial support package would hinge on a good result for President Javier Milei's party.
paras.zh: 特朗普还对阿根廷去年的中期选举发表了看法，暗示财政支持计划将取决于总统哈维尔·米莱(Javier Milei)所在政党的良好结果。

paras.en: Daniel Drezner, a professor of international politics at Tufts University in Massachusetts, said U.S. officials suggesting Canada is interfering in the midterms is a situation of the "pot calling the kettle black," given Trump's track record.
paras.zh: 马萨诸塞州塔夫茨大学国际政治学教授丹尼尔·德雷兹纳表示，考虑到特朗普的以往记录，美国官员暗示加拿大干预中期选举，这是一种“锅自相矛盾”的情况。

paras.en: "The truth is that this administration has had a long track record of intervening directly into the elections of official allies," he told CBC News in an interview.
paras.zh: 他在接受加拿大广播公司新闻采访时表示：“事实是，本届政府在直接干预官方盟友选举方面有着长期的记录。”

paras.en: The U.S. Embassy in Ottawa released a "fact sheet" on Wednesday pointing to instances that could amount to "potential interference in U.S. elections" after Prime Minister Mark Carney and other Canadian politicians dismissed previous suggestions that Canadian officials are trying to influence the vote outcome on Nov. 3.
paras.zh: 美国驻渥太华大使馆周三发布了一份“情况说明书”，指出了可能构成“潜在干预美国选举”的情况，此前加拿大总理马克·卡尼和其他加拿大政界人士驳斥了此前有关加拿大官员试图影响 11 月 3 日投票结果的说法。

paras.en: The embassy's release pointed to Liberal MP Anthony Housefather canvassing for a Florida Democrat, whom he's said is a friend, during a primary vote earlier this year and comments made by Industry Minister Mélanie Joly regarding Canada's counter-tariff strategy, some going back to March 2025 when she was in charge of foreign affairs.
paras.zh: 大使馆的消息指出，自由党议员安东尼·豪斯费瑟(Anthony Housefather)在今年早些时候的初选期间为一位佛罗里达州民主党人拉票，自称是他的朋友，以及工业部长梅兰妮·乔利(Mélanie Joly)就加拿大反关税战略发表的评论，其中一些评论可以追溯到2025年3月，当时她负责外交事务。

paras.en: The embassy's list also included the Ontario government's now infamous Ronald Reagan ad that ran in the U.S. last year and a federal government billboard campaign from early 2025.
paras.zh: 大使馆的名单还包括安大略省政府去年在美国投放的现已臭名昭著的罗纳德·里根广告，以及从 2025 年初开始的联邦政府广告牌活动。

paras.en: In an exclusive interview with Rosemary Barton Live, former U.S. ambassador to Canada James Blanchard said the administration has "no credibility" given Trump's list of public endorsements.
paras.zh: 美国前驻加拿大大使詹姆斯·布兰查德在接受罗斯玛丽·巴顿现场专访时表示，鉴于特朗普的公开支持名单，政府“没有可信度”。

paras.en: "If this accusation had come from the Reagan administration or the Bush administration or the Obama administration, the Clinton administration, I would take it seriously," Blanchard said. "But I can't from this current administration."
paras.zh: “如果这项指控来自里根政府、布什政府、奥巴马政府、克林顿政府，我会认真对待，”布兰查德说。 “但我不能从本届政府那里得到。”

paras.en: CBC News reached out to the U.S. Embassy in Ottawa and pointed out Trump's track record of endorsing foreign candidates. The embassy declined to comment when asked if a Canadian official offering a similar endorsement to a midterm candidate would amount to potential election interference.
paras.zh: 加拿大广播公司新闻联系了美国驻渥太华大使馆，并指出了特朗普支持外国候选人的记录。当被问及加拿大官员向中期候选人提供类似支持是否构成潜在的选举干扰时，大使馆拒绝发表评论。

paras.en: Trump also jumped into the Canadian political fray during the 2025 campaign, writing on social media that he'd "rather deal with a liberal than a conservative."
paras.zh: 特朗普还在 2025 年竞选期间加入了加拿大的政治纷争，他在社交媒体上写道，他“宁愿与自由派打交道，也不愿与保守派打交道”。

paras.en: The current president is not the only notable U.S. politician to talk Canadian electoral politics during a campaign. Former president Barack Obama publicly endorsed former prime minister Justin Trudeau in 2019 and 2021, albeit after he had left the White House. Sen. Bernie Sanders also backed former NDP leader Jagmeet Singh in the 2021 campaign.
paras.zh: 现任总统并不是唯一一位在竞选期间谈论加拿大选举政治的著名美国政治家。前总统巴拉克·奥巴马 (Barack Obama) 在 2019 年和 2021 年公开支持前总理贾斯汀·特鲁多 (Justin Trudeau)，尽管是在他离开白宫之后。参议员伯尼·桑德斯 (Bernie Sanders) 也在 2021 年竞选中支持前新民主党领导人驵勉诚 (Jagmeet Singh)。

paras.en: Drezner said those examples are different from Trump's endorsements because neither were a part of the executive branch at the time. He pointed out that typically it's the norm for heads of states or heads of government not to weigh in on foreign elections.
paras.zh: 德雷兹纳表示，这些例子与特朗普的支持不同，因为当时两者都不属于行政部门。他指出，国家元首或政府首脑不参与外国选举通常是常态。

paras.en: "The idea was that surely you can do business with whoever wins and you might have to do business with whichever party wins. So therefore you shouldn't be seen as campaigning overtly for one side or another," he said.
paras.zh: “我们的想法是，无论谁获胜，你都可以与他们做生意，而且你可能必须与获胜的政党做生意。因此，你不应该被视为公开为某一方竞选，”他说。

paras.en: Trump officials also appeared to take an interest in the recent Alberta referendum. U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said in January that Alberta would make a "natural partner" for the U.S. while discussing the possibility of a separation referendum.
paras.zh: 特朗普官员似乎也对最近的艾伯塔省公投感兴趣。美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特 (Scott Bessent) 一月份在讨论分离公投的可能性时表示，阿尔伯塔省将成为美国的“天然合作伙伴”。

paras.en: The Globe and Mail reported recently that Republican political operatives were on the ground in Alberta earlier this year to help the separatist campaign. CBC News previously reported that Alberta separatists also attended meetings in U.S. State Department offices in Washington, D.C., last year.
paras.zh: 《环球邮报》最近报道称，共和党政治人员今年早些时候在阿尔伯塔省实地帮助分离主义运动。加拿大广播公司新闻此前报道称，艾伯塔省分离主义者去年也出席了美国国务院在华盛顿特区办公室举行的会议。

paras.en: The U.S. Embassy's list came after Ambassador Pete Hoekstra and Trump adviser Peter Navarro warned against Canada getting involved in the midterms.
paras.zh: 美国大使馆的名单是在皮特·霍克斯特拉大使和特朗普顾问彼得·纳瓦罗警告加拿大不要参与中期选举之后发布的。

paras.en: Carney and other government officials have pushed back on the suggestion that Canada is looking to interfere.
paras.zh: 卡尼和其他政府官员反驳了加拿大寻求干预的说法。

paras.en: "There is no merit to these claims, so I'll call it out that way," Carney told reporters during a news conference in Istanbul on Friday.
paras.zh: 卡尼周五在伊斯坦布尔举行的新闻发布会上对记者表示：“这些说法没有任何道理，所以我会这样说。”

paras.en: "I'm disappointed that their envoy sees that as his role, to make these suggestions," the prime minister said of Hoekstra in particular.
paras.zh: “我很失望他们的特使认为这是他的职责，提出这些建议，”总理特别谈到霍克斯特拉时说道。

paras.en: While Drezner said Housefather's canvassing for a candidate might be "slightly unusual," other instances the embassy mentioned — like Joly and Bernadette Jordan, Canada's consul general in Boston, meeting with American politicians — amounts to "garden variety diplomacy."
paras.zh: 虽然德雷兹纳表示，豪斯父亲为候选人拉票可能“有点不寻常”，但大使馆提到的其他例子——比如加拿大驻波士顿总领事乔利和伯纳黛特·乔丹与美国政界人士会面——相当于“普通外交”。

paras.en: Joly herself has pushed back against the accusations saying she has met with Republicans and Democrats in recent months.
paras.zh: 乔莉本人反驳了这些指控，称她近几个月来会见了共和党人和民主党人。

paras.en: The trade war has become a pressure point on Republican candidates in border states like Michigan and Maine.
paras.zh: 贸易战已成为密歇根州和缅因州等边境州共和党候选人的压力点。

paras.en: Republican Sen. Susan Collins, who has represented Maine since 1997 and has tried to distance herself from Trump's tariffs, said Friday that she "secured" some exemptions to those levies.
paras.zh: 自 1997 年以来一直代表缅因州并试图与特朗普关税保持距离的共和党参议员苏珊·柯林斯 (Susan Collins) 周五表示，她“确保”了这些关税的部分豁免。

paras.en: "I will continue working directly with administration officials to seek additional relief and encourage a broader trade agreement with Canada, our neighbour, ally and largest trading partner," she said in a social media post.
paras.zh: 她在社交媒体帖子中表示：“我将继续与政府官员直接合作，寻求更多救济，并鼓励与我们的邻国、盟友和最大贸易伙伴加拿大达成更广泛的贸易协定。”

paras.en: The Republican candidate for Michigan's open Senate seat released a 30-second ad criticizing tariffs earlier this month.
paras.zh: 本月早些时候，密歇根州参议院空缺席位的共和党候选人发布了一段 30 秒的广告，批评关税。

paras.en: "Here in Michigan we know that Canada is not our enemy. We need to end this tariff war now," Mike Rogers says in the ad.
paras.zh: “在密歇根州，我们知道加拿大不是我们的敌人。我们现在需要结束这场关税战，”迈克·罗杰斯在广告中说道。

paras.en: Drezner said he could "easily see" a situation where the Trump administration blames bad midterm results on Canada.
paras.zh: 德雷兹纳表示，他“很容易看到”特朗普政府将糟糕的中期结果归咎于加拿大的情况。

paras.en: "They're going to blame anyone and everyone. That is the modus operandi of this White House," he said.
paras.zh: “他们会责怪任何人。这就是本届白宫的作案手法，”他说。

paras.en: When asked on Friday if the Trump administration might blame Canada for a poor midterm result and slap more tariffs on Canadian exports, the prime minister said he doesn't "see that coming to pass."
paras.zh: 周五，当被问及特朗普政府是否会因中期选举结果不佳而归咎于加拿大并对加拿大出口产品征收更多关税时，总理表示，他“认为这种情况不会发生”。

paras.en: With files from The Canadian Press and Reuters
paras.zh: 来自加拿大新闻社和路透社的文件

articles.title: Jordan arrests 3 suspects in deadly church attack after gunbattle

paras.en: Jordan arrests 3 suspects in deadly church attack after gunbattle
paras.zh: 约旦在枪战后逮捕了致命教堂袭击事件中的 3 名嫌疑人

paras.en: Suspects found hiding in abandoned house, appear to not have additional ties, official says
paras.zh: 官员称，嫌疑人被发现躲藏在废弃房屋中，似乎没有其他联系

paras.en: Jordanian security forces arrested two brothers and their brother-in-law after a shootout on Monday over a church attack that killed nine people, and the suspects appear to have no ties to other terrorist cells, senior government security officials said.
paras.zh: 政府高级安全官员表示，周一，约旦安全部队因教堂袭击事件发生枪战，导致九人死亡，随后逮捕了两兄弟和他们的妹夫，嫌疑人似乎与其他恐怖组织没有联系。

paras.en: "God willing, they only represent themselves," said Maj.-Gen. Obeidallah al-Maaytah, Jordan's director of public security.
paras.zh: “上帝保佑，他们只代表他们自己，”少将说。奥贝达拉·迈塔 (Obeidallah al-Maaytah)，约旦公共安全总监。

paras.en: Jordan, a relatively stable U.S. ally in the Middle East, and Friday's attack on the Christian minority prompted King Abdullah to order security forces to respond with an "iron fist."
paras.zh: 约旦是美国在中东相对稳定的盟友，周五对基督教少数群体的袭击促使阿卜杜拉国王命令安全部队以“铁拳”回应。

paras.en: In a press conference, al-Maaytah and Interior Minister Mazen al-Faraya said the country would not tolerate extremist terrorism.
paras.zh: 迈塔和内政部长马赞·法拉亚在新闻发布会上表示，该国不会容忍极端主义恐怖主义。

paras.en: "The file has not yet been closed; investigations are still ongoing. As of today, there are no indications of any links between them and other cells," al-Faraya added.
paras.zh: 法拉亚补充说：“该案卷尚未结案；调查仍在进行中。截至今天，没有迹象表明他们与其他组织之间有任何联系。”

paras.en: A building shows signs of gunfire at the site where Jordanian security forces arrested three suspects in connection with Friday's shooting. (Alaa Al Sukhni/Reuters)
paras.zh: 约旦安全部队逮捕了与周五枪击事件有关的三名嫌疑人的现场，一栋建筑显示出枪声。 （阿拉·阿尔·苏赫尼/路透社）

paras.en: Friday's attack during a funeral at a Greek Orthodox church in the village of Hamoud, in Karak governorate, about 120 kilometres southwest of the capital of Amman, also wounded 40 others. Witnesses said the shooting lasted several minutes.
paras.zh: 周五，位于首都安曼西南约 120 公里处的卡拉克省哈穆德村的一座希腊东正教教堂举行葬礼时发生袭击，造成 40 人受伤。目击者称枪击持续了几分钟。

paras.en: Jordan's Public Security Directorate said the suspects were located while hiding in an abandoned house in Karak. They refused to surrender and attacked security forces, who returned fire and arrested all three after wounding them, the directorate said in a statement published on state media.
paras.zh: 约旦公共安全局表示，嫌疑人是在卡拉克一栋废弃房屋中藏身时被发现的。该局在官方媒体上发表的一份声明中表示，他们拒绝投降并袭击了安全部队，安全部队击伤三人后还击并逮捕了他们。

paras.en: No security personnel were injured, it said, and a number of firearms and ammunition were found in the suspects' possession.
paras.zh: 报告称，没有安全人员受伤，并在嫌疑人身上发现了一些枪支和弹药。

paras.en: Mourners gather around a grave as the flag-draped coffin of a victim killed in an attack on a Greek Orthodox church is lowered for burial during a funeral in Karak, Jordan on Sunday. (Raad Adayleh/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 周日，在约旦卡拉克举行的葬礼上，哀悼者聚集在一座坟墓周围，在希腊东正教教堂袭击事件中丧生的一名受害者的覆盖着旗帜的棺材被降下埋葬。 （拉德·阿达勒/美联社）

paras.en: Jordanian authorities have said the violence was carried out by "extremist terrorists." There has been no claim of responsibility.
paras.zh: 约旦当局表示，暴力事件是由“极端主义恐怖分子”实施的。目前尚未有人声称对此事负责。

paras.en: The Public Security Directorate did not name the suspects or publicly identify possible affiliations with any Islamist militant groups.
paras.zh: 公安局没有透露嫌疑人的名字，也没有公开指出他们可能与任何伊斯兰激进组织有联系。

paras.en: Al-Faraya said authorities were reviewing the circumstances that led young people toward extremism and would hold accountable anyone found to have participated in the attack.
paras.zh: 法拉亚表示，当局正在审查导致年轻人走向极端主义的情况，并将追究任何被发现参与袭击的人的责任。

articles.title: Anthropic files for potentially biggest IPO ever, even as CEO warns of AI risks to humanity

paras.en: Anthropic files for potentially biggest IPO ever, even as CEO warns of AI risks to humanity
paras.zh: 尽管首席执行官警告人工智能对人类构成风险，Anthropic仍申请有史以来规模最大的IPO

paras.en: Anthropic could be biggest-ever initial public sale of stock, raising as much as $100B US, reports say
paras.zh: 据报道，Anthropic 可能是有史以来规模最大的股票首次公开发行，筹集资金高达 $100B US

paras.en: Artificial intelligence giant Anthropic filed papers Monday for what could be the biggest initial public offering of stock ever, even as its top executive warns that advanced AI could pose an existential threat to humanity.
paras.zh: 人工智能巨头 Anthropic 周一提交了可能是有史以来规模最大的首次公开募股文件，尽管该公司的高管警告说先进的人工智能可能对人类构成生存威胁。

paras.en: The filing sets up the San Francisco company for a Wall Street debut next month, potentially eclipsing the SpaceX initial public offering in June that raised a record $86 billion US. An Anthropic IPO would also put the company ahead of OpenAI in going public in what is expected to be a pair of blockbuster stock debuts for the rival AI labs.
paras.zh: 该文件规定这家位于旧金山的公司将于下个月在华尔街首次亮相，这可能会超过 SpaceX 6 月份首次公开募股 (IPO)，后者筹集了创纪录的 860 亿美元资金。 Anthropic 的 IPO 也将使该公司领先于 OpenAI 上市，预计这两家竞争对手的人工智能实验室将迎来两轮重磅上市。

paras.en: The filing comes weeks after CEO Dario Amodei argued in an essay for slowing the development of the most advanced AI models.
paras.zh: 几周前，首席执行官达里奥·阿莫迪 (Dario Amodei) 在一篇文章中主张减缓最先进人工智能模型的开发。

paras.en: Earnest Wong, a portfolio manager and head of research at Toronto-based Baskin Wealth Management, says it's surprising how little of this warning was reflected in Anthropic's new prospectus.
paras.zh: 总部位于多伦多的 Baskin Wealth Management 的投资组合经理兼研究主管 Earnest Wong 表示，令人惊讶的是，Anthropic 的新招股说明书中几乎没有反映这一警告。

paras.en: "Most of the risks are kind of just normal, vanilla legal disclosures that are included in most companies," Wong told CBC News on Monday.
paras.zh: “大多数风险都是正常的，大多数公司都会进行普通的法律披露，”黄周一告诉加拿大广播公司新闻。

paras.en: An IPO could provide Anthropic with enormous resources to accelerate its expansion. The amount the company ultimately raises remains uncertain, as do its final valuation and offering price, but even at lower estimates, it would turn the five-year-old startup into one of the world's most valuable companies and potentially boost the wealth of Amodei and his sister and co-founder, Daniela, by billions of dollars.
paras.zh: 首次公开募股可以为 Anthropic 提供巨大的资源来加速其扩张。该公司最终筹集的金额以及最终估值和发行价格仍不确定，但即使按照较低的估计，这家成立五年的初创公司也将成为世界上最有价值的公司之一，并有可能使阿莫迪和他的妹妹兼联合创始人丹妮拉的财富增加数十亿美元。

paras.en: The 335-page document showed Anthropic's revenue is growing rapidly, but like many other tech companies going public, it has yet to turn a profit. The company behind the chatbot Claude reported a net loss of $80.7 billion US in the first half of 2026. That compares to a loss of $13 billion in the same period a year earlier.
paras.zh: 这份长达 335 页的文件显示，Anthropic 的收入正在快速增长，但与许多其他上市科技公司一样，它尚未实现盈利。聊天机器人 Claude 背后的公司报告称，2026 年上半年净亏损 807 亿美元。而去年同期亏损 130 亿美元。

paras.en: A view of 500 Howard Street in San Francisco, which is the address of Anthropic headquarters. (Jeff Chiu/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 旧金山霍华德街 500 号的景观，这里是 Anthropic 总部的地址。 （杰夫·邱/美联社）

paras.en: Despite the losses, Anthropic, valued earlier this year at $965 billion US by private investors, is reportedly set to see that value rise to $1.5 trillion US or possibly $2 trillion US, although its final valuation has not been established. At $1.5 trillion US, Anthropic would rank among the world's most valuable public companies, alongside Tesla.
paras.zh: 尽管出现了亏损，今年早些时候私人投资者对 Anthropic 的估值为 9650 亿美元，但据报道，该公司的估值预计将升至 1.5 万亿美元，甚至可能达到 2 万亿美元，尽管其最终估值尚未确定。 Anthropic 将以 1.5 万亿美元的市值与特斯拉并列全球最有价值的上市公司之一。

paras.en: "You can quibble about whether $1.5 trillion US or $2 trillion US … is the correct valuation, but there's no doubt that this is a large company that is a force to be dealt with," Wong said.
paras.zh: “你可以争论 1.5 万亿美元还是 2 万亿美元……是否是正确的估值，但毫无疑问，这是一家需要应对的大公司，”黄说。

paras.en: As for money raised, the offering could bring in as much as $100 billion US, according to reports, surpassing the current record set by another one of Musk's companies, SpaceX, earlier this year.
paras.zh: 据报道，此次发行筹集的资金可能高达 1000 亿美元，超过了马斯克旗下另一家公司 SpaceX 今年早些时候创下的目前纪录。

paras.en: In a regulatory filing, Anthropic said it will list its stock on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the ticker symbol "ANT."
paras.zh: Anthropic 在一份监管​​文件中表示，其股票将在纳斯达克全球精选市场上市，股票代码为“ANT”。

paras.en: - What happens when a Google data centre comes to town? Southern India is finding out
paras.zh: - 当谷歌数据中心来到城镇时会发生什么？印度南部正在发现

paras.en: - AI 'slop' is dominating menus, as some restaurant owners turn to it to save time and money
paras.zh: - 人工智能“slop”在菜单中占据主导地位，一些餐厅老板转向它来节省时间和金钱

paras.en: Risks aplenty, but big payoff to founders
paras.zh: 风险很大，但创始人回报丰厚

paras.en: In the filing, the company said it could use some of that money on acquiring other businesses and technology, as well as investing in infrastructure to grow its business to take on rivals.
paras.zh: 该公司在文件中表示，可以将部分资金用于收购其他业务和技术，以及投资基础设施以发展业务，与竞争对手抗衡。

paras.en: Formed in 2021 by ex-OpenAI leaders, Anthropic is locked in a fight for dominance with that company; the two leaders, Amodei and OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, are widely seen as bitter rivals.
paras.zh: Anthropic 由 OpenAI 前领导人于 2021 年成立，目前正与该公司争夺主导地位。 Amodei 和 OpenAI 首席执行官 Sam Altman 这两位领导者被广泛视为死对头。

paras.en: But they have plenty of other competitors, including Google, newer startups in the U.S. and China, and Musk's SpaceX , which has an AI business. Anthropic, OpenAI and SpaceX's AI division have all been losing more money than they make because of the huge costs in resources in building AI, fuelling concerns of a bubble.
paras.zh: 但他们还有很多其他竞争对手，包括谷歌、美国和中国的新兴初创公司，以及拥有人工智能业务的马斯克的 SpaceX。由于构建人工智能所需的巨大资源成本，Anthropic、OpenAI 和 SpaceX 的人工智能部门的亏损都超过了盈利，引发了人们对泡沫的担忧。

paras.en: The IPO would help cover any cash shortfall, as well as shower extraordinary wealth on Anthropic's seven founders, including Amodei and his sister. Collectively they own nearly 500 million shares, though it's unclear from the offering document how much that will represent of the company after the IPO.
paras.zh: 此次首次公开募股将有助于弥补现金短缺，并为 Anthropic 的七位创始人（包括阿莫迪和他的妹妹）带来非凡的财富。他们总共拥有近 5 亿股股票，尽管从发行文件中并不清楚这些股票在 IPO 后将代表公司的多少。

paras.en: Dario, 43, and 39-year-old Daniela, who is Anthropic's president, are worth $15.5 billion US each, according to Forbes, which ranks them as the 176th and 177th richest people in the world.
paras.zh: 据《福布斯》报道，43 岁的达里奥和 39 岁的 Anthropic 总裁丹妮拉的身价分别为 155 亿美元，在全球富豪榜上排名第 176 和第 177 位。

paras.en: The filing also listed a host of risks for Anthropic, ranging from not being able to retain key staff, navigate regulatory roadblocks and secure enough compute power to run its AI systems.
paras.zh: 该文件还列出了Anthropic面临的一系列风险，包括无法留住关键员工、避开监管障碍以及确保足够的计算能力来运行其人工智能系统。

paras.en: But the standout was that its AI models could "pose catastrophic or existential risks to humanity."
paras.zh: 但最引人注目的是，其人工智能模型可能“给人类带来灾难性或生存风险”。

paras.en: The IPO comes as worries about AI grow inside and outside the industry and reports continue to emerge about increasingly powerful systems that solve problems beyond human capacity but could also go rogue and carry out other, more harmful tasks.
paras.zh: 此次首次公开募股正值行业内外对人工智能的担忧日益加剧，并且不断有报道称，越来越强大的系统可以解决超出人类能力的问题，但也可能失控并执行其他更有害的任务。

paras.en: In September, Amodei said the AI industry should slow its fast-moving development to give safety measures time to catch up. Without such a slowdown, Amodei warned AI could be capable of letting loose a swarm of agents that could take over the entire internet within six to 12 months.
paras.zh: 9 月，阿莫迪表示，人工智能行业应该放慢快速发展的步伐，以便安全措施有时间跟上。阿莫迪警告说，如果没有这样的放缓，人工智能可能会释放出一大群代理，这些代理可能会在 6 到 12 个月内接管整个互联网。

paras.en: He offered a plan in a post on his website to increase checks on the industry, noting that Anthropic is already undertaking part of this on its own. As for other steps, though, he said that would require co-ordination across the industry and with governments around the world, including authoritarian ones.
paras.zh: 他在其网站上的一篇文章中提出了一项计划，以加强对该行业的检查，并指出 Anthropic 已经自己承担了部分工作。不过，至于其他步骤，他表示这需要整个行业以及与世界各地政府（包括独裁政府）的协调。

paras.en: "I believe that if slowing down bought us even an extra year or two before models reach critical levels of capability, and we used that time to advance alignment, we could greatly reduce the risk that something goes seriously wrong," Amodei wrote.
paras.zh: 阿莫迪写道：“我相信，如果放慢速度，让我们在模型达到关键能力水平之前多花一两年的时间，并且我们利用这段时间来推进调整，我们就可以大大降低出现严重错误的风险。”

paras.en: Anthropic has tried to set itself apart from other AI companies as the "good guys," focusing on safety and responsible development, as opposed to growing at all costs and with few guardrails.
paras.zh: Anthropic 试图将自己与其他人工智能公司区分开来，成为“好人”，专注于安全和负责任的开发，而不是不惜一切代价、几乎没有护栏的增长。

paras.en: Some of this sentiment stems from the company's dispute with the U.S. government , which broke out in February when President Donald Trump and Secretary of War Pete Hegseth accused Anthropic of endangering national security and designated the company a supply chain risk.
paras.zh: 这种情绪部分源于该公司与美国政府的争端，该争端于 2 月份爆发，当时唐纳德·特朗普总统和战争部长皮特·赫格斯指责 Anthropic 危害国家安全，并将该公司列为供应链风险。

paras.en: - AI company Anthropic amends core safety principle amid growing competition in sector
paras.zh: - 人工智能公司 Anthropic 在行业竞争日益激烈的情况下修改了核心安全原则

paras.en: - Analysis Trump claims AI poses no real risk — but even some of his allies disagree
paras.zh: - 分析特朗普声称人工智能不会带来真正的风险 - 但即使是他的一些盟友也不同意

paras.en: - Trump decries critics of AI, saying they're 'negative forces' with exaggerated concerns
paras.zh: - 特朗普谴责人工智能的批评者，称他们是“负面力量”，夸大了担忧

paras.en: Anthropic sued the Pentagon over the designation in March for what it called an "unlawful campaign of retaliation" over its refusal to allow unrestricted military use of its technology. The legal challenge intensified an unusually public dispute over how AI can be used in warfare and mass surveillance.
paras.zh: 今年三月，Anthropic 就这一指定起诉五角大楼，称其为五角大楼拒绝允许无限制地将其技术用于军事目的的“非法报复行动”。这一法律挑战加剧了关于人工智能如何用于战争和大规模监视的异常公开的争议。

paras.en: ChatGPT maker OpenAI made its own deal to work with the Pentagon hours after the government punished Anthropic for its stance. Anthropic also filed a separate, narrower case involving a different rule the Pentagon is using to try to declare Anthropic a supply chain risk.
paras.zh: 在政府惩罚 Anthropic 的立场几小时后，ChatGPT 制造商 OpenAI 与五角大楼达成了合作协议。 Anthropic 还提起了另一起规模较小的案件，涉及五角大楼试图宣布 Anthropic 存在供应链风险的不同规则。

paras.en: A California judge ruled in Anthropic's favour in the first case and a Washington, D.C., judge sided with the government in the second. Both sides are appealing the decisions.
paras.zh: 加利福尼亚州的一名法官在第一个案件中做出了对人类有利的裁决，而华盛顿特区的一名法官在第二个案件中站在了政府一边。双方都对这些决定提出上诉。

articles.title: Venezuelan opposition leader Machado returns from exile

paras.en: Venezuela's opposition leader Maria Corina Machado was greeted by thousands of cheering supporters in Caracas on Sunday after returning from nearly a year in exile.
paras.zh: 周日，委内瑞拉反对派领导人玛丽亚·科里纳·马查多在结束近一年的流亡归来后，在加拉加斯受到了数千名欢呼的支持者的欢迎。

paras.en: Her supporters stood along highways, toll plazas and city streets waving Venezuelan flags and chanting slogans like "freedom" as Machado made her way in a convoy of cars and motorcycles to the capital, Caracas.
paras.zh: 当马查多乘坐汽车和摩托车车队前往首都加拉加斯时，她的支持者站在高速公路、收费站和城市街道上，挥舞着委内瑞拉国旗，高呼“自由”等口号。

paras.en: Wearing her trademark white T-shirt and blue jeans, she leaned out of the sunroof and shouted "this country is giving lessons to everyone" as her convoy entered the capital.
paras.zh: 当她的车队进入首都时，她穿着她标志性的白色T恤和蓝色牛仔裤，从天窗探出身子，大喊“这个国家正在给每个人上教训”。

paras.en: In Guacara earlier, the AFP news agency reported seeing Machado singing the national anthem in a plaza packed with supporters, waving flags and cheering her return.
paras.zh: 早些时候，法新社报道在瓜卡拉，看到马查多在挤满支持者的广场上唱国歌，挥舞旗帜为她的回归欢呼。

paras.en: Machado left Venezuela last December to receive the Nobel Peace Prize for her work in promoting democracy in autocratic Venezuela.
paras.zh: 马查多去年 12 月离开委内瑞拉，因其在专制委内瑞拉促进民主方面的工作而获得诺贝尔和平奖。

paras.en: Facing arrest by the regime of former President Nicolas Maduro, she sought refuge in the Argentine embassy in Caracas and was smuggled out of the country with assistance from the United States.
paras.zh: 面对前总统尼古拉斯·马杜罗政权的逮捕，她在阿根廷驻加拉加斯大使馆寻求庇护，并在美国的协助下被偷运出境。

paras.en: At first she was unable to return for fear of detention by authorities.
paras.zh: 起初，她因害怕被当局拘留而无法返回。

paras.en: After the US-led ouster and arrest of Maduro, she gave her Nobel medal to US President Donald Trump.
paras.zh: 在美国领导下台并逮捕马杜罗后，她将诺贝尔奖章授予美国总统唐纳德·特朗普。

paras.en: However, her inability to return to Venezuela for so long was partly due to the Trump administration.
paras.zh: 然而，她这么长时间无法返回委内瑞拉，部分原因是特朗普政府。

paras.en: Instead of backing Machado, Washington decided to support interim President Delcy Rodriguez.
paras.zh: 华盛顿没有支持马查多，而是决定支持临时总统德尔西·罗德里格斯。

paras.en: Machado has said she faced travel restrictions and flight cancellations, partly due to Trump's worries that her presence in Venezuela could inflame tensions during a period of transition, and partly due to Rodriguez' interference.
paras.zh: 马查多表示，她面临旅行限制和航班取消，部分原因是特朗普担心她在委内瑞拉的存在可能会加剧过渡时期的紧张局势，部分原因是罗德里格斯的干涉。

paras.en: If you rely on our team for trusted reporting, please take a moment to select us as your Preferred Source on Google by clicking here and hitting the "star" or "preferred" button, so you'll always see our verified news first.
paras.zh: 如果您信赖我们团队的可信报道，请花点时间点击此处并点击“星标”或“首选”按钮，选择我们作为您在 Google 上的首选来源，这样您始终会首先看到我们经过验证的新闻。

articles.title: Germany's Merz heads to Asia as security issues loom large

paras.en: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz kicked off a five-day tour of Asia on Monday, traveling to Singapore before his scheduled visits to Japan and South Korea. Merz is accompanied by an entourage of 30 senior businesspeople, including representatives of Germany's industry, tech and defense companies, and energy suppliers.
paras.zh: 德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨周一开始了为期五天的亚洲之行，在访问日本和韩国之前先访问新加坡。陪同梅尔茨出访的有 30 名高级商人，其中包括德国工业、科技和国防公司以及能源供应商的代表。

paras.en: At the same time, Germany's President Frank-Walter Steinmeier is visiting China.
paras.zh: 与此同时，德国总统施泰因迈尔正在中国访问。

paras.en: While the trips are not officially related, they both seem aimed at boosting Berlin's economic and security relationships at a time of geopolitical instability, which threatens global supply chains.
paras.zh: 虽然这些访问没有正式关联，但它们似乎都是为了在地缘政治不稳定威胁全球供应链的时期促进柏林的经济和安全关系。

paras.en: In Singapore, Merz is set to deliver a major foreign policy speech and meet Prime Minister Lawrence Wong. He will then travel to Japan on Wednesday to meet with Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi and take part in the German-Japanese Business Summit.
paras.zh: 在新加坡，默茨将发表重要的外交政策演讲，并会见新加坡总理黄循财。然后他将于周三前往日本会见首相高市早苗并参加德日商业峰会。

paras.en: Merz's visit "will be very much welcomed in Tokyo," said Ben Ascione, an assistant professor of politics and international relations at Tokyo's Waseda University.
paras.zh: 东京早稻田大学政治与国际关系助理教授本·阿西奥内表示，梅尔茨的访问“将在东京受到热烈欢迎”。

paras.en: "For more than a decade, Japan has been looking to generate new security allies and closer trade partnerships," he told DW.
paras.zh: 他告诉德国之声：“十多年来，日本一直在寻求建立新的安全盟友和更紧密的贸易伙伴关系。”

paras.en: "This greater outreach was started under Prime Minister [Shinzo] Abe, but Takaichi is very much following that blueprint because of the growing tensions in the Indo-Pacific region and the greater uncertainty around the second administration of [US President] Donald Trump," he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说：“这一更大范围的外展活动是在安倍晋三首相领导下开始的，但由于印太地区的紧张局势日益加剧，以及唐纳德·特朗普第二届政府的不确定性加大，高市非常遵循这一蓝图。”

paras.en: Germany and Japan face different, but connected threats
paras.zh: 德国和日本面临不同但相互关联的威胁

paras.en: The challenges posed by an increasingly expansionist China in the region are of deep concern to Tokyo, particularly as Beijing is forging closer ties with both Russia and the unpredictable regime in North Korea. China and Russia have conducted joint military exercises off Japan, and Beijing is resolute in its insistence that Taiwan be brought under the control of the mainland.
paras.zh: 东京在该地区日益扩张的中国所带来的挑战深感担忧，特别是在北京与俄罗斯以及难以预测的朝鲜政权建立更密切关系的情况下。中国和俄罗斯在日本附近举行了联合军事演习，北京方面坚决坚持将台湾置于大陆的控制之下。

paras.en: Ascione points out that any conflict over Taiwan, the disputed islands of the South China Sea or territorial claims elsewhere in the region would have a major impact on global trade. Such disruptions would also impact Germany.
paras.zh: 阿西奥内指出，任何围绕台湾、南海争议岛屿或该地区其他地区领土主张的冲突都会对全球贸易产生重大影响。这种干扰也会影响德国。

paras.en: "Japan and Germany have different primary security threats at the moment, with Germany focused on the Russian invasion of Ukraine and Japan keeping a close watch on China, North Korea and Russia, but I do believe that Germany has come more into line with Takaichi's perception of the security threat that is posed by China," Ascione said.
paras.zh: 阿西奥内表示：“日本和德国目前面临着不同的主要安全威胁，德国专注于俄罗斯入侵乌克兰，而日本则密切关注中国、朝鲜和俄罗斯，但我确实相信，德国已经更加认同高市对中国构成的安全威胁的看法。”

paras.en: "Takaichi is going to underline the importance of a rules-based order and the policy of a free and open Indo-Pacific at a time of such geopolitical uncertainty," he added. "Japan has in recent years moved towards greater resilience building, supply chain resilience and more and deeper security partnerships."
paras.zh: 他补充说：“在地缘政治不确定性如此之际，高市将强调基于规则的秩序和自由开放的印太政策的重要性。” “近年来，日本致力于增强复原力建设、供应链复原力以及更多、更深层次的安全伙伴关系。”

paras.en: According to Ascione, Japan would also "welcome" Germany deploying its military assets to the region, following its Bayern frigate docking in Tokyo in 2021 and its fighter jets conducting air drills with Japanese fighters in 2024.
paras.zh: 阿西奥内表示，继2021年拜仁护卫舰在东京停靠以及2024年德国战斗机与日本战斗机进行空中演习之后，日本也将“欢迎”德国向该地区部署军事资产。

paras.en: The frigate Bayern became the first German Navy warship to dock in Tokyo in 20 years in May 2021 and went on to conduct air and maritime exercises with Japanese units. In July 2024, German Eurofighter Typhoon aircraft similarly carried out air drills with Japanese fighters over northern Japan.
paras.zh: 2021年5月，拜仁号护卫舰成为20年来第一艘停靠东京的德国海军军舰，并与日本部队进行了空中和海上演习。 2024年7月，德国欧洲台风战斗机与日本战斗机在日本北部进行了类似的空中演习。

paras.en: Merz and Takaichi are expected to exchange views on responding to geopolitical threats.
paras.zh: 默茨和高一预计将就应对地缘政治威胁交换意见。

paras.en: This would include ensuring supply chain resilience, protecting strategically important industries and ensuring access to technologies and components, such as the rare earths that are critical to a range of advanced technologies but remain largely controlled by China.
paras.zh: 这将包括确保供应链的弹性、保护具有战略意义的重要产业以及确保获得技术和零部件，例如对一系列先进技术至关重要但仍主要由中国控制的稀土。

paras.en: European nations 'irritated' by Seoul's outreach to North Korea
paras.zh: 欧洲国家对首尔与朝鲜的接触感到“愤怒”

paras.en: Merz is then scheduled to visit South Korea, where he will meet with President Lee Jae-myung and open the 19th Asia-Pacific Conference of German Business in Seoul. He is also due to visit the Demilitarized Zone that marks the border between North and South Korea.
paras.zh: 默茨随后计划访问韩国，与韩国总统李在明会面，并为首尔第十九届德国商业亚太会议开幕。他还将访问标志着朝鲜和韩国边界的非军事区。

paras.en: Security issues will again dominate discussions in Seoul, believes Saeme Kim, a research fellow at The Asan Institute for Policy Studies.
paras.zh: 牙山政策研究所研究员 Saeme Kim 认为，安全问题将再次成为首尔讨论的主导话题。

paras.en: However, the German leader could voice concerns about South Korea's perceived "outreach" efforts towards North Korea and, by extension, Russia.
paras.zh: 然而，这位德国领导人可能对韩国对朝鲜乃至俄罗斯的“外展”努力表示担忧。

paras.en: "There has been discussion recently about exports of petroleum to Russia, although Seoul says it has not breached sanctions," she said.
paras.zh: “最近有关于向俄罗斯出口石油的讨论，尽管首尔表示没有违反制裁，”她说。

paras.en: South Korea is trying to set up a way to communicate with Pyongyang, according to the expert, despite the regime of Kim Jong Un sending troops to the conflict in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 这位专家表示，尽管金正恩政权派遣军队参加乌克兰冲突，但韩国仍在试图建立一种与平壤沟通的方式。

paras.en: "It's not just Germany, I think a lot of European countries will be irritated by the Lee administration trying to improve relations with North Korea and Russia," Kim said.
paras.zh: 金说：“不仅仅是德国，我认为许多欧洲国家都会对李明博政府试图改善与朝鲜和俄罗斯的关系感到恼火。”

paras.en: The South also continues to provide humanitarian assistance to North Korea, even as the regime forges ever closer economic ties with China and Russia.
paras.zh: 尽管朝鲜政权与中国和俄罗斯建立了越来越密切的经济联系，韩国也继续向朝鲜提供人道主义援助。

paras.en: "The government needs to keep in mind that some of these policies are going to be damaging to South Korea's own interests over the long-run," she said.
paras.zh: “政府需要记住，从长远来看，其中一些政策将损害韩国自身的利益，”她说。

paras.en: Can South Korea learn from Germany's history?
paras.zh: 韩国可以从德国的历史中吸取教训吗？

paras.en: At the same time, Merz could also offer insight into two Koreas trying to work with one another, drawing on the German experience of reuniting in 1990.
paras.zh: 与此同时，梅尔茨还可以借鉴德国 1990 年重新统一的经验，深入了解两个朝鲜试图相互合作的情况。

paras.en: "There are lessons that South Korea can learn, of course, but there are a lot of differences," Kim said. "The two Koreas are still technically at war and Seoul has to deal with an aspiring nuclear power on its border."
paras.zh: “当然，韩国可以吸取一些教训，但也有很多差异，”金说。 “从技术上讲，两个朝鲜仍处于战争状态，首尔必须应对其边境上一个雄心勃勃的核国家。”

paras.en: Merz will have the opportunity to see the North at a distance when he visits the DMZ. His visit to the border, however, could also be canceled due to lingering tensions over the North Korean mine injuring three South Korean soldiers last month. Pyongyang has accused the South of staging the incident.
paras.zh: 梅尔茨访问非军事区时将有机会远远地看到北方。然而，由于上个月朝鲜地雷造成三名韩国士兵受伤，紧张局势持续存在，他对边境的访问也可能被取消。平壤指责韩国策划了这起事件。

articles.title: Why Ukraine may be involved in Mali's conflict

paras.en: Ukraine is fighting Russia — and the conflict may extend into Africa's Sahel region.
paras.zh: 乌克兰正在与俄罗斯作战，冲突可能会蔓延到非洲萨赫勒地区。

paras.en: According to an investigation published by US media outlet CNN in September, around 15 Ukrainian drone specialists are reportedly supporting Tuareg rebels in northern Mali. Their common enemy: the military government in Bamako and its Russian allies.
paras.zh: 据美国媒体 CNN 9 月发布的一项调查显示，据报道约有 15 名乌克兰无人机专家正在支持马里北部的图阿雷格叛军。他们的共同敌人：巴马科军政府及其俄罗斯盟友。

paras.en: But how reliable is the information? And what price could Kyiv pay for engaging in Africa?
paras.zh: 但这些信息的可靠性如何？基辅参与非洲事务会付出什么代价？

paras.en: Marta Oliynyk-D'omochko, coordinator of the African Studies Program at the National University of Kyiv-Mohyla Academy, sees a strategic motive. "Ukraine's main interest is to weaken Russia's influence around the world," she told DW. If Russia's military influence were rolled back, she added, the economic opportunities arising from it would also diminish.
paras.zh: 基辅国立大学莫希拉学院非洲研究项目协调员玛尔塔·奥利尼克-多莫奇科（Marta Oliynyk-D'omochko）看到了战略动机。 “乌克兰的主要利益是削弱俄罗斯在世界各地的影响力，”她告诉德国之声。她补充说，如果俄罗斯的军事影响力被削弱，由此产生的经济机会也会减少。

paras.en: Russian historian Irina Filatova, professor emeritus at the University of KwaZulu-Natal in South Africa, also considers Ukrainian support for the Tuareg movement plausible. However, she said she has no independent evidence to confirm such involvement.
paras.zh: 南非夸祖鲁纳塔尔大学名誉教授、俄罗斯历史学家伊琳娜·菲拉托娃也认为乌克兰对图阿雷格运动的支持是有道理的。然而，她说她没有独立证据证实这种参与。

paras.en: Kyiv's alleged partners are controversial. The Tuareg separatist Azawad Liberation Front (FLA) cooperates with the Jama'at Nusrat al-Islam wal Muslimeen (JNIM), a jihadist group affiliated with al-Qaeda.
paras.zh: 基辅所谓的合作伙伴是有争议的。图阿雷格分离主义分子阿扎瓦德解放阵线 (FLA) 与附属于基地组织的圣战组织 Jama'at Nusrat al-Islam wal Muskeen (JNIM) 合作。

paras.en: In July 2024, DW reported on possible involvement by the Ukrainian military intelligence service (HUR) in an ambush on Russian Wagner fighters near Tinzaouaten in northern Mali.
paras.zh: 2024 年 7 月，德国之声报道称，乌克兰军事情报部门 (HUR) 可能参与了马里北部廷扎瓦滕附近对俄罗斯瓦格纳战斗机的伏击。

paras.en: At the time, HUR spokesperson Andriy Yusov said the Tuareg rebels had received information they needed to carry out the attack. Ukraine denied direct involvement.
paras.zh: 当时，HUR 发言人安德烈·尤索夫 (Andriy Yusov) 表示，图阿雷格叛军已收到实施袭击所需的信息。乌克兰否认直接参与其中。

paras.en: Paramilitaries from Russia's Wagner Group and Malian troops suffered heavy losses in the July 2024 attack.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯瓦格纳集团准军事部队和马里军队在 2024 年 7 月的袭击中遭受重大损失。

paras.en: CNN's investigation has reignited the question of whether the Russia-Ukraine war is also being fought on African soil.
paras.zh: 美国有线电视新闻网（CNN）的调查再次引发了俄罗斯和乌克兰战争是否也在非洲土地上进行的问题。

paras.en: The suspicions were renewed by a post on X by Kyrylo Budanov. The former head of Ukraine's military intelligence, now chief of staff to President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, wrote on September 7 that Ukrainian intelligence protects the country's interests worldwide — "from Russia to Africa … in the burning desert sands and in the snows of icy Antarctica...".
paras.zh: Kyrylo Budanov 在 X 上发布的帖子再次引发了人们的怀疑。乌克兰前军事情报局局长、现任总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基的幕僚长于 9 月 7 日写道，乌克兰情报机构保护该国在全世界的利益——“从俄罗斯到非洲……在燃烧的沙漠和冰冷的南极洲的雪地……”。

paras.en: Budanov did not explicitly mention Mali and his post does not confirm any specific operation. CNN reported that the Ukrainians provided drone training, operational planning and remote support for drone missions. DW has not independently verified those claims.
paras.zh: 布达诺夫没有明确提及马里，他的帖子也没有证实任何具体行动。美国有线电视新闻网 (CNN) 报道称，乌克兰人为无人机任务提供了无人机训练、作战规划和远程支持。德国之声尚未独立证实这些说法。

paras.en: DW reached out to the HUR for comment. Among other things, DW wanted to know whether personnel had been deployed to Mali, whether the political leadership had approved such a mission, and what measures were in place to ensure that the JNIM — which cooperates with the FLA — does not indirectly benefit from Ukrainian support.
paras.zh: 德国之声联系了 HUR 寻求评论。除其他外，德国之声想知道人员是否已部署到马里、政治领导层是否批准了这样的任务，以及采取了哪些措施来确保与FLA合作的JNIM不会间接受益于乌克兰的支持。

paras.en: DW did not receive a specific response. An HUR spokesperson said the agency might provide information at a later date. The extent of any potential Ukrainian involvement therefore remains unclear.
paras.zh: 德国之声没有收到具体回复。 HUR 发言人表示，该机构可能会在晚些时候提供信息。因此，乌克兰潜在参与的程度仍不清楚。

paras.en: Following military coups in 2020 and 2021, Mali increasingly turned away from Western partners and toward Russia. The Wagner Group was subsequently replaced by the Africa Corps in 2025 as Moscow reorganized its military presence.
paras.zh: 在 2020 年和 2021 年发生军事政变后，马里日益远离西方伙伴并转向俄罗斯。随着莫斯科重组其军事存在，瓦格纳集团随后于 2025 年被非洲军团取代。

paras.en: Russia has sought to consolidate its influence in the Sahel region and present itself as a reliable security partner.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯寻求巩固其在萨赫勒地区的影响力，并将自己打造为可靠的安全伙伴。

paras.en: Ulf Laessing, former head of the Sahel program of the Konrad Adenauer Foundation in Mali and now head of its Syria and Iraq program, said Russia is continuing to expand its activities in Africa.
paras.zh: 马里康拉德·阿登纳基金会萨赫勒项目前负责人、现任叙利亚和伊拉克项目负责人乌尔夫·莱辛表示，俄罗斯正在继续扩大在非洲的活动。

paras.en: "I have received information that the Africa Corps still uses Syria and Libya as transit points for flights from Russia, including for refueling and loading, to support its operations on the continent," Laessing told DW.
paras.zh: 莱辛告诉德国之声：“我收到消息称，非洲军团仍然使用叙利亚和利比亚作为从俄罗斯起飞的航班的中转站，包括加油和装载，以支持其在非洲大陆的行动。”

paras.en: From Ukraine's perspective, it could be attractive to exert pressure on Russian forces in Africa.
paras.zh: 从乌克兰的角度来看，向俄罗斯在非洲的军队施加压力可能很有吸引力。

paras.en: Filatova sees a strategic logic to this: "The Ukrainians regard Russian troops anywhere in the world as legitimate targets." Setbacks in Mali could tie up Russian resources and undermine Moscow's reputation as a security partner, she argued.
paras.zh: 菲拉托娃认为其中有一个战略逻辑：“乌克兰人将世界任何地方的俄罗斯军队视为合法目标。”她认为，马里的挫折可能会占用俄罗斯的资源，并损害莫斯科作为安全伙伴的声誉。

paras.en: However, Oliynyk-D'omochko stressed that the relationship with the Tuareg is not a comprehensive alliance. The FLA is not seeking to replace the government in Bamako. Instead, it is focused on northern Mali and is pursuing self-determination or extensive autonomy.
paras.zh: 不过，奥利尼克-多莫奇科强调，与图阿雷格人的关系并不是全面联盟。 FLA 并不寻求取代巴马科政府。相反，它的重点是马里北部，并正在追求自决或广泛自治。

paras.en: Oliynyk-D'omochko describes the relationship as a tactical arrangement: "It is more of a situational alliance against a common enemy than a comprehensive partnership."
paras.zh: 奥利尼克-多莫奇科将这种关系描述为一种战术安排：“这更像是针对共同敌人的情境联盟，而不是全面的伙伴关系。”

paras.en: The FLA is fighting for an independent state in the north of Mali, a region predominantly inhabited by Tuaregs. JNIM, by contrast, aims to impose strict Islamic rule. Both groups oppose the military government and its Russian allies, but their objectives differ.
paras.zh: FLA 正在为马里北部的独立国家而战，该地区主要由图阿雷格人居住。相比之下，JNIM 的目标是实行严格的伊斯兰统治。两个组织都反对军政府及其俄罗斯盟友，但目标不同。

paras.en: Any potential Ukrainian support for the FLA would not, in itself, prove that Kyiv is directly supporting JNIM. However, jihadists could benefit indirectly if they conduct joint operations with FLA or gain access to knowledge and equipment.
paras.zh: 乌克兰对 FLA 的任何潜在支持本身并不能证明基辅直接支持 JNIM。然而，如果圣战分子与 FLA 开展联合行动或获得知识和设备，他们可以间接受益。

paras.en: Cooperation between Tuareg and Islamist groups dates back more than a decade.
paras.zh: 图阿雷格人和伊斯兰组织之间的合作可以追溯到十多年前。

paras.en: After the ousting and killing of Libya's longtime dictator Muammar al-Gaddafi during the Arab Spring in October 2011, heavily armed Tuareg fighters returned to Mali and took up the struggle for an independent state.
paras.zh: 2011年10月阿拉伯之春期间，利比亚长期独裁者穆阿迈尔·卡扎菲被推翻并被杀害后，全副武装的图阿雷格战士返回马里，开始了争取独立国家的斗争。

paras.en: In the process, separatist ambitions became intertwined with Islamist movements. Iyad Ag Ghaly, the current leader of JNIM, was himself involved in the Tuareg rebellion before turning to jihadism.
paras.zh: 在此过程中，分离主义野心与伊斯兰运动交织在一起。 JNIM 现任领导人伊亚德·阿格·加利 (Iyad Ag Ghaly) 在转向圣战之前曾参与过图阿雷格叛乱。

paras.en: According to Oliynyk-D'omochko, the cooperation is primarily tactical in nature. The two sides have collaborated during past uprisings but later fell out. It remains unclear how long the current alliance will last.
paras.zh: 奥利尼克-多莫奇科表示，这种合作本质上主要是战术性的。双方在过去的起义中曾合作过，但后来分道扬镳。目前尚不清楚当前的联盟将持续多久。

paras.en: For Kyiv, this also poses a political risk. In many African countries, the Tuaregs are viewed as separatists. Cooperation with them could therefore create the impression that Ukraine is interfering in another country's internal affairs.
paras.zh: 对于基辅来说，这也带来了政治风险。在许多非洲国家，图阿雷格人被视为分离主义者。因此，与他们合作可能会给人留下乌克兰正在干涉他国内政的印象。

paras.en: Mali, Niger and Burkina Faso accuse Ukraine of supporting armed groups and threatening their territorial integrity. The three Sahel nations, all ruled by military governments, have severed diplomatic relations with Kyiv and deepened their cooperation with Russia.
paras.zh: 马里、尼日尔和布基纳法索指责乌克兰支持武装团体并威胁其领土完整。萨赫勒三个国家均由军政府统治，已与基辅断绝外交关系，并加深与俄罗斯的合作。

paras.en: In September, Mali's Foreign Minister Abdoulaye Diop accused Ukraine at the United Nations of "providing clear and open support to terrorist groups and other mafia-like groups to undermine our country's territorial integrity," reported Agence France-Presse. Diop did not provide evidence for his claim.
paras.zh: 据法新社报道，9月，马里外交部长阿卜杜拉耶·迪奥普在联合国指责乌克兰“向恐怖组织和其他类似黑手党的组织提供明确和公开的支持，破坏我国的领土完整”。迪奥普没有提供证据证明他的说法。

paras.en: The three nations' governments have may have an interest in legitimizing their partnership with Moscow and portraying Kyiv as a destabilizing actor.
paras.zh: 这三个国家的政府可能有兴趣使它们与莫斯科的伙伴关系合法化，并将基辅描绘成破坏稳定的角色。

paras.en: Oliynyk-D'omochko has found no definitive proof of the allegations, yet warned of the potential consequences for Ukraine's Africa policy. Kyiv advocates equal partnerships with African countries. Any alleged cooperation with separatists could undermine that message and affect how potential partners view Ukraine.
paras.zh: 奥利尼克-多莫奇科尚未找到这些指控的明确证据，但警告乌克兰非洲政策的潜在后果。基辅主张与非洲国家建立平等伙伴关系。任何与分裂分子合作的指控都可能破坏这一信息，并影响潜在合作伙伴对乌克兰的看法。

paras.en: Engagement in Mali could offer Ukraine a relatively low-cost way to weaken Russian interests beyond Europe. A small team of specialists could train local fighters and improve their capabilities in the use of drones.
paras.zh: 参与马里事务可能为乌克兰提供一种相对低成本的方式来削弱俄罗斯在欧洲以外的利益。一个专家小组可以训练当地战士并提高他们使用无人机的能力。

paras.en: But a potential partnership with the FLA carries political risks. Because the Tuareg separatists cooperate with the JNIM, Kyiv could face accusations of indirectly supporting jihadist fighters. That could undermine Ukraine's efforts to strengthen its relations with African countries.
paras.zh: 但与 FLA 的潜在合作会带来政治风险。由于图阿雷格分离主义分子与 JNIM 合作，基辅可能面临间接支持圣战分子的指控。这可能会破坏乌克兰加强与非洲国家关系的努力。

paras.en: This article has been translated from German
paras.zh: 这篇文章是从德文翻译过来的

paras.en: Correction, October 26, 2026: An earlier version of this article stated that the CNN investigation was published in October 2026; the report was published in September. DW apologizes for the error.
paras.zh: 更正，2026 年 10 月 26 日：本文早期版本称 CNN 调查于 2026 年 10 月发表；该报告于九月发表。德国之声对错误表示歉意。

articles.title: US midterm elections 2026 in maps and charts

paras.en: On November 3, about 210 million registered voters will decide how much power Donald Trump has for the rest of his US presidency.
paras.zh: 11 月 3 日，约 2.1 亿登记选民将决定唐纳德·特朗普在其剩余的美国总统任期内拥有多少权力。

paras.en: Trump is not on the ballot, but control of the United States Congress is. Made up of the House of Representatives and the Senate, Congress writes the country’s laws and controls federal spending.
paras.zh: 特朗普不在选票上，但对美国国会的控制却在。国会由众议院和参议院组成，负责制定国家法律并控制联邦支出。

paras.en: In this visual explainer, Al Jazeera breaks down how the elections work, which races matter and what the results could mean for either party.
paras.zh: 在这个视觉解说中，半岛电视台详细介绍了选举的运作方式、哪些种族重要以及结果对任何一方意味着什么。

paras.en: Held halfway through a US president’s four-year term, midterm elections decide the makeup of Congress.
paras.zh: 中期选举在美国总统四年任期的中间举行，决定国会的组成。

paras.en: All 435 seats in the House of Representatives and 35 of the Senate’s 100 seats are being contested, including special elections in the states of Florida and Ohio to fill the seats vacated by US Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Vice President JD Vance. Voters in 36 states will also elect governors.
paras.zh: 众议院全部435个席位和参议院100个席位中的35个席位都在角逐，其中包括佛罗里达州和俄亥俄州的特别选举，以填补美国国务卿卢比奥和副总统万斯空出的席位。 36个州的选民还将选举州长。

paras.en: House members represent one congressional district each and serve two-year terms, while senators serve six-year terms.
paras.zh: 众议院议员每人代表一个国会选区，任期两年，参议员任期六年。

paras.en: Midterm elections are also widely considered a referendum on the sitting president’s performance.
paras.zh: 中期选举也被广泛认为是对现任总统表现的全民公投。

paras.en: Since 1946, the president’s party has lost an average of 26.5 seats in the House and a handful in the Senate in midterm elections, according to Todd Belt, a professor of political management at George Washington University.
paras.zh: 乔治华盛顿大学政治管理学教授托德·贝尔特表示，自 1946 年以来，总统所在的政党在中期选举中平均失去了众议院 26.5 个席位和参议院的少数席位。

paras.en: Beyond Congress and governors, voters will also elect state legislators and local officials.
paras.zh: 除了国会和州长之外，选民还将选举州议员和地方官员。

paras.en: Nadia Brown, a professor of government at Georgetown University, said that while national elections get most of the attention, “It is important to remember that local politics is where most Americans interact with government.”
paras.zh: 乔治城大学政府学教授纳迪亚·布朗表示，虽然全国选举最受关注，但“重要的是要记住，地方政治是大多数美国人与政府互动的地方。”

paras.en: She added that “It is the local propositions or referendums on ballots [that] will impact the everyday lives of people.”
paras.zh: 她补充说：“当地的提案或公投将影响人们的日常生活。”

paras.en: What is at stake in the House and Senate?
paras.zh: 众议院和参议院的利害关系是什么？

paras.en: Republicans hold majorities in both chambers. Losing either would give Democrats the power to block legislation and launch investigations into Trump’s administration.
paras.zh: 共和党在参众两院均占多数。失去其中任何一个都将赋予民主党阻止立法并对特朗普政府展开调查的权力。

paras.en: Democrats need to gain three seats in the House and four in the Senate to take control. A 50-50 split in the Senate would leave Republicans in control, because Vance can cast tie-breaking votes.
paras.zh: 民主党需要在众议院获得三个席位，在参议院获得四个席位才能获得控制权。如果参议院以 50 比 50 的比例出现分歧，共和党将继续掌控局面，因为万斯可以投出决定性的选票。

paras.en: Belt said a Democratic victory could significantly limit Trump’s ability to pursue his domestic agenda.
paras.zh: 贝尔特表示，民主党的胜利可能会严重限制特朗普推行国内议程的能力。

paras.en: “If Democrats take one chamber, all non-government funding legislation will grind to a halt,” he told Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: “如果民主党拿下一个议院，所有非政府资助立法都将陷入停滞，”他告诉半岛电视台。

paras.en: The House of Representatives is the lower house of the US Congress.
paras.zh: 众议院是美国国会的下议院。

paras.en: Its 435 members each represent one local district and serve two-year terms, so every seat is contested every two years.
paras.zh: 其 435 名成员每人代表一个当地选区，任期两年，因此每个席位每两年进行一次竞选。

paras.en: Seats are divided among the states by population, based on the US Census conducted every 10 years. California, the most populous state, has 52 seats, while the least populous, such as Wyoming and Vermont, have one each.
paras.zh: 席位根据美国每十年进行一次的人口普查按人口划分。人口最多的州加利福尼亚州有 52 个席位，而人口最少的州，如怀俄明州和佛蒙特州，各有 1 个席位。

paras.en: Republicans currently control the House, with 218 seats to the Democrats’ 214, and one independent sits with the Republicans. Two seats are vacant, one last held by each party.
paras.zh: 共和党目前控制众议院，拥有 218 个席位，民主党拥有 214 个席位，其中一名独立人士与共和党同席。两个席位空着，最后一个席位由双方各占。

paras.en: The new House will be sworn in on January 3, 2027.
paras.zh: 新众议院将于 2027 年 1 月 3 日宣誓就职。

paras.en: Each district elects its own representative, and the party that wins 218 seats takes control, so a few narrow wins in close districts can decide the majority.
paras.zh: 每个选区选举自己的代表，赢得218个席位的政党占据控制权，因此在接近的选区中以微弱优势获胜就可以决定多数席位。

paras.en: Belt estimates that about 35 House races could decide the majority. He predicts Democrats could gain about 15 seats, despite Republican redistricting that he says has given the party an advantage in nine additional districts.
paras.zh: 贝尔特估计，大约 35 场众议院竞选可能会决定多数席位。他预计民主党可能会获得大约 15 个席位，尽管共和党重新划分选区，他说这让该党在另外 9 个选区获得了优势。

paras.en: “People generally vote straight ticket, meaning they will vote for all the candidates of one party, so this is likely to affect down-ballot races [as well],” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“人们通常会直接投票，这意味着他们会投票给一个政党的所有候选人，因此这也可能会影响下一轮选票的竞选。”

paras.en: A battleground district is a seat either party could realistically win. The graphic below highlights 12 of these key races to watch.
paras.zh: 战场选区是任何一方都可以实际赢得的席位。下图重点介绍了其中 12 场值得关注的关键比赛。

paras.en: The Senate is the upper house of the US Congress.
paras.zh: 参议院是美国国会的上议院。

paras.en: Its 100 members, two from each state regardless of population, are elected statewide and serve six-year terms, with about a third of seats contested every two years.
paras.zh: 它有 100 名成员，无论人口多少，每个州都有两名成员，在全州范围内选举产生，任期六年，每两年选举大约三分之一的席位。

paras.en: This year, 33 seats are being contested in regular elections, alongside special elections in Florida and Ohio. Those two contests will fill the remaining two years of terms previously held by Marco Rubio and JD Vance.
paras.zh: 今年，除了佛罗里达州和俄亥俄州的特别选举外，还有 33 个席位在常规选举中角逐。这两场比赛将填补马可·卢比奥和 JD·万斯之前所担任的剩余两年任期。

paras.en: Of the 35 seats being contested, Republicans hold 22, and Democrats hold 13.
paras.zh: 在竞争的 35 个席位中，共和党占据 22 个席位，民主党占据 13 个席位。

paras.en: Republicans currently have 53 senators. Democrats have 45, and two independents sit with them, giving the Democratic bloc 47 seats.
paras.zh: 共和党目前有 53 名参议员。民主党拥有 45 个席位，加上两名独立人士与他们坐在一起，民主党集团拥有 47 个席位。

paras.en: Democrats need a net gain of four seats to reach 51 and take control. Republicans can keep control with 50 because Vice President Vance can break tied votes.
paras.zh: 民主党需要净增加 4 个席位才能达到 51 个席位并取得控制权。共和党可以保持 50 票的控制权，因为副总统万斯可以打破平局选票。

paras.en: The new Senate will be sworn in on January 3, 2027.
paras.zh: 新一届参议院将于2027年1月3日宣誓就职。

paras.en: To win the Senate, Democrats must hold the 13 seats they are defending and flip Republican-held ones.
paras.zh: 要赢得参议院席位，民主党必须保住他们正在捍卫的 13 个席位，并推翻共和党占据的席位。

paras.en: In Georgia, Democratic Senator Jon Ossoff faces Republican Mike Collins. Michigan’s open seat pits Democrat Abdul El-Sayed against Republican Mike Rogers, while Democrat Chris Pappas faces Republican John Sununu for an open seat in New Hampshire.
paras.zh: 在佐治亚州，民主党参议员乔恩·奥索夫面对共和党参议员迈克·柯林斯。密歇根州的空缺席位由民主党人阿卜杜勒·赛义德与共和党人迈克·罗杰斯争夺，而民主党人克里斯·帕帕斯在新罕布什尔州与共和党人约翰·苏努努争夺空缺席位。

paras.en: Republican-held seats offer Democrats opportunities elsewhere. In Maine, Senator Susan Collins faces Democrat Troy Jackson, who replaced primary winner Graham Platner after he withdrew in July. North Carolina’s open seat pits Democrat Roy Cooper against Republican Michael Whatley.
paras.zh: 共和党占据的席位为民主党在其他地方提供了机会。在缅因州，参议员苏珊·柯林斯面对民主党人特洛伊·杰克逊，后者接替了初选获胜者格雷厄姆·普拉特纳，后者于 7 月退出。北卡罗来纳州的空缺席位由民主党人罗伊·库珀与共和党人迈克尔·沃特利对决。

paras.en: Ohio, Alaska and Iowa are also competitive, while Texas and Kansas have drawn growing attention as Democrats look for more routes to a majority.
paras.zh: 俄亥俄州、阿拉斯加州和爱荷华州也具有竞争力，而德克萨斯州和堪萨斯州也吸引了越来越多的关注，因为民主党正在寻求更多途径获得多数席位。

paras.en: Although Democrats face a more difficult path to a Senate majority than to control of the House, the growing number of competitive races has increased their chances of winning the chamber, according to election analysts.
paras.zh: 选举分析人士表示，尽管民主党获得参议院多数席位比控制众议院要困难得多，但竞争性竞选数量的增加增加了他们赢得众议院的机会。

paras.en: The cost of living tops voters’ concerns, with rising petrol prices, housing costs and healthcare coverage squeezing household budgets.
paras.zh: 生活成本是选民最关心的问题，汽油价格、住房成本和医疗保险的上涨挤压了家庭预算。

paras.en: Reproductive rights remain a major issue, while immigration and the state of US democracy are also on the ballot.
paras.zh: 生育权仍然是一个主要问题，而移民和美国民主状况也受到关注。

paras.en: The US-Israel war on Iran and the rapid growth of artificial intelligence (AI)` and data centres have raised further questions about security, jobs and energy costs.
paras.zh: 美以对伊朗的战争以及人工智能 (AI) 和数据中心的快速增长引发了有关安全、就业和能源成本的进一步问题。

paras.en: About 210 million Americans are registered to vote, nearly eight in 10 US residents aged 18 or older, according to USAFacts, a nonpartisan organisation that compiles government data.
paras.zh: 根据编制政府数据的无党派组织 USAFacts 的数据，约有 2.1 亿美国人登记投票，占 18 岁或以上美国居民的十分之八。

paras.en: California has the most registered voters, with 23.2 million, followed by Texas (17.4 million) and Florida (13.6 million). Together, they account for about 26 percent of all registered voters.
paras.zh: 加利福尼亚州登记选民最多，为 2,320 万，其次是德克萨斯州（1,740 万）和佛罗里达州（1,360 万）。他们合计约占所有登记选民的 26%。

paras.en: Wyoming (278,468), Vermont (459,455) and Alaska (603,310) have the fewest.

A Pew Research Center survey conducted from September 28 to October 4 found that 44 percent of registered voters backed the Democratic candidate in their district, compared with 36 percent for the Republican. Five percent support another candidate, and 15 percent are unsure.
paras.zh: 皮尤研究中心9月28日至10月4日进行的一项调查发现，44%的登记选民支持所在选区的民主党候选人，而支持共和党的比例为36%。 5% 支持另一位候选人，15% 不确定。

paras.en: Men are evenly split, with 42 percent backing each party, while women favour Democrats by 45 percent to 31 percent.
paras.zh: 男性的支持率持平，各有 42% 的人支持各党派，而女性则分别支持民主党，比例分别为 45% 和 31%。

paras.en: The graphic below shows how voting preferences differ by gender, race, age, education and party affiliation.
paras.zh: 下图显示了投票偏好如何因性别、种族、年龄、教育程度和党派关系而有所不同。

paras.en: Fewer Americans vote in midterms than in presidential elections. Since 1944, average turnout has been about 42 percent in midterms, compared with 58 percent in presidential races.
paras.zh: 在中期选举中投票的美国人比在总统选举中投票的人少。自 1944 年以来，中期选举的平均投票率约为 42%，而总统竞选的平均投票率为 58%。

paras.en: What happens if Republicans lose the House?
paras.zh: 如果共和党失去众议院会发生什么？

paras.en: A Democratic House could block Republican legislation and use its committees to investigate the Trump administration. It would also hold the power to impeach the president, which only the House can do.
paras.zh: 民主党众议院可以阻止共和党立法并利用其委员会来调查特朗普政府。它还将拥有弹劾总统的权力，而这只有众议院才能做到。

paras.en: Control would also give Democrats leverage over government funding. Every bill needs approval from both chambers, so a Republican Senate could not pass laws on its own.
paras.zh: 控制权还将赋予民主党对政府资金的影响力。每项法案都需要获得参众两院的批准，因此共和党参议院无法自行通过法律。

paras.en: Belt expects a Democratic-controlled House to lead to more confrontations over federal spending, including the 12 annual bills needed to fund federal agencies. That raises the possibility of further government shutdowns, when funding lapses and many federal services stop.
paras.zh: 贝尔特预计，民主党控制的众议院将导致在联邦支出方面出现更多对抗，其中包括为联邦机构提供资金所需的 12 项年度法案。当资金失效和许多联邦服务停止时，这增加了政府进一步关闭的可能性。

paras.en: Belt also believes that Trump could turn increasingly to foreign policy if his domestic agenda faces opposition in Congress.
paras.zh: 贝尔特还认为，如果特朗普的国内议程遭到国会的反对，他可能会越来越多地转向外交政策。

paras.en: “Traditionally, presidents facing divided government in their last two years pivot to foreign policy almost exclusively. I think the same will be true for Trump,” he said.
paras.zh: “传统上，过去两年面临政府分裂的总统几乎完全转向外交政策。我认为特朗普也是如此，”他说。

paras.en: What happens if Republicans lose the Senate?
paras.zh: 如果共和党失去参议院会发生什么？

paras.en: A Democratic Senate could block legislation and reject presidential nominees, including federal judges, Supreme Court justices, cabinet officials and ambassadors.
paras.zh: 民主党参议院可以阻止立法并拒绝总统提名人，包括联邦法官、最高法院法官、内阁官员和大使。

paras.en: That makes Senate control consequential beyond the next two years. Federal judges serve for life, shaping rulings long after a presidency ends.
paras.zh: 这使得参议院的控制权在未来两年内变得至关重要。联邦法官终身任职，在总统任期结束后很久才能制定裁决。

paras.en: The Senate also holds the trial if the House impeaches a president. Removing a president from office requires a two-thirds majority, a threshold neither party is likely to reach.
paras.zh: 如果众议院弹劾总统，参议院也会进行审判。罢免总统需要三分之二多数票，这是两党都不太可能达到的门槛。

paras.en: Would winning both chambers give Democrats full control?
paras.zh: 赢得参众两院会让民主党获得完全控制权吗？

paras.en: No. Trump would remain president and could veto legislation, and overriding a veto requires a two-thirds vote in each chamber.
paras.zh: 不会。特朗普将继续担任总统，并可以否决立法，而推翻否决权需要两院三分之二的票数。

paras.en: Senate rules also require 60 votes to end debate on most legislation, though some budget bills can pass with a simple majority. A narrow majority therefore does not guarantee a party can pass its programme.
paras.zh: 参议院规定还需要 60 票才能结束大多数立法的辩论，不过一些预算法案可以以简单多数通过。因此，微弱多数并不能保证政党能够通过其纲领。

paras.en: A Democratic House could open impeachment proceedings against Trump, who has already been impeached twice. However, removing a president from office requires a two-thirds majority in the Senate.
paras.zh: 民主党众议院可能会对特朗普启动弹劾程序，特朗普已经被弹劾两次。然而，罢免总统需要参议院三分之二多数票。

paras.en: Belt considers another impeachment unlikely.
paras.zh: 贝尔特认为不太可能再次弹劾。

paras.en: “There will definitely be investigations,” he told Al Jazeera, but added, “There will not likely be another impeachment because Democrats tried that twice and Republicans rallied behind Trump.”
paras.zh: “肯定会进行调查，”他告诉半岛电视台，但补充道，“不太可能再次弹劾，因为民主党人曾两次尝试弹劾，而共和党人则团结起来支持特朗普。”

paras.en: Results will begin emerging after the first polls close at 6pm Eastern time (23:00 GMT) on November 3, but some close races could take days to resolve.
paras.zh: 结果将于 11 月 3 日东部时间下午 6 点（格林尼治标准时间 23:00）第一次投票结束后开始揭晓，但一些势均力敌的竞选可能需要几天时间才能得出结果。

paras.en: Election night results are preliminary. Final tallies can take days or sometimes weeks as officials count mail-in, provisional and other outstanding ballots before certifying the results, and the pace varies by state.
paras.zh: 选举之夜的结果是初步的。最终计票可能需要几天甚至几周的时间，因为官员们在确认结果之前会清点邮寄选票、临时选票和其他未完成的选票，而且速度因州而异。

paras.en: “In some states, it may take up to a week or more,” Belt said.
paras.zh: “在某些州，这可能需要一周或更长时间，”贝尔特说。

paras.en: Some contests may go further. In Georgia, if no Senate candidate wins a majority, the race goes to a run-off election on December 1.
paras.zh: 有些比赛可能会更进一步。在佐治亚州，如果没有参议院候选人赢得多数席位，比赛将在 12 月 1 日进行决选。

paras.en: Belt warned that early results could give a misleading picture of the outcome. Because Republicans have historically been less likely than Democrats to vote by mail, some states could initially appear to favour Republican candidates before later-counted ballots narrow or reverse their leads. This is known as the “red mirage”. In states that count mail ballots first, the reverse can happen.
paras.zh: 贝尔特警告说，早期结果可能会对结果产生误导。由于历来共和党人通过邮寄投票的可能性低于民主党人，因此一些州最初可能会表现出支持共和党候选人的态度，但后来计票的选票缩小或逆转了领先优势。这就是所谓的“红色海市蜃楼”。在首先统计邮寄选票的州，可能会发生相反的情况。

paras.en: A delay in counting or a change in which candidate is leading does not, by itself, indicate electoral fraud.
paras.zh: 计票延迟或候选人领先地位发生变化本身并不表明存在选举舞弊。

paras.en: The vote will decide who writes legislation, scrutinises the administration and controls federal spending, setting the balance of power for the rest of Trump’s term.
paras.zh: 此次投票将决定由谁起草立法、审查政府并控制联邦支出，从而为特朗普剩余任期奠定权力平衡。

articles.title: Brazil’s real sinks after Lula’s re-election victory

paras.en: Brazil’s real dropped against the United States dollar on the heels of Brazil’s President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva’s unexpected re-election after right-wing Flavio Bolsonaro, the son of former President Jair Bolsonaro, led in the first round of voting earlier this month.
paras.zh: 巴西总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦出人意料地连任，前总统雅伊尔·博尔索纳罗之子、右翼人士弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗本月早些时候在第一轮投票中领先，巴西雷亚尔兑美元汇率下跌。

paras.en: Brazil’s currency dropped against the dollar by 12 percent in spot trading. Bovespa stock index futures tumbled nearly 15 percent on Monday.
paras.zh: 巴西货币兑美元汇率在现货交易中下跌了 12%。周一，Bovespa 股指期货暴跌近 15%。

paras.en: “I’m not surprised the real is sinking sharply; traders are covering their bets that assume a Bolsonaro victory and tighter fiscal policy,” Rachel Ziemba, adjunct senior fellow at the Center for a New American Security, told Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: 新美国安全中心兼职高级研究员雷切尔·齐姆巴 (Rachel Ziemba) 告诉半岛电视台：“我对雷亚尔大幅下跌并不感到惊讶；交易员正在回补他们的赌注，假设博尔索纳罗获胜和收紧财政政策。”

paras.en: Brazil’s stock exchange halted trading for 30 minutes. The Bovespa index fell 10 percent from its previous close, triggering a circuit-breaker safety mechanism and reversing a rally earlier this month amid expectations of a shift to the right after Bolsonaro won the first round.
paras.zh: 巴西证券交易所暂停交易30分钟。博维斯帕指数较前收盘下跌 10%，触发熔断安全机制，并扭转了本月早些时候的涨势，因博尔索纳罗赢得首轮选举后市场预期将转向右翼。

paras.en: Ziemba says Bolsonaro’s refusal to concede the election has driven some financial uncertainty.
paras.zh: 津巴表示，博尔索纳罗拒绝承认选举结果带来了一些财务不确定性。

paras.en: “The market pressure is also amplified by the objections raised by Bolsonaro, but the scale of the victory suggests that the result will stand,” she said.
paras.zh: 她表示：“博尔索纳罗提出的反对意见也放大了市场压力，但胜利的规模表明结果将持续下去。”

paras.en: Interest rate futures had also reflected expectations that tighter fiscal policy under Bolsonaro would allow borrowing costs to decline.
paras.zh: 利率期货还反映出人们的预期，即博尔索纳罗领导下的紧缩财政政策将使借贷成本下降。

paras.en: “They [investors] assume more domestic spending and higher rates in Brazil. However, the real is still likely to be supported by strong commodity revenues,” Ziemba noted.
paras.zh: “他们（投资者）假设巴西国内支出更多，利率更高。然而，强劲的大宗商品收入仍可能支撑雷亚尔，”津巴指出。

paras.en: Stocks closed on Friday almost 7 percent above their level before the first round, while the Brazilian real was nearly 5 percent stronger against the US dollar.
paras.zh: 周五股市收盘价比第一轮投票前的水平高出近 7%，而巴西雷亚尔兑美元汇率则上涨近 5%。

paras.en: Interest rate futures are up 3.1 percent, rising sharply after President Lula’s win. Interest rate futures had previously reflected a tighter fiscal policy amid expectations that Bolsonaro would oust the incumbent and that he would allow borrowing costs to decline.
paras.zh: 卢拉总统获胜后，利率期货上涨 3.1%。利率期货此前反映了紧缩的财政政策，因为人们预期博尔索纳罗将罢免现任总统并允许借贷成本下降。

paras.en: Lula faces an increase in Brazil’s debt and will be challenged with protecting both social programmes and investment, with investors looking for signs of whether his gradual fiscal approach can bring borrowing costs down.
paras.zh: 卢拉面临着巴西债务增加的问题，并将面临保护社会计划和投资的挑战，投资者正在寻找他的渐进式财政政策能否降低借贷成本的迹象。

paras.en: Lula’s team aims to produce a budget surplus of about 1.3 percent of gross domestic product (GDP) by 2030. That would leave money to cover part of the interest bill, reducing the need for fresh borrowing. But public debt already exceeds 82 percent of GDP, while pensions and other legally required spending limit where savings can come from.
paras.zh: 卢拉团队的目标是到 2030 年实现预算盈余占国内生产总值 (GDP) 约 1.3%。这将留下资金来支付部分利息费用，从而减少新借款的需求。但公共债务已经超过 GDP 的 82%，而养老金和其他法律规定的支出限制了储蓄的来源。

paras.en: “Lula’s policies have talked about spending cuts, but he has not gone into the details of how that is going to look,” said Divya Singaravelu, head of research at Meridian 1305 Capital.
paras.zh: Meridian 1305 Capital 研究主管迪维亚·辛加拉维卢 (Divya Singaravelu) 表示：“卢拉的政策谈到了削减支出，但他没有详细说明具体情况。”

paras.en: Attention will now turn to Lula’s choice of finance minister and what it signals about his fiscal approach.
paras.zh: 现在的注意力将转向卢拉对财政部长的选择以及这对他的财政方针意味着什么。

articles.title: Trump faces private citizens lawsuit over limiting White House media access

paras.en: A group of private citizens has sued the administration of United States President Donald Trump over its restrictions on news outlets covering the White House.
paras.zh: 一群普通公民起诉美国总统唐纳德·特朗普政府对报道白宫的新闻媒体的限制。

paras.en: “All of the Plaintiffs rely on the White House press corps for independent reporting about the president and his administration, and all of them use that reporting in a variety of ways in their scholarship, teaching, journalism, or advocacy,” says the lawsuit, filed on Monday in a federal court in New York.
paras.zh: 周一在纽约联邦法院提起的诉讼称：“所有原告都依赖白宫记者团对总统及其政府进行独立报道，并且他们所有人都以各种方式在学术、教学、新闻或宣传中使用这些报道。”

paras.en: The lawsuit is the first lodged not by the news outlets being banned, but by those who consume the news and rely on it for their work.
paras.zh: 这起诉讼并不是由被禁止的新闻媒体提起的，而是由那些消费新闻并依赖新闻开展工作的人提起的。

paras.en: The plaintiffs include a human rights advocate, a media watchdog, a university history professor, a high school teacher, a legal journalist and a student journalist.
paras.zh: 原告包括一名人权倡导者、一名媒体监管机构、一名大学历史教授、一名高中教师、一名法律记者和一名学生记者。

paras.en: Each argues they need unbiased, diverse media reporting from the White House to do their work.
paras.zh: 每个人都认为他们需要白宫公正、多样化的媒体报道来完成他们的工作。

paras.en: “I’m gravely concerned that the Trump administration’s restrictions on White House reporters are cutting off access to crucial information,” Peter Schmidt-Nowara, a high school social studies teacher in New York City, said in a statement.
paras.zh: 纽约市高中社会研究教师彼得·施密特-诺瓦拉在一份声明中表示：“我严重担心特朗普政府对白宫记者的限制正在切断他们获取关键信息的渠道。”

paras.en: “I joined this lawsuit because my students deserve to know what’s happening in their government and to hear from a free and independent press.”
paras.zh: “我参加了这场诉讼，因为我的学生应该知道他们的政府正在发生什么，并听到自由和独立媒体的声音。”

paras.en: Trump already faces several legal challenges to his practice of banning journalists from outlets he dislikes from accessing the White House.
paras.zh: 特朗普禁止他不喜欢的媒体记者进入白宫的做法已经面临多项法律挑战。
