paras.en: Last month, he banned journalists from CNN, MS NOW, and Politico from attending news conferences at the White House. A federal judge later ruled the order was unconstitutional, a violation of the First Amendment, which protects freedom of the press, and ordered access be restored. However, the Trump administration continues to fight the ruling.
paras.zh: 上个月，他禁止 CNN、MS NOW 和 Politico 的记者参加白宫新闻发布会。一名联邦法官后来裁定该命令违宪，违反了保护新闻自由的第一修正案，并下令恢复访问。然而，特朗普政府继续反对这一裁决。

paras.en: Last week, Trump dismissed reporting that he planned to evict journalists from the White House press briefing room and restore a swimming pool that was housed there starting in 1933. But he said he is still considering moving the press out of the briefing room.
paras.zh: 上周，特朗普驳斥了有关他计划将记者赶出白宫新闻发布室并修复自 1933 年开始修建的游泳池的报道。但他表示，他仍在考虑将媒体从新闻发布室移出。

paras.en: “I am thinking about moving the Press, and putting them in a different location, but I will use that location for very badly needed space,” Trump said in a social media post.
paras.zh: 特朗普在社交媒体帖子中表示：“我正在考虑将媒体搬迁，并将它们放在不同的位置，但我将把那个位置用于非常需要的空间。”

paras.en: Kenneth Roth, a senior fellow at Yale University and former executive director of Human Rights Watch, said the restrictions on press access were familiar postmarks in countries whose leaders have become authoritarian.
paras.zh: 耶鲁大学高级研究员、人权观察组织前执行主任肯尼思·罗斯表示，在领导人变得独裁的国家，对媒体采访的限制是常见的邮戳。

paras.en: “Worldwide, I have seen how governmental leaders’ efforts to penalise independent journalists are a prelude to the rise of autocracy,” he said in a statement.
paras.zh: 他在一份声明中表示：“在世界范围内，我看到政府领导人惩罚独立记者的努力是独裁统治崛起的前奏。”

articles.title: Russia says it will open humanitarian corridor to Ukrainian town
articles.author: Joanna Kakissis

paras.en: Russia says it will open humanitarian corridor to Ukrainian town
paras.zh: 俄罗斯表示将向乌克兰城镇开放人道主义走廊

paras.en: Russia says it will open a humanitarian corridor to the occupied Ukrainian town of Oleshky, where people have been eating weeds and pickles to survive while trapped by minefields, shelling and drones.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯表示，将向被占领的乌克兰小镇奥列什基开辟一条人道主义走廊，那里的人们被雷区、炮击和无人机困住，只能靠吃杂草和泡菜生存。

paras.en: Russia and Ukraine have agreed to a very limited ceasefire. It's to help a Ukrainian town that's been under Russian occupation for nearly five years. NPR's Joanna Kakissis has this report on what life there has been like, which includes some graphic details.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯和乌克兰已同意非常有限的停火。这是为了帮助一个被俄罗斯占领近五年的乌克兰小镇。 NPR 的乔安娜·卡基西斯 (Joanna Kakissis) 报道了那里的生活，其中包括一些生动的细节。

paras.en: JOANNA KAKISSIS, BYLINE: It is nearly impossible to reach the town of Oleshky, which sits on the Dnipro River in southern Ukraine. Russian forces occupied this town in 2022 and mined the land around it. Food and medicine rarely get through, and the roughly 2,000 residents remaining in Oleshky cannot get out.
paras.zh: 乔安娜·卡基西斯连线：要到达位于乌克兰南部第聂伯河畔的奥列什基镇几乎是不可能的。俄罗斯军队于 2022 年占领了这座城镇，并在其周围的土地上埋设了地雷。食物和药品很少能送达，奥列什基的大约 2000 名居民无法出去。

paras.en: KAKISSIS: NPR spoke to a woman from Oleshky whose elderly mother still lives there. At her request, NPR is not using her or her mother's real name or voice for safety reasons. She says she fears Russian authorities will target them both. She gives her name as Solomiia (ph), and her mother's as Halyna (ph).
paras.zh: 卡基西斯：美国国家公共广播电台采访了一位来自奥列什基的妇女，她年迈的母亲仍然住在那里。应她的要求，出于安全原因，NPR 不会使用她或她母亲的真实姓名或声音。她说她担心俄罗斯当局会针对他们两人。她的名字是 Solomiia (ph)，她母亲的名字是 Halyna (ph)。

paras.en: SOLOMIIA: (Through voice actor) She tries to call every day. I make sure I never miss that call. Wherever I am, no matter what I'm doing, I will drop everything and talk to her. Nothing is more important than hearing her voice.
paras.zh: 索洛米亚：（通过配音演员）她每天都试着打电话。我确保我不会错过那个电话。无论我在哪里，无论我在做什么，我都会放下一切和她说话。没有什么比听到她的声音更重要的了。

paras.en: KAKISSIS: Because that means her mother is still alive.
paras.zh: 卡基西斯：因为这意味着她的母亲还活着。

paras.en: SOLOMIIA: (Through voice actor) The people of Oleshky are not just starving. They are dying of hunger. There is no flour, no electricity. There is no water unless it's from a well. My mom eats pickles she makes from the vegetables she grows just outside her front door.
paras.zh: 索洛米亚：（通过配音演员）奥列什基的人民不仅仅在挨饿。他们快要饿死了。没有面粉，没有电。除非来自井，否则没有水。我妈妈吃她用前门外种的蔬菜做的泡菜。

paras.en: KAKISSIS: She says her mother also makes soup from grass and weeds from her yard, which she barely leaves.
paras.zh: 卡基西斯：她说她的母亲还用她几乎不离开的院子里的草和杂草做汤。

paras.en: SOLOMIIA: (Through voice actor) Next to my mother's yard, there are land mines on one side. I worry they will explode at any moment. There are a lot of drones lying in her yard tangled in the flowers. A drone chased her in her own yard. She fell and broke her arm.
paras.zh: 索洛米亚：（通过配音演员）我母亲的院子旁边，一侧有地雷。我担心它们随时都会爆炸。她的院子里躺着很多无人机，缠在花丛中。一架无人机在她自己的院子里追赶她。她摔倒了，摔断了手臂。

paras.en: KAKISSIS: Drones have killed her mother's neighbors. Their bodies are often left on the street for days because it's too dangerous to retrieve them. Solomiia says her mother has seen stray dogs eating those bodies. The dogs are starving too.
paras.zh: 卡基西斯：无人机杀死了她母亲的邻居。他们的尸体经常被留在街上好几天，因为取回它们太危险了。索洛米亚说，她的母亲曾见过流浪狗吃掉这些尸体。狗也快饿死了。

paras.en: SOLOMIIA: (Through voice actor) My mom says the Russians don't allow residents to bury the bodies. They're shot at if they try to.
paras.zh: 索洛米亚：（通过配音演员）我妈妈说俄罗斯人不允许居民埋葬尸体。如果他们试图这样做，就会遭到枪击。

paras.en: KAKISSIS: Oleshky's top official in exile, Tetiana Hasanenko, has been hearing such horror stories for months. Many residents know her personally and send her secure private messages.
paras.zh: 卡基西斯：奥列什基流亡的最高官员泰蒂安娜·哈萨年科（Tetiana Hasanenko）几个月来一直听到这样的恐怖故事。许多居民认识她并向她发送安全的私人信息。

paras.en: TETIANA HASANENKO: (Speaking Ukrainian).
paras.zh: TETIANA HASANENKO：（乌克兰语）。

paras.en: KAKISSIS: "People want me to give them hope," she says, "but what can I tell them?" Ukraine's military has tried to ease Oleshky's humanitarian crisis by using drones to drop parcels of food and medicine near homes. Yevhen Voronetskyi is a spokesman for the 34th Separate Marine Brigade.
paras.zh: 卡基西斯：“人们希望我给他们希望，”她说，“但我能告诉他们什么呢？”乌克兰军方试图通过使用无人机在居民家附近投放食品和药品包裹来缓解奥列什基的人道主义危机。叶夫亨·沃罗涅茨基 (Yevhen Voronetskyi) 是第 34 独立海军陆战旅的发言人。

paras.en: YEVHEN VORONETSKYI: (Speaking Ukrainian).
paras.zh: 叶夫亨·沃罗涅茨基：（乌克兰语）。

paras.en: KAKISSIS: "We are not just sending them this food so they can make it through the winter," he says. "We want them to regain their strength and get out of Oleshky." Only a few locals have managed to escape in the last month, guided by a network run by Ksenia Arkhipova, who grew up in Oleshky.
paras.zh: 卡基西斯：“我们给他们送这些食物不仅仅是为了让他们能够度过冬天，”他说。 “我们希望他们恢复体力并离开奥列什基。”上个月，只有少数当地人在奥列什基长大的克塞尼亚·阿尔希波娃（Ksenia Arkhipova）运营的网络的引导下成功逃脱。

paras.en: KAKISSIS: "It is impossible for residents to drive out of the town," she says, "so they have to walk on roads full of land mines and with Russian drones flying over them."
paras.zh: 卡基西斯：“居民不可能开车出城，”她说，“所以他们必须走在布满地雷的道路上，俄罗斯无人机在上面飞过。”

paras.en: UNIDENTIFIED PROTESTER: (Chanting) Save Oleshky.
paras.zh: 身份不明的抗议者：（高喊）拯救奥列什基。

paras.en: UNIDENTIFIED PROTESTERS: (Chanting) Save Oleshky.
paras.zh: 身份不明的抗议者：（高喊）拯救奥列什基。

paras.en: KAKISSIS: Ukrainians have tried to get the word out about Oleshky both online and at protests like this one, outside the Vatican's embassy in Kyiv.
paras.zh: 卡基西斯：乌克兰人试图在网上以及在梵蒂冈驻基辅大使馆外举行的这样的抗议活动中宣传奥列什基。

paras.en: UNIDENTIFIED PROTESTERS: (Singing in Ukrainian).
paras.zh: 身份不明的抗议者：（用乌克兰语唱歌）。

paras.en: KAKISSIS: Art historian Oksana Ivanchenkova (ph) holds up a handmade sign that reads, can torturers be Christian?
paras.zh: 卡基西斯：艺术历史学家奥克萨娜·伊万琴科娃（Oksana Ivanchenkova，博士）举着一块手工制作的牌子，上面写着：施刑者可以是基督徒吗？

paras.en: OKSANA IVANCHENKOVA: (Speaking Ukrainian).
paras.zh: 奥克萨娜·伊万琴科娃：（乌克兰语）。

paras.en: KAKISSIS: "I understand it's impossible to negotiate with Vladimir Putin," she says. "Still, we must try because God sees everything." At the Vatican, Pope Leo has taken notice. Earlier this month, he urged Putin to create a humanitarian corridor for food, medicine and the evacuation of residents. First lady Melania Trump also joined the effort. On Friday, Ukraine and Russia said they had agreed to a ceasefire for Oleshky. We checked back with Solomiia about her mother, Halyna
paras.zh: 卡基西斯：“我知道与弗拉基米尔·普京谈判是不可能的，”她说。 “不过，我们必须尝试，因为上帝看到一切。”在梵蒂冈，教皇利奥已经注意到了这一点。本月早些时候，他敦促普京建立一条人道主义走廊，提供食品、药品和居民疏散。第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普也加入了这一努力。周五，乌克兰和俄罗斯表示，他们已同意奥列什基停火。我们向 Solomiia 询问了她母亲 Halyna 的情况

paras.en: SOLOMIIA: (Through voice actor) My mother says residents have been informed that starting Tuesday morning they would be loaded onto buses and taken to a shut-down children's camp. After that, it's not clear.
paras.zh: 索洛米亚：（通过配音演员）我母亲说，居民们已被告知，从周二早上开始，他们将被装上公共汽车，并被带到一个关闭的儿童营地。之后就不清楚了。

paras.en: KAKISSIS: Solomiia says Halyna sounded frightened and suspicious because, after nearly five years of all-out war, she does not believe in ceasefires.
paras.zh: 卡基西斯：索洛米亚说，哈琳娜听起来既害怕又可疑，因为经过近五年的全面战争，她不相信停火。

paras.zh: NPR 文字记录的准确性和可用性可能有所不同。转录文本可能会被修改以纠正错误或匹配音频更新。 npr.org 上的音频可能会在其原始广播或发布后进行编辑。 NPR 节目的权威记录是音频记录。

articles.title: What to know about China's plenum as Xi seeks stronger party discipline
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: What to know about China's plenum as Xi seeks stronger party discipline
paras.zh: 习近平寻求加强党纪，关于中国十一届三中全会需要了解什么

paras.en: HONG KONG — China's political leaders and elites began a four-day meeting Monday to discuss strengthening the ruling Communist Party's discipline, as Chinese President Xi Jinping pushes for greater loyalty and reliability from officials while deepening his yearslong campaign against corruption.
paras.zh: 香港——中国国家主席习近平在深化其多年来的反腐败运动的同时，力求提高官员的忠诚度和可靠性，周一，中国的政治领导人和精英们开始了为期四天的会议，讨论加强执政的共产党的纪律。

paras.en: This week's closed-door gathering, known as the fifth plenum of the Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party, comes roughly a year before Xi is widely expected to secure his fourth five-year term as the party's leader and personnel changes to key leadership bodies.
paras.zh: 本周举行的闭门会议，即中国共产党中央委员会第五次全体会议，大约一年后，人们普遍预计习近平将获得党的第四个五年任期，并对主要领导机构进行人事变动。

paras.en: Xi began the meeting by delivering a work report and speaking about a draft policy decision on advancing "full and rigorous party self-governance," according to China's official Xinhua News Agency. The policy aims to make cadres more disciplined, effective and less corrupt.
paras.zh: 据中国官方新华社报道，习近平在会议上首先作了工作报告，并提出了关于推进“全面从严治党”的政策决定草案。该政策旨在提高干部纪律性、效率和腐败程度。

paras.en: While Xi has consolidated his grip on power, analysts say the plenum will offer him an opportunity to further align what Chinese officials do with what Beijing wants.
paras.zh: 尽管习近平巩固了对权力的控制，但分析人士表示，这次全会将为他提供一个机会，让中国官员的所作所为进一步符合北京的愿望。

paras.en: "The plenum is a chance to ensure the new generations rising the ranks share Xi's assessment of the opportunities and risks China faces," said Ruby Osman, a senior policy adviser at London's Tony Blair Institute for Global Change.
paras.zh: 伦敦托尼·布莱尔全球变化研究所高级政策顾问鲁比·奥斯曼表示：“这次全会是一个机会，可以确保新一代的晋升者认同习近平对中国面临的机遇和风险的评估。”

paras.en: Here's what to know about one of Beijing's most significant political meetings this year.
paras.zh: 以下是有关北京今年最重要的政治会议之一的信息。

paras.en: Xi targets underperforming cadres and corruption
paras.zh: 习近平针对表现不佳的干部和腐败问题

paras.en: Xi's anti-graft drive has been a defining feature of his rule since he came to power in 2012. Purges of officials — including some viewed as his political rivals — have been carried out on a scale that led critics to argue the campaign was also used to consolidate his power.
paras.zh: 自2012年上台以来，习近平的反腐运动一直是他统治的一个决定性特征。对官员（包括一些被视为他的政治对手的官员）的清洗规模之大，导致批评者认为反腐运动也是为了巩固他的权力。

paras.en: But his focus has expanded to cracking down on underperforming cadres too. In recent years, the number of officials punished for "formalism" and "bureaucratism" — misconduct such as dereliction of duty, inaction and reckless acts that seriously hinder development — has surged.
paras.zh: 但他的重点也扩大到了打击表现不佳的干部。近年来，因“形式主义”、“官僚主义”失职、不作为、乱作为、严重阻碍发展等行为受到处罚的官员数量激增。

paras.en: Xi's policy proposals reflect his emphasis on the party's "self-revolution," a concept centered on the party reforming itself through efforts such as rooting out corruption and building ideological commitment, analysts say.
paras.zh: 分析人士表示，习近平的政策建议反映了他对党的“自我革命”的重视，这一概念的核心是党通过根除腐败和建立意识形态承诺等努力进行自我改革。

paras.en: Osman said the disciplinary crackdowns are now aimed more at institutional longevity.
paras.zh: 奥斯曼表示，纪律打压现在的目标更多是为了机构的长寿。

paras.en: "It's less about purging elite rivals and more about building a disciplined system that can sustain Xi's political priorities across leadership cycles," she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“与其说是清除精英竞争对手，不如说是建立一个纪律严明的体系，能够在整个领导周期内维持习近平的政治优先事项。”

paras.en: Record-high disciplinary campaigns also do not necessarily mean a rebound in corruption, but rather that Xi has been steadily raising the bar for the party's expectations of officials, she added.
paras.zh: 她补充说，创纪录的纪律处分并不一定意味着腐败现象的反弹，而是习近平一直在稳步提高党对官员的期望标准。

paras.en: Mingda Qiu, senior analyst of Eurasia Group's China practice, said Beijing has been building its agenda for months.
paras.zh: 欧亚集团中国业务高级分析师邱明达表示，北京几个月来一直在制定议程。

paras.en: "The message is clear: the anti-corruption campaign is not winding down. Officials are not only tested for loyalty, but also for compliance and action," he said.
paras.zh: “信息很明确：反腐败运动不会结束。官员不仅要接受忠诚度考验，还要接受合规和行动考验，”他说。

paras.en: Xi said in a January meeting that while decisions by the party's top leadership were smoothly implemented in general, inspections and audits found problems such as failures to comply and improper execution, according to an October article in the Qiushi Journal, a publication of the central committee.
paras.zh: 据中央机关刊物《求是》10月份的一篇文章称，习近平在1月份的一次会议上表示，党的最高领导层决策总体贯彻落实顺利，但检查审计中也发现了不遵纪守法、执行不力等问题。

paras.en: Xi warned against "two-faced people" who might profess political loyalty while privately defying orders and doing as they please.
paras.zh: 习近平警告，要提防“两面人”，他们表面上忠于政治，但私下却违抗命令、为所欲为。

paras.en: "During leadership transitions, we must keep our eyes sharp, elevate good cadres who are truly loyal and reliable, consistent in word and deed, and willing to take responsibility, and never allow 'two-faced people' or those driven by self-interest to slip through," Xi was quoted as saying.
paras.zh: 习近平指出，领导班子换届要擦亮眼睛，培养真正忠诚可靠、言行一致、敢于担当的好干部，决不允许‘两面人’、利己主义漏网。

paras.en: Xi's purges of top army officials will be put on display
paras.zh: 习近平对军队高级官员的清洗将被展示

paras.en: The number of empty seats in the conference hall this week will help observers gauge how widespread Xi's purges have been.
paras.zh: 本周会议厅的空座位数量将有助于观察人士判断习近平的清洗范围有多大。

paras.en: Neil Thomas, senior fellow at the Asia Society Policy Institute, and his colleagues Lobsang Tsering and Shengyu Wang noted that while Xi's civilian purges are record-breaking, 42 out of 44 officials affiliated with the military elected as full central committee members in 2022 have also been purged or disappeared.
paras.zh: 亚洲协会政策研究所高级研究员尼尔·托马斯 (Neil Thomas) 及其同事洛桑次仁 (Lobsang Tsering) 和王胜宇 (Shengyu Wang) 指出，虽然习近平对文职人员的清洗破了纪录，但在 2022 年当选为中央委员的 44 名军方官员中，有 42 名也被清洗或失踪。

paras.en: The central committee started its term in 2022 with more than 370 full and alternate members. Thomas and his colleagues estimated turnout this week could be less than 80%, potentially setting a record low at any plenum since the end of former leader Mao Zedong's rule in 1976.
paras.zh: 中央委员会于2022年开始任期，现有正式委员和候补委员370余人。托马斯和他的同事估计本周的投票率可能低于 80%，有可能创下自 1976 年前领导人毛泽东统治结束以来历届全会的最低投票率。

paras.en: Attention will also be on new demands on the officials who remain.
paras.zh: 人们还将关注对留任官员的新要求。

paras.en: Thomas expects tighter scrutiny of public spending and major projects, more use of technology to uncover corruption, and tougher consequences for officials who fail to deliver on Xi's priorities.
paras.zh: 托马斯预计，将对公共支出和重大项目进行更严格的审查，更多地利用技术来揭露腐败，并对未能实现习近平优先事项的官员承担更严厉的后果。

paras.en: New personnel appointments are possible, though Xi may wait until a once-in-five-years Communist Party Congress next year to anoint his picks, said Steve Tsang, director of the SOAS China Institute in London. If he does fill any openings, it will be with loyalists, he added.
paras.zh: 伦敦亚非学院中国研究院院长曾锐生表示，新的人事任命是可能的，不过习近平可能要等到明年五年一次的共产党代表大会上才任命人选。他补充说，如果他确实填补了任何空缺，那也将是由忠诚的人填补。

paras.en: The underlying theme of the fifth plenum is that it will be another opportunity for Xi to position himself for an unprecedented fourth term in office.
paras.zh: 五中全会的根本主题是，这将是习近平为前所未有的第四个任期定位的又一次机会。

paras.en: Xi, who removed presidential term limits in 2018, is viewed by some as the most powerful Chinese leader since Mao. He is widely expected to be confirmed as party leader for the next term in the fall of 2027.
paras.zh: 习近平于 2018 年取消了国家主席任期限制，被一些人视为自毛泽东以来最有权势的中国领导人。人们普遍预计他将被确认为 2027 年秋季下一届党魁。

paras.en: Ahead of that, Thomas said new ideological language reinforcing Xi's authority might emerge at this week's meeting.
paras.zh: 在此之前，托马斯表示，本周的会议上可能会出现加强习近平权威的新意识形态语言。

paras.en: He said the plenum should prepare the ground for Xi's fourth term and reinforce expectations of political and policy continuity.
paras.zh: 他表示，这次全会应该为习近平的第四个任期奠定基础，并强化对政治和政策连续性的预期。

paras.en: "After Xi has purged so many of the people that he promoted at the last congress, watch for tougher scrutiny of the officials competing to join his next leadership team," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“习近平清洗了他在上届全国代表大会上提拔的这么多人后，请注意对竞争加入他的下一届领导班子的官员进行更严格的审查。”

articles.title: Australian judge rejects prisoner's human rights challenge to Vegemite ban
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: Australian judge rejects prisoner's human rights challenge to Vegemite ban
paras.zh: 澳大利亚法官驳回囚犯对 Vegemite 禁令提出的人权挑战

paras.en: MELBOURNE, Australia — A prisoner on Monday lost his challenge to an Australian state's ban on inmates eating Vegemite after he argued in court that withholding the polarizing yeast-based spread breached his human right to "enjoy his culture as an Australian."
paras.zh: 澳大利亚墨尔本——周一，一名囚犯在法庭上辩称，拒绝使用基于酵母的两极分化酱侵犯了他“作为澳大利亚人享受自己的文化”的人权，他对澳大利亚一个州禁止囚犯食用 Vegemite 的禁令发起的挑战失败了。

paras.en: Andre McKechnie, 55, who is serving a life sentence for murder, took his battle for the salty, sticky, black-brown byproduct of brewing beer to the Supreme Court of the state of Victoria last year.
paras.zh: 55 岁的安德烈·麦基奇尼 (Andre McKechnie) 因谋杀罪被判无期徒刑，正在服刑。去年，他就啤酒酿造过程中的咸味、粘稠、黑褐色副产品向维多利亚州最高法院提起诉讼。

paras.en: He had argued being refused Vegemite denied him his right under the Charter of Human Rights and Responsibilities Act to "enjoy his culture as an Australian in the community with other persons of Australian background," court documents showed.
paras.zh: 法庭文件显示，他辩称，被拒绝接受 Vegemite 剥夺了他根据《人权和责任法案》享有的权利，即“在社区中与其他澳大利亚背景的人一起享受澳大利亚人的文化”。

paras.en: Justice Claire Harris accepted prison authorities' refusal to allow McKechnie Vegemite "limited his cultural rights" under the charter.
paras.zh: 克莱尔·哈里斯法官接受了监狱当局拒绝允许麦基尼·维吉麦特根据宪章“限制他的文化权利”的决定。

paras.en: But she found the ban was justified in meeting authorities' goals of removing illicit drugs and alcohol from the prison system.
paras.zh: 但她发现这项禁令是合理的，可以满足当局从监狱系统中消除非法毒品和酒精的目标。

paras.en: "The limitation on Mr. McKechnie's ability to enjoy Vegemite in community with other persons of Australian background is primarily that he is a prisoner," Harris wrote in her 47-page judgment.
paras.zh: 哈里斯在长达 47 页的判决书中写道：“麦基奇尼先生与其他澳大利亚背景的人一起享用 Vegemite 的能力受到限制，主要是因为他是一名囚犯。”

paras.en: Prison officials testify Vegemite could impair drug sniffer dogs and be used to make alcohol
paras.zh: 监狱官员证实 Vegemite 可能会损害缉毒犬并可用于制造酒精

paras.en: Prison officials testified at a trial in July that Vegemite had been banned throughout the state's 12 prisons for the past 20 years because it could potentially impair sniffer dogs' ability to detect narcotics and could be used to brew alcohol because of its yeast content.
paras.zh: 监狱官员在 7 月份的一次审判中作证说，过去 20 年来，Vegemite 已在该州 12 所监狱中被禁止使用，因为它可能会损害嗅探犬检测毒品的能力，并且由于其酵母含量而可能被用来酿造酒精。

paras.en: McKechnie, who represented himself in court by video link from maximum security Barwon Prison west of Melbourne, argued that the fact that neighboring New South Wales state did not ban Vegemite from its prisons was evidence that there were "less restrictive means reasonably available" to achieve such drug and alcohol outcomes.
paras.zh: 麦基奇尼在墨尔本以西安全级别最高的巴旺监狱通过视频连线出庭，他辩称，邻近的新南威尔士州没有禁止其监狱中使用 Vegemite，这一事实证明存在“合理可用的限制较少的手段”来实现此类毒品和酒精结果。

paras.en: Most Australians revere Vegemite as an unfairly maligned culinary icon, and more than 80% of Australian households are estimated to have a jar in their pantries. Vegemite is typically considered an acquired taste at best by those who weren't raised on it.
paras.zh: 大多数澳大利亚人将 Vegemite 视为一种受到不公平诽谤的烹饪偶像，据估计，超过 80% 的澳大利亚家庭的食品储藏室里都有一个罐子。对于那些没有吃过 Vegemite 长大的人来说，Vegemite 充其量被认为是后天习得的口味。

paras.en: The last U.S. president to visit Australia, Barack Obama, once said: "It's horrible."
paras.zh: 上一位访问澳大利亚的美国总统巴拉克·奥巴马(Barack Obama)曾表示：“这太可怕了。”

paras.en: Prisoner argues Vegemite ban contributed to vitamin deficiency
paras.zh: 囚犯辩称 Vegemite 禁令导致维生素缺乏

paras.en: McKechnie had initially testified that the lack of Vegemite had contributed to his thiamine deficiency.
paras.zh: 麦基奇尼最初证实，缺乏 Vegemite 导致了他的硫胺素缺乏。

paras.en: He said both Vegemite and pork were sources of thiamine, also known as vitamin B1. As a Jew who observed kosher law, he told the court he couldn't eat pork either and took daily doses of the vitamin.
paras.zh: 他说 Vegemite 和猪肉都是硫胺素（也称为维生素 B1）的来源。作为一名遵守犹太洁食法的犹太人，他告诉法庭他也不能吃猪肉，并且每天服用维生素。

paras.en: Vegemite has long been marketed as a source of B vitamins thiamine (B1), riboflavin (B2), niacin (B3) and folate (B9) which are promoted as healthy additions to the diets of growing children.
paras.zh: Vegemite 长期以来一直作为 B 族维生素硫胺素 (B1)、核黄素 (B2)、烟酸 (B3) 和叶酸 (B9) 的来源进行销售，这些物质被宣传为成长中儿童饮食中的健康添加物。

paras.en: But McKechnie dropped the thiamine issue as "not important," after lawyers for the prison authorities objected to his evidence.
paras.zh: 但在监狱当局的律师反对他的证据后，麦基奇尼放弃了硫胺素问题，称其“不重要”。

paras.en: Prisoner said Vegemite ban left him feeling 'deprived, sad and disconnected'
paras.zh: 囚犯称 Vegemite 禁令让他感到“被剥夺、悲伤和孤立”

paras.en: McKechnie said not eating Vegemite made him feel "deprived of being able to practice my Australian culture, sad and disconnected from my family and community."
paras.zh: 麦基奇尼说，不吃 Vegemite 让他感到“无法践行我的澳大利亚文化，感到悲伤，并与家人和社区脱节。”

paras.en: The judge responded that "it is difficult to accept that the inability to consume Vegemite, rather than the fact of his imprisonment, is a material cause of his sadness and disconnection from his family and community."
paras.zh: 法官回应说，“很难接受的是，无法食用 Vegemite，而不是他被监禁的事实，才是导致他悲伤以及与家人和社区脱节的物质原因。”

paras.en: McKechnie cited an article published in the food studies journal "Gastronomica" in 2003 that said, "Vegemite may be the best predictor of national identity of any food in the world."
paras.zh: McKechnie引用了2003年发表在食品研究杂志《Gastronomica》上的一篇文章称，“Vegemite可能是世界上任何食品民族特性的最佳预测者。”

paras.en: The article, based on research by Australia's Queensland University in 1995, found that a "taste for the spread strongly correlates with early exposure and to Australian birth and ancestry."
paras.zh: 这篇文章基于澳大利亚昆士兰大学 1995 年的研究，发现“对传播的口味与早期接触以及澳大利亚出生和血统密切相关”。

paras.en: McKechnie also referred to the Australian Olympic Committee overturning an Chinese import ban on Vegemite ahead of the 2008 Summer Olympics in Beijing.
paras.zh: 麦基奇尼还提到澳大利亚奥委会在 2008 年北京夏季奥运会之前推翻了中国对 Vegemite 的进口禁令。

paras.en: He cited Australian band Men at Work's 1980s international hit "Down Under" that mentions a "Vegemite sandwich."
paras.zh: 他引用了澳大利亚乐队 Men at Work 1980 年代的国际热门歌曲“Down Under”，其中提到了“Vegemite 三明治”。

paras.en: On the effectiveness of smearing contraband with Vegemite, McKechnie cited a Melbourne newspaper article from 2017 that reported a man's unsuccessful attempt to use the odor of the spread to conceal illicit drugs that he attempted to smuggle into a music festival in Victoria. The attempt was thwarted by police sniffer dogs.
paras.zh: 关于用 Vegemite 涂抹违禁品的效果，McKechnie 引用了 2017 年墨尔本报纸的一篇文章，该文章报道了一名男子试图利用涂抹物的气味来掩盖他试图走私进入维多利亚音乐节的非法药物，但没有成功。这次尝试遭到警方嗅探犬的阻挠。

paras.en: Judge rejects evidence that Vegemite doesn't interfere with drug sniffer dogs
paras.zh: 法官驳回 Vegemite 不会干扰缉毒犬的证据

paras.en: The judge upheld prison authorities' argument that McKechnie had failed to provide any proper foundations for his opinion that Vegemite does not interfere with drug sniffer dogs.
paras.zh: 法官维持了监狱当局的论点，即麦基奇尼未能为他的观点提供任何适当的基础，即 Vegemite 不会干扰缉毒犬。

paras.en: McKechnie also argued that Vegemite contained "no live yeast" and that any piece of fruit would be more useful in making alcohol than the spread.
paras.zh: 麦基奇尼还认为，Vegemite 中“不含活酵母”，任何一块水果都比果酱更适合用来酿造酒精。

paras.en: A state prison department manager, Kevin White, cited publicly available research that said Vegemite helped home-brewed beer ferment more quickly.
paras.zh: 州监狱部门经理凯文·怀特 (Kevin White) 援引公开研究称，Vegemite 有助于自制啤酒更快发酵。

paras.en: Vegemite's owner, Bega Group, did not respond to a request for comment on Monday.
paras.zh: Vegemite 的所有者 Bega Group 周一没有回应置评请求。

articles.title: It's official: now avoid credit card interest into 2024

paras.en: If you're on a Galaxy Fold, consider unfolding your phone or viewing it in full screen to best optimize your experience.
paras.zh: 如果您使用的是 Galaxy Fold，请考虑展开手机或全屏查看手机，以最大程度地优化您的体验。

paras.en: If you're carrying credit card debt — or expecting upcoming expenses — interest can make it harder to get ahead.
paras.zh: 如果你背负着信用卡债务——或者预计即将发生的开支——利息可能会让你更难取得成功。

paras.en: The Citi Simplicity® Card gives you a clear window to reset.
paras.zh: Citi Simplicity® 卡为您提供了清晰的重置窗口。

paras.en: With no interest for 18 months on both balance transfers and purchases, you can focus on paying down what you owe or covering new expenses without interest piling up.
paras.zh: 余额转账和购买均无需支付 18 个月的利息，因此您可以专注于偿还欠款或支付新费用，而不会产生利息累积。

paras.en: 0% intro APR for 18 months on Balance Transfers is one of the longest interest-free periods available today.
paras.zh: 余额转账 18 个月的 0% 年利率是当今最长的免息期之一。

paras.en: Balance Transfers: 0%, 18 months on Balance Transfers
paras.zh: 余额转账：0%，余额转账 18 个月

paras.en: Applicants with a good to excellent credit score (670+) typically have the best odds of approval.
paras.zh: 信用评分良好至优秀（670+）的申请人通常获得批准的几率最高。

paras.en: There is an intro balance transfer fee of 3% of each transfer (minimum $5) completed within the first 4 months of account opening. After that, your fee will be 5% of each transfer (minimum $5)
paras.zh: 开户后 4 个月内完成的每笔转账（最低 5 美元）需缴纳 3% 的介绍性余额转账费。此后，您的费用将为每次转账的 5%（最低 5 美元）

paras.en: That lower 3% intro fee can reduce your upfront cost compared to cards that charge 5% from the start.
paras.zh: 与一开始就收取 5% 费用的信用卡相比，3% 的介绍费较低，可以降低您的前期成本。

paras.en: If you want flexibility — whether that’s paying down debt, managing new expenses, or both — this card gives you a defined window to do it without interest.
paras.zh: 如果您想要灵活性——无论是偿还债务、管理新开支，还是两者兼而有之——这张卡为您提供了一个明确的窗口，让您可以无利息地做到这一点。

paras.en: With 18 months of 0% intro APR on both balance transfers and purchases, you can choose how to use it based on what you need most right now.
paras.zh: 余额转账和购买均可享受 18 个月的 0% 年利率，您可以根据当前最需要的情况选择使用方式。

paras.en: You won’t even pay an annual fee to hold the card, and applying takes just a few minutes from your phone or computer.
paras.zh: 您甚至不需要支付年费来持有该卡，并且只需几分钟即可通过手机或计算机进行申请。

paras.en: But don’t wait too long — we often see 0% intro APR periods get cut without notice, so it’s smart to act while this one’s still available.
paras.zh: 但不要等待太久——我们经常看到 0% 的年利率优惠期在没有通知的情况下被削减，所以趁这个优惠仍然可用时采取行动是明智之举。

paras.en: We're firm believers in the Golden Rule, which is why editorial opinions are ours alone and have not been previously reviewed, approved, or endorsed by included advertisers. Motley Fool Money does not cover all offers on the market. Motley Fool Money is 100% owned and operated by The Motley Fool. Our knowledgeable team of personal finance editors and analysts are employed by The Motley Fool and held to the same set of publishing standards and editorial integrity while maintaining professional separation from the analysts and editors on other Motley Fool brands.
paras.zh: 我们是黄金法则的坚定信徒，这就是为什么编辑意见仅属于我们，并且之前没有经过所包含的广告商的审查、批准或认可。 Motley Fool Money 并不涵盖市场上的所有优惠。 Motley Fool Money 由 The Motley Fool 100% 拥有和经营。我们知识渊博的个人理财编辑和分析师团队受聘于 The Motley Fool，并遵守相同的出版标准和编辑诚信，同时与其他 Motley Fool 品牌的分析师和编辑保持专业分离。

articles.title: 0% intro APR until 2024 is 100% insane

paras.en: If you're on a Galaxy Fold, consider unfolding your phone or viewing it in full screen to best optimize your experience.
paras.zh: 如果您使用的是 Galaxy Fold，请考虑展开手机或全屏查看手机，以最大程度地优化您的体验。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card (rates and fees) is one of the best cards you can get for paying down debt or financing a big purchase interest-free. It carries one of the longest 0% intro APR periods on the market, plus a $0 annual fee.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡（费率和费用）是您可以用来偿还债务或为大宗购物提供无息融资的最佳卡之一。它具有市场上最长的 0% 年利率之一，并且年费为 0 美元。

paras.en: The catch: once that intro APR window closes, the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card earns no rewards and hands you no ongoing perks. So it's not a great long-term keeper.
paras.zh: 问题是：一旦 APR 介绍窗口关闭，Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡将不会获得任何奖励，也不会为您提供持续的福利。所以它不是一个很好的长期保存者。

paras.en: If your only goal is to stop interest cold, the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is hard to beat. Here's my honest review.
paras.zh: 如果您的唯一目标是停止利息，富国银行 Reflect® 卡将是您的最佳选择。这是我的诚实评论。

paras.en: Intro APR 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on purchases and qualifying balance transfers
paras.zh: 初始年利率 0% 初始年利率，自购买账户开户和合格余额转账起 21 个月内

paras.en: Purchases: 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on purchases
paras.zh: 购买：自购买账户开户起 21 个月内 0% 初始年利率

paras.en: Balance Transfers: 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on qualifying balance transfers
paras.zh: 余额转账：合格余额转账开户后 21 个月内年利率为 0%

paras.en: This no-frills card is a solid choice if your priority is to avoid credit card interest for as long as possible. It offers an incredible 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on purchases and qualifying balance transfers (17.74%, 24.24%, or 28.49% Variable APR after). The balance transfer fee (5%; $5 min.) is higher than some cards, but if you want an equally long intro APR on purchases and balance transfers, this card is hard to beat.
paras.zh: 如果您的首要任务是尽可能长时间地避免信用卡利息，那么这张简单的卡是一个不错的选择。从购买账户开户和合格余额转账起，它提供令人难以置信的 0% 介绍年利率 21 个月（之后为 17.74%、24.24% 或 28.49% 可变年利率）。余额转账费用（5%；至少 5 美元）比某些卡要高，但如果您想要购买和余额转账时有同样长的年利率介绍，那么这张卡很难被击败。

paras.en: These cards are designed for people looking to pay off a large purchase or transfer a balance — so our ratings emphasize interest-free periods, fee structures, and how much time you really get to pay things down.
paras.zh: 这些卡是为那些希望还清大额购买或转移余额的人而设计的，因此我们的评级强调免息期、费用结构以及您真正还清贷款的时间。

paras.en: We don’t penalize cards for a lack of long-term rewards here – this category is all about interest savings, and our ratings reflect that.
paras.zh: 我们不会因为缺乏长期奖励而对信用卡进行处罚——这一类别主要是为了节省利息，我们的评级反映了这一点。

paras.en: We combine these factors with an evaluation of brand reputation and customer satisfaction to ensure you're getting the best high limit card recommendations. Our aim is to maintain a balanced best-of list featuring top-scoring high limit credit cards from reputable brands. 'Best for' category selections on this page are determined by our editors, and a single card may be recognized in multiple categories.
paras.zh: 我们将这些因素与品牌声誉和客户满意度评估相结合，以确保您获得最佳的高限额卡推荐。我们的目标是维持一个平衡的最佳列表，其中包括来自知名品牌的得分最高的高限额信用卡。此页面上的“最佳”类别选择由我们的编辑确定，单张卡片可能会在多个类别中被识别。

paras.en: Ordering within lists is influenced by advertiser compensation, including featured placements at the top of a given list, but our product recommendations are NEVER influenced by advertisers. Learn more about how Motley Fool Money rates credit cards.
paras.zh: 列表中的排序受到广告商补偿的影响，包括给定列表顶部的特色展示位置，但我们的产品推荐永远不会受到广告商的影响。详细了解 Motley Fool Money 如何对信用卡进行评级。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is best for people carrying high-interest debt or planning a large purchase they want to spread out over time.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡最适合背负高息债务或计划长期分期进行大额购买的人士。

paras.en: You get nearly two years of breathing room with no interest, which can save a lot of money while you pay things off.
paras.zh: 您将获得近两年的无息喘息空间，这可以在您还清债务的同时节省大量资金。

paras.en: If you're looking for cash back or travel rewards, this is not the card for you. The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card has no rewards program and no welcome bonus. It loses most of its value the moment the intro period ends.
paras.zh: 如果您正在寻求现金返还或旅行奖励，那么这张卡不适合您。 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡没有奖励计划，也没有欢迎奖金。一旦介绍期结束，它就失去了大部分价值。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card's headline feature is 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on purchases and qualifying balance transfers. (A 17.74%, 24.24%, or 28.49% Variable APR applies after.)
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡的主要特点是，自开户购买和合格余额转账起 21 个月内，年利率为 0%。 （此后适用 17.74%、24.24% 或 28.49% 可变年利率。）

paras.en: That's one of the longest 0% APR periods you'll find anywhere -- which is why it earned Motley Fool Money's award for Best 0% Intro APR Card of 2026.
paras.zh: 这是您能在任何地方找到的最长的 0% 年利率卡之一 - 这就是为什么它获得 Motley Fool Money 颁发的 2026 年最佳 0% 年利率介绍卡奖。

paras.en: This long intro APR is particularly handy for large balances (think anything $5,000+). The longer the promo window, the less you need to pay each month to clear your balance while paying no interest.
paras.zh: 这个长篇介绍年利率对于大额余额（想想任何 5,000 美元以上的东西）特别方便。促销窗口越长，您每月需要支付的费用就越少，无需支付利息即可结清余额。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges no annual fee, so it costs nothing to keep in your wallet. For anyone building credit history -- or, like me, holding onto a top credit card for the long haul -- that's a real plus.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不收取年费，因此放在钱包中无需支付任何费用。对于任何建立信用记录的人来说——或者像我一样长期持有顶级信用卡——这是一个真正的优势。

paras.en: Keeping the card open can help your credit score by lengthening your average credit history over time.
paras.zh: 保持信用卡开放可以随着时间的推移延长您的平均信用记录，从而提高您的信用评分。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card includes cellphone protection when you pay your monthly phone bill with the card. It covers up to $600 per claim for theft or damage, with a $25 deductible, and you can file up to two claims per 12-month period.
paras.zh: 当您使用Wells Fargo Reflect ®卡支付每月电话账单时，该卡包含手机保护。每项盗窃或损坏索赔最多可赔偿600美元，免赔额为25美元，您每12个月最多可以提交两项索赔。

paras.en: I've never had to use cellphone insurance, but as a frequent phone-dropper and generally clumsy person, I've always loved having it in my back pocket.
paras.zh: 我从来没有使用过手机保险，但作为一个经常丢手机而且通常很笨拙的人，我一直喜欢把它放在我的后口袋里。

paras.en: We recommend comparing options to ensure the card you're selecting is the best fit for you. To make your search easier, here's a short list of standout credit cards.
paras.zh: 我们建议比较选项，以确保您选择的卡最适合您。为了让您的搜索更容易，这里列出了一些优秀的信用卡。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card earns no rewards. If you want a card with long-term perks like cash back or travel points, this isn't it.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不赚取任何奖励。如果您想要一张具有现金返还或旅行积分等长期福利的卡，那么这张卡不合适。

paras.en: A strong alternative is the Wells Fargo Active Cash® Card (rates and fees), which earns a flat 2% cash rewards on purchases for a $0 annual fee. It's our Best Overall Credit Card of 2026, and a fan favorite for flat-rate rewards.
paras.zh: 一个强有力的替代方案是 Wells Fargo Active Cash® 卡（费率和费用），该卡以 0 美元年费购买即可获得 2% 的固定现金奖励。这是我们 2026 年最佳综合信用卡，也是粉丝最喜欢的统一费率奖励信用卡。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges a balance transfer fee of 5%, min: $5 -- this is on the high side for a balance transfer card.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡收取 5% 的余额转账费用，最低 5 美元——这对于余额转账卡来说偏高。

paras.en: If you move a $10,000 balance, you'd owe a $500 fee, even though you'd pay the balance off at 0% during the intro period.
paras.zh: 如果您转移 10,000 美元的余额，则需要支付 500 美元的费用，即使您在介绍期内以 0% 的利率还清余额。

paras.en: Run the math before you transfer, because the fee should cost less than the interest you'd otherwise pay. If you won't clear the balance within the 0% APR period, then an alternative balance transfer card with a lower transfer fee may serve you better.
paras.zh: 在转账之前先计算一下，因为费用应该低于您原本支付的利息。如果您无法在 0% 年利率期间清除余额，那么转账费用较低的替代余额转账卡可能会为您提供更好的服务。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges a 3% foreign transaction fee, so you'll pay extra on purchases made outside the U.S. If you travel abroad and want to skip that cost, consider one of our favorite travel credit cards.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡收取 3% 的国外交易费，因此您在美国境外购物时需要支付额外费用。如果您出国旅行并想跳过这笔费用，请考虑我们最喜欢的旅行信用卡之一。

paras.en: It also has no purchase protection or extended warranty on purchases.
paras.zh: 它也没有购买保护或延长购买保修。

paras.en: You'll generally need good to excellent credit (Motley Fool Money estimates this to be a FICO® Score of about 670 or higher) to qualify for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card. Wells Fargo doesn't publish an official cutoff, and applicants closer to 700 tend to be the best-qualified candidates.
paras.zh: 您通常需要良好到优秀的信用（Motley Fool Money 估计 FICO® 分数约为 670 或更高）才有资格获得 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡。富国银行没有公布官方截止日期，接近 700 名的申请者往往是最合格的候选人。

paras.en: Keep in mind, your score isn't the only factor. Wells Fargo also weighs your income, existing debt, and overall credit history. You can check for pre-selected offers on Wells Fargo's site without a hard inquiry to gauge your chances first.
paras.zh: 请记住，您的分数并不是唯一的因素。富国银行还会衡量您的收入、现有债务和整体信用记录。您可以在富国银行网站上查看预先选定的优惠，无需进行严格询问即可首先评估您的机会。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card comes with a minimum credit limit of $1,000, and higher scores and income generally earn higher limits. Wells Fargo sets your limit individually based on your full credit profile, so two applicants can get very different lines of credit.
paras.zh: 富国银行Reflect ®卡的最低信用额度为$ 1,000 ，分数和收入越高，信用额度越高。富国银行根据您的完整信用档案单独设置您的限额，因此两位申请人可以获得非常不同的信用额度。

paras.en: Your starting limit isn't permanent, though. Once your account is open and in good standing, usually after six to 12 months, you can request an increase. Or, Wells Fargo may raise it automatically for on-time payments and low utilization.
paras.zh: 不过，您的起始限制并不是永久的。一旦您的账户开设且信誉良好，通常在 6 到 12 个月后，您就可以请求增加金额。或者，富国银行可能会因按时付款和利用率低而自动提高费用。

paras.en: To get the 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on qualifying balance transfers (then 17.74%, 24.24%, or 28.49% Variable APR), you must complete qualifying transfers within 120 days of opening your account.
paras.zh: 要在开户后 21 个月内通过合格余额转账获得 0% 初始年利率（然后是 17.74%、24.24% 或 28.49% 可变年利率），您必须在开户后 120 天内完成合格转账。

paras.en: I recommend starting the transfer online or by phone as soon as you're approved. Having your old account details ready speeds things up.
paras.zh: 我建议您在获得批准后立即开始在线或通过电话转移。准备好旧帐户详细信息可以加快速度。

paras.en: One important note: you can't transfer a balance from another Wells Fargo or affiliated card. Transfers have to come from a different issuer, and the 5%, min: $5 transfer fee applies to each one.
paras.zh: 一个重要的注意事项：您无法从另一张富国银行或附属卡转移余额。转账必须来自不同的发行人，并且每笔转账均需缴纳 5%（最低 5 美元）的转账费。

paras.en: Applying for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is quick. Here's what to do:
paras.zh: 申请 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡的速度很快。该怎么做：

paras.en: Approvals are usually instant, but can take a few days if Wells Fargo needs to verify some of your information.
paras.zh: 批准通常是即时的，但如果富国银行需要验证您的某些信息，则可能需要几天的时间。

paras.en: Yes, the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is worth it if your priority is paying off debt or financing a large purchase without interest. Very few cards give you a long no-interest runway like this.
paras.zh: 是的，如果您的首要任务是偿还债务或为大额购买提供无息融资，那么 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡是值得的。很少有卡可以给你这样一条漫长的无息跑道。

paras.en: It's not worth it if you want rewards or perks after the intro period, since it offers neither.
paras.zh: 如果您在介绍期后想要奖励或福利，那么这是不值得的，因为它两者都没有提供。

paras.en: Ready to make a dent in your debt? Apply for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card today -- awarded Motley Fool Money's Best 0% Intro APR Card of 2026.
paras.zh: 准备好减少债务了吗？立即申请 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡 - 荣获 Motley Fool Money 2026 年最佳 0% 年利率介绍卡。

paras.en: When the 0% intro APR period ends, any remaining balance starts accruing interest at your regular variable APR from that point forward. The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card doesn't charge deferred or retroactive interest, so you only pay on what's left -- not on the full original balance.
paras.zh: 当 0% 介绍年利率期结束时，任何剩余余额将开始按照您的常规可变年利率计息。 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不收取递延或追溯利息，因此您只需支付剩余金额，而不是全额原始余额。

paras.en: No, the 0% intro APR does not cover cash advances. Cash advances start accruing interest immediately at a separate, higher APR and come with their own fee. The intro offer only applies to purchases and qualifying balance transfers.
paras.zh: 不可以，0% 的年利率不包括现金预支。现金预支立即开始以单独的、较高的年利率计息，并收取自己的费用。介绍优惠仅适用于购买和符合条件的余额转账。

paras.en: Keeping the card open is usually the better move, even after your balance hits $0. If it has no annual fee, it costs nothing to hold, and the open account helps your credit score by supporting your total available credit and length of history.
paras.zh: 即使您的余额达到 0 美元，保持卡打开通常是更好的选择。如果它没有年费，那么持有它就不需要任何成本，并且开放账户通过支持您的总可用信用和历史长度来帮助您的信用评分。
